description:
At Ruff and Tumble we are proud to be the market leaders in Dog Drying Coats.

Our high-quality, super-absorbent, double thickness soft cotton towelling drying rugs, with their unique, practical yet stylish design, is what sets us apart from other brands. Everything we make at Ruff and Tumble is designed with dogs and their owners in mind. Our Dog Drying Robes, Mitts, Bed Covers and Sofa Throws are the ultimate solution for managing wet dogs. Designed with care, and made from top quality cotton towelling, the Ruff and Tumble range is simply essential for dog owners everywhere.

description:
A truly tailored solution to parasite protection

Our goal is simple: to keep every pet protected from parasites, by making parasite protection as easy and accessible as possible.

We deliver flea, tick and worm treatments through your letterbox in exactly the right doses for your pet, at exactly the right time. Simply answer a few questions about your pet, and select from a range of treatment options. We’ll tailor their treatments and put everything in their very own personalised dispensing envelope. When it arrives in the post, it’s time to dose! You’ll never forget to protect, and you can enjoy the convenience of having your pet’s care on your doormat when you need it.

Vet-recommended treatments you can trust

Our protection options include the UK’s No. 1 flea treatment, Frontline Plus, as well as market-leaders, Drontal and Dronspot, and other reputable products that are safe, effective and provide long-lasting protection. As a team of veterinary professionals ourselves, we wouldn’t have it any other way.

A commitment-free subscription that you control

Everything you need to manage your subscription is available at your fingertips via your online account. Make changes to your pet’s protection, add other pets to your subscription, pause or cancel deliveries and more.

Want to know more?


Visit our website to read our story, discover how we’re supporting pet welfare charities and enjoy fun reads in our pet-friendly hub: www.protect-mypet.com

records.title: I treat people as I wish to be treated…… why ??  As a disabled (hidden severe
records.text: I am disabled (hidden severe, crumbling, spinal) prior to our delivery, in the notes (or add info section) I ensured that I’d noted that to please if poss to give me prior warning, as it takes me time to get to the my front door. I have had prev unpleasant experiences with the delivery person, who was going to just leave our 27kg box on the front steps - I hd hoped they hd been resolved, we do not have a closed in porch. I asked to pls just push into our hall - he snapped ´I have a hernià’- i sympathised & then embarrassingly hd to tell him, that I live with a crumbling spine, titanium top & bottom of my spine. Only, after I asked for his name, did he most begrudgingly put the box at the v front of our hall. To which I thanked him profusely & wished him a good recovery.  I have prev left notes on our front door stating the same. This time he waited no time for me to even get to the front door. They just left the large box in full view, in front of our car , no cover or protection.  At mid day - it had to wait until my husband came home from work in the evening. Absolutely no consideration for the fact I’m disabled. What would happen if it had been stolen ?? It’s our darling boys kibble & not cheap. It was really v stressful & quite unnecessary experience. A v sorry state of affairs 😞Your staff at Angell pet Co are terrific, thank you to them all. We hope you all have a wonderful Christmas & New year. Best wishes to you all 😍

description: O.U.R Dog Foundation is a C.I.C set up to help end the suffering of many Romanian dogs. We also have an online one stop dog shop where all profits go towards saving more kill shelter dogs.

records.title: We've had such a positive experience…
records.text: We've had such a positive experience with O.U.R dog foundation! We'd been discussing adopting a dog for some time and got in touch with a few different charities whilst looking but none of them stood out as much as O.U.R dog foundation. From our initial enquiry to the day we put our deposit down the process was seamless and professional, our volunteer (Sarah) really took the time to understand our needs and how our chosen pup would fit into our lifestyle. We were always kept updated with pictures, videos and comments about our pups progress which was reassuring. We were told processes and procedures of getting our dog into the UK which was handled effortlessly by the team. We've fallen in love with (Frankie/Sherbet) and enjoy our evening snuggles and walks! We cannot thank you for all you do. Lots of love The Hale Family ❤️🐾

records.title: From OUR Dog to Our Dog - 5 Stars
records.text: What a wonderful group of volunteers at OUR Dog Foundation and what a wonderful experience adopting Skittles from them.From the first contact right up to the gotcha day and beyond they have been incredibly supportive and friendly. No stone is left unturned in the adoption process, and neither should it be. It give you a complete sense of confidence that they are always there for you and always will be in your journey of giving a home to the best little character ever. Please adopt don’t buy and please get your new doggy pal from OUR Dog. You won’t regret it. And as they say, if you can’t adopt, foster, if you can’t foster, donate.

records.title: Amazing charity amazing work.
records.text: OUR dog foundation has been amazing, they were through in their application process which gave me peace of mind the dogs and our welfare was important to them. They listened to our family situation and helped us find the perfect dog to fit in with our family. The support has been endless and they respond quickly with questions of queries. When you are waiting for your new friend to arrive there is constant updates this was great too. The whats app group for the dogs arriving on the same day is great too as we are all in the same boat and get to share our journeys and experiences and you dont feel alone in this new journey. I would recommend OUR dog foundation to anyone. We are so grateful for everything 🥰

records.title: Darc
records.text: We received our fur baby skittles from O.U.R and the process was thorough yet exhilarating. Every single part of the team has been amazing, kind and supportive to these doggies. Couldn’t thank or recommend them enough!!!

records.title: Thank you O.U.R
records.text: We adopted Silas from O.U.R and every part of the process was amazing. The team of volunteers were so supportive throughout and made sure we had all the help and advice we needed. They did rigorous checks to ensure that we were the right home for Silas which made me feel at ease. Thank you for the great experience

records.title: The whole adoption process was amazing!
records.text: The whole adoption process was amazing. The team were incredibly thorough and helpful throughout - providing regular updates, useful information and photos of the puppies. When speaking to others about the "aftercare" service that is offered, it's clear that the team go above and beyond.Cannot recommend O.U.R Dog Foundation enough to anyone who is looking to adopt from abroad. Once our new puppy has settled, we would definitely consider adopting again through O.U.R.

records.title: If I could give more than 5 stars I would!
records.text: If I could give more than 5 stars I would! OUR are incredible, the way they support you throughout your dogs journey, even after they've arrived is brilliant. You end up with your own little community of doggy adopters who are on the same journey as you and there's always someone there if you've got a question. Thank you OUR for allowing us to adopt such a sweet boy (Bobby) and bringing such love and joy into our life. This experience is so much more rewarding that buying a dog or even a UK rescue. If you're thinking of adopting a Romanian dog, OUR is the place for you.

records.title: Gretel was our second Rommie
records.text: Gretel was our second Rommie, and our second one via OUR. Can't fault them or the way they worked for us. Thorough but sensible home checks, lots of information and help. We got regular updates during our transfers, from collection from the shelter to arrival at our door. Plenty of advice during the settling in period. Hard to imagine what could have been done extra to make the experience better.  Highly recommended.

records.title: Give a dog a chance
records.text: This wonderful charity brought two dogs into our lives… my older lady Ginny and a wee pup for my mum and dad Little Sirius Black!! The team provide Such an amazing adoption experience. Alina is an angel saving these wee dogs from an unimaginable fate. Give a dog a chance of a furever home and be given unconditional love in return

records.title: Amazing experience, we love Honey
records.text: We are totally in love with out dog Honey from O.U.R.The whole experience, from getting in touch to welcoming her home has been amazing.They listened to our needs and lifestyle and actually suggested Honey to us, even we initially inquired about a different dog.The team was right when they said Honey would suit a home with children who can play with her. Even though she was not tested, her fosters in Romania really seem to know their dogs and they were right- she loves our kids and is super gentle with them.She is very energetic but picks up new things very quickly and was toilet trained within two days.We also really loved the ongoing support and what's app group, which has been so helpful!Thank you O.U.R. for our Honey :-)

records.title: They don't produce their own dog food
records.text: I'm really disappointed in Ci Food. I've only recently found out that they don't produce their own dog food, they just buy it from a bigger company, put their own label on the package and sell it to us as if they have produced it themselves. If you don't believe me, you can copy the ingredients of whatever Ci Food you're feeding your dog and paste it to Google. Then you will see that the exact same kibble / wet food with the exact same recipe is sold by other brands as well. For example, I was feeding my dog Tickety Boo Large Breed Puppy (Salmon, Sweet Potato & Vegetables) and Top Drawer Puppy Chicken & Rice. If you copy the ingredients of Tickety Boo Large Breed Puppy and paste it to Google, you will see that the exact same kibble with the exact same recipe is also sold under different names by brands like Furlington, Country Kibble, Challenge Dog Food, Dog's Life Dog Food, Canine Kitchen, Luv Dogz, etc. etc. - brands I've never even heard of before. And the list goes on. Obviously they all buy the same kibble from the same big company, put their own labels and prices on it, and sell it as if they've produced it themselves. Similarly when I've copied and pasted the ingredients of Top Drawer Puppy Chicken & Rice, again I've seen that the exact same wet food with the exact same recipe is also sold under different names by brands like Pets Love Europa, PawPrints, Lovejoys, etc. I recommend you google the ingredients of whatever you are feeding your dog as well. When these companies tell us things like 'we have developed this recipe' or 'we have added this and that to this kibble', they are lying to us because they have never produced the kibble themselves in the first place. They simply buy and sell it and only care about the profit they make.

records.title: I’ve placed two orders so far with…

records.title: I ordered over £100 worth of frozen…

Frustrating as the price was good and the rats looked like they were good quality - other than the fact half were defrosted. I would like to use again though am concerned that this may happen again- though they say frozen rodents are guaranteed to arrive frozen which is not my experience with my first order.

records.title: Not happy with return postage charges…

Very poor in these days when so many things are sent and returned FOC yet this item cost me about £10 in postage when it wasn't needed - I won't order from them again will use a company that do not charge postage and are more organised with their returns.

I spoke with Ryan Woods who was really helpful and knowledgeable and gave me great advice about how to proceed with my dog's care. He also booked a follow up appointment for a couple of days to check on my pup's progress. I feel like I am in really safe hands, and it has avoided a visit to the vet which wasn't necessary at this stage. Awesome service thank you!

records.title: Brilliant service
records.text: I’m not one to write reviews often however this deserves one. I was getting ready to go to bed and went to kiss my cat goodnight and realised she had 2 bald patches under her eyes that weren’t there in the morning, I of course panicked and was very confused about why it happened and weather my cat has an infection or not. Used Joii for the first time as my insurer provides it for free (Waggel) and was pleasantly surprised. The call was answered within 10 minutes, the vet Dr Marta Maksymiuk was very compassionate and understanding and put my mind at ease, told the next steps for the night and morning and even booked a follow up appointment for me after I told her what time I finish work. My closest of hours vet is about 40 minute drive with a £249 consult fee (out of hours), not only it saved me money by using Joii but also saved me stress and gave me a next time to help and monitor my cat. The app is also super user friendly and very easy to navigate.Would highly recommend as this is a literal life saver for pet owners! Thank you Joii

records.title: Fantastic experience!
records.text: I recently downloaded the app through Animal Friends, as I was worried about my 5-month-old kitten showing some concerning signs after using the litter tray. I was feeling really anxious, but within just 20 minutes of completing the consult form, I was on a video call with Dr. Maria Lamprou. She was incredibly reassuring, explaining that the symptoms were likely normal and putting my mind at ease. The whole experience was fantastic - efficient, effective, and very user-friendly. I’m genuinely impressed and so relieved to have this service at my fingertips for any future concerns. Highly recommend!

records.title: Excellent care
records.text: Adopted a cat last week who has unfortunately been poorly since she came home. Have used Joii twice and both times the vets have been excellent and reassuring. They have provided good advice and saved trips to the vets. Very very thankful to have access to Joii through Waggle. Definitely recommend Joii and will only use pet insurers who are partnered with them.

records.title: Reassurance at its finest
records.text: Used this app late last night as one of my greyhounds came up with hives, call requested and spoken to within 15 minutes, Dr Olivia Coker was very reassuring & gave us appropriate advice on how to manage her symptoms and said if anything gets worse to call back through. Thank you!

records.title: Invaluable App - Would Recommend
records.text: I have this app through my pet insurance (Animal Friends) and it is invaluable. I have 24/7 access to a vet, and am able to speak to them quickly even at 2am in the morning. They have been able to observe my dog, and this has been really helpful given he is nervous and reactive in vets, so using the app they can see him in his home environment and give us advice from there. In particular I would please like to thank Dr Sandeep Sidhu for a reassuring and compassionate appointment recently. I would recommend this app to any pet owner.

records.title: Fantastic service
records.text: Spoke with Dr Ryan Woods today, first time I have accessed this service. Fantastic consultation, saw my dog through video call and advised on treatment with a link to medication.This saved me a trip to the vet and an expensive consultation. Ryan did advise if no improvement in 2 weeks to take Frank to our vets which was reassuring

records.title: Absolutely excellent!!
records.text: Absolutely excellent!!! I was so worried about my cat and contacted Joii Pet Care through my cat insurance company (Animal Friends Pet Insurance) as our vet was closed (out of hours). I contacted them initially online and sent photos of my cat so that the vet could assess him prior to the video call and they called me within 10 minutes. The vet was great,  immediately put my mind at ease and gave me valuable advice. Thank you so much Joii Pet Care

records.title: Joii are really helpful and great to…
records.text: Joii are really helpful and great to have on hand through my dog’s insurance with animal friends - they’ve helped me majorly especially outside of normal opening hours. The only problem is, wait times used to be short, whereas now they’re over 1 hour sometimes and the app then shows an error and completely cancels my call. So I have to rejoin all over again. I understand this is probably because they’ve partnered with a fair few insurances and are becoming inundated, but they maybe should look at bringing additional Joii vets in?

records.title: Good experience talking to vet but admin problems!
records.text: Good experience talking to vet. But - my account appears  to be incomplete and unable to complete so unfortunately had to pay £28 on Sunday to get help. Have tried to delete and re download but still not able to update. Have tried 3 times to send message but each time says there's a problem. Thanks Jenny Cattaneo

records.title: This service is included in my dogs…
records.text: This service is included in my dogs annual insurance, to make things worse we were on holiday in Europe. Vet called me she was really good we went through a few checks and she booked a follow up appt for the following day.My alternative was googling a vet and driving there, I felt assured once I spoke with a vet I would be able to contact someone should he deteriorate prior to the follow up appt.

records.title: Helpful 24/7 vet service!
records.text: Great to be able to check your pet's symptoms straight away by following some easy questionnaires and uploading photos you get a videocall from a vet and discuss further from the comfort of your home. You receibe a treatment plan and follo-up meetings of required. Fantastic service! 24/7!

records.title: Good advice from the on line vet
records.text: Good advice from the on line vet who took time to look at my dog (who’d been sick a couple of times) and ask thoroughly about his symptoms before giving advice on what I needed to do/monitor. My only negative is that it took 2 times to connect so I had to join the queue again before able to speak to the vet.

records.title: 4 stars for them
records.text: 4 stars for them. my exp was avg.

records.title: Rocky
records.text: Very good call back system.Vets very friendly and helpful.Downside - issue with app. Had to reinstallto get video and sound working properly. Prompt recall after reinstalled.Always a good service.

records.title: Good service until you change address
records.text: Update after negative review. I had problems with deliveries when I changed address & had difficulty resolving it. However, Joii responded to my review & resolves the issue - which did turn out to be a problem with the app. While I was not refunded for the items which were sent to my previous, the items were sent to my new address, which I’m happy with.

records.title: It was very comforting to have a Vet on…
records.text: It was very comforting to have a Vet on video call in middle of night when our dog was poorly.  They carried out a basic examination, instructing me what to do. They were able to advise that he needed to see a vet but not out of hours.  As instructed I contacted them every 2 hours to monitor the situation.

records.title: Good service Unfortunately Didn’t find the website…
records.text: Unfortunately Didn’t find the website easy to use initially. But had a video call from a vet within 10 minutes,who was friendly and polite .Was given good advice and offered a follow up appointment if required.Excellent service, would definitely recommend.

records.title: Useful app!
records.text: Really good app - our cat had a sore paw which we discovered around midnight so it was excellent being able to speak to a vet in the early hours for peace of mind. The wait was about 10min so not too long. The only thing I would say is the camera quality isn’t great when using the app - I have an iPhone 14 Pro Max and the video quality was a bit grainy, so that was my only negative. Overall, a really good experience and the vet was helpful.

records.title: Easy process to get through to a vet
records.text: Easy process to get through to a vet. Vet very friendly and helpful with thoughts on the issue with my dog. Only issue I had was the arrangements for the follow up appointment. I assumed the vet would call me back the next day. However, even though I was logged into the app it would seem I was meant to initiate the call. Clearer instructions on this would have avoided the call being missed, especially as this was the first time of using this facility.

records.title: Vets are helpful and knowledgeable
records.text: Vets are helpful and knowledgeable. My favourite feature is consultation note after the call. So that I can see the recommended medicine or foods. I think the online shop feature should improve by showing status and tracking information.

records.title: i needed some advice about an other cat…

records.title: Quick and free service
records.text: It's really helpful to get quick and free advice from online vets. It can save time and expensive visits to the vet or OOH animal hospital.

records.title: very good and fast access
records.text: The vet was very good as is getting access to one so easily. The automated questions to get to that point were not so good though. I couldn't really describe her symptoms.

records.title: Lovely advisor
records.text: Lovely advisor. Great advice. I just didn't get the chance to book a time for our next check up call. The day I have been given is just an Anytime call. Otherwise I love this service. It's so reassuring as a fur baby momma.

records.title: Test review
records.text: I am actually not sure I know this company but I’m testing.  I’m going to be rude to see what happens:  I hate donuts

records.title: Wonderful when it works
records.text: Wonderful when it works. Currently my active policy (Animal Friends) is inactive according to Joii on line. UpdateNow sorted and likely caused by the insurer not linking my account with an address.

records.title: Mixed review of Joii
records.text: Used this service back in February and couldn't fault the advice and reassurance I received. Unfortunately, this evening, the 2nd time I have used this service, I was given a window of approximately 60 mins waiting time. I was updated regularly on the time I had left to wait, until I was next in line at approximately 10.48pm, an hour after the initial message. I waited another 30 mins and eventually decided to cancel the call. I was then informed I could not cancel a 'past' consultation. I can only assume the call was cancelled by the vet, prior to my attempt or the app froze?Very disappointed, as I'd had a good experience the first time I used the service, and had hoped for the same tonight. Thankfully not an emergency, but some advice would have been helpful and reassuring.

records.title: Cat having problems with repeated throwing up
records.text: We liked the prompt response and the video call was arranged soon. However, the call did not add particular value at all. We would have liked some practical solution so that our cat got some immediate relief. That did not happen, and we had to rush to the out of hours hospital for Loki.

records.title: Great as a free service, but don't pay
records.text: Great as a free service, but don't bother paying.I used their free service to get a vet nurse appointment about our dog's itchy skin. She recommended some products to buy, we bought one that didn't really work. Later on, I used it again to get an actual vet appointment through our insurance which was offered by Waggel for free. However, the vet offered near enough the exact same recommendations as the vet nurse. Had I paid for  this, I'd be annoyed.Never pay for an appointment with them. Only ever  use the free vet nurse appointments, or free through your insurance. They cannot provide prescriptions and so their advice only ever extends to being just advice about over the counter products you can buy, or recommending you to go to an actual high street vet. £30 for a vet appointment when an actual high street vet appointment is £30-£50, it doesn't make sense to waste your time and money.

records.title: The vet that I spoke too was lovely and…
records.text: The vet that I spoke too was lovely and she did her best to see what was wrong with my dogs claw. I was hoping I could avoid having to go to the vet but she recommended I took her to check. The wait was a bit longer than the 10 mins that it said it would take.

records.title: A mixed experience using this app
records.text: Initially, the system all worked well, but the call with the vet dropped out. It was then frustrating and confusing to  either know whether I was still booked in for a call, or had to re book. Anyway got there in the end and the consultation with the vet was helpful and informative.

records.title: It has come to my attention that Joii…
records.text: It has come to my attention that Joii Pet care are associated with Animal Friends insurance company. Unfortunately we have been left broke and our dog left in pain due to Animal Friends refusing to pay for her PRP treatment. Animal Foes pointed out this treatment is not covered by their terms. In other words, you didn't read the small print. We are not trained vets and we had no idea what PRP was until we needed it. So.... do you still support Animal Friends?

records.title: A good Consultation but no notes!
records.text: Seemed like a good consultation and I was happy at the time but when I phoned my vet after the weekend who in turn contacted our pet insurance company regarding the consultation, the vet hadn’t passed on any notes. Apparently nothing written up at all!After reading Joii reply - the insurance company confirmed no notes when my vet contacted them and none were any sent to me or was I notified I could see the notes via the website.

records.title: Good service, poor stock control
records.text: Great service especially since lock down, however once medication offered at a great low price it wasn't in stock then went back to get new prescription which then tripled in price. Asked to wait for the first order to be sent when restocked was told two months before this would happen. Cancelled the order as two months awaiting a flea treatment is terrible.

records.title: Thoroughly detailed and caring
records.text: Very good, thoroughly detailed and caring. Valuable service in lockdown but still had to make a visit to my local vet for a blood test so ended up paying twice. The prescription was for a generic drug not the proprietary one I requested Metacam. Did not follow up with appointment as needed to see my local vet.

records.title: It was nice to talk to a vet but in all…
records.text: It was nice to talk to a vet but in all honesty probably better for someone to actually see them in person which is what I had to do in the end. The product I bought for my cat was something I wouldn’t use again an made the situation worse. This can work for some but not for me this time, although I would use again if need be.

records.title: Good
records.text: I ordered both dry and wet food for my dogs. They look good, especially the wet food look like homemade unlike other pet food we buy on high street. My dogs seem to like it at the begging but now they seem to stop liking it. It would be nice if we could have variety of food every month instead of having repeated items.

records.title: Mixed feelings
records.text: We had 2 consultations and the 2nd was much better than the 1st where the lady did not have English as her first language and seemed to be reading from a script. We explained we were self isolating for medical reasons and she gave us no help to find a mobile vet service. The 2nd lady was scottish told us exactly what to look for and  if we found it what to say to the vet to elicit an emergency response. Thankfully we managed to cure our pet at home. Otherwise I would have had to have the cat euthanized as that was the only mobile service I could find in our area.

records.title: Good company with good benefits. However, suck in the 1990s so that’s somthing to look out for
records.text: Good company with good benefits including round the clock vet care included in your plan. However, the reason for the low rating is that all their hard work is undone by their inability to have an app that you can pay your premiums online if you fall behind you only have 10 days to pay a premium if you forget and that premiums are split so you have more than 1 direct debit instead of one as I have 2 cats, if this is changed within 12 months I will be moving to a company that u can do that with. It’s 2021 and their procedure and account management is stuck in the 1990s. Would be really good if this company modernised.

records.title: Joii is a very convenient way to speak…
records.text: Joii is a very convenient way to speak to vet in our own comfort. However their delivery and medication charges is something not everyone can afford. They need to take it in consideration so more people feel comfortable and would increase their customers.

I waited about 2 hours then the call came, I answered, saw a glimpse of the vet then she cancelled the call. Waste of time!

description:
The Home of Real-Life Behaviour Results for You & Your Pets.
Behavet is the remote Veterinary Behaviour practice founded by Dr. Tom Mitchell to demystify dog and cat behaviour and improve communication between pets and owners.
Behavet works with clients across the world to offer both one-to-one Behaviour improvement support as well as providing a referral service for a network of Veterinary practices.
Get in touch with the team
 Or, send us an email to: hello@beha.vet, and let our experienced team know what your pet is struggling with
 Alternatively, book a call with our experienced Client Success team and find out how you could get booked in with our Behaviourists for as little as £25 out-of-pocket.

records.title: I recently had my first session with…
records.text: I recently had my first session with Dr. Lily at Behavet and feel very encouraged about addressing my dog's behavioral needs. I've worked with a good trainer and have read many books, but our session gave me new insight and strategies. Lily was very familiar with Harry's medical history, and my vet was impressed with the report he received about our session. I've already seen results; Harry and I both love the training we've begun.

records.title: A special experience
records.text: A special experience. I felt listened to and understood. Living with a dog with multiple struggles has made me feel isolated.With it all being remote I thought it might feel even more isolating but it's been the opposite. My dog wouldn't have coped with in person session and somebody coming to the house is impossible right now. From our very first consult I felt that I was really being listened to an that Dr Lily really understands the struggles that we are going through. Our games have been adapted and broken into bite sized pieces to suit her. She is progressing through the steps faster than I expected. We have a way to go but I feel totally supported by the whole Behavet team and I already have a much happier, calmer dog.

records.text: Great service and excellent advice and programme which is already starting to work after 1 week when I had spent thousands with other trainers and behaviourist and always ended up at square one.  So far so good, I think when you do start to see progress it really helps your confidence to drive forward with the programme.

records.title: Initial appointment
records.text: From making first contact to our first appointment the team kept us updated with what to expect and ensured we had reminders of our appointments. Our consultation was with Liz who took time to probe the issues we are having before giving us tasks to work on. We received a video of our consultation with the tasks we were given the next day for us to refer to. Lexi is a work in progress as it is only two weeks since our consultation.

records.title: We have a very reactive rescue boy
records.text: We have a very reactive rescue boy, reactivity is something that was completely new to me after having had dogs for 20 years. We sought the help of a behaviourist who set us on our path and was very good but Gus just couldn't seem to move forward. I saw Behavet on FB and Trustpiloted them to death ! Our experience so far has been outstanding, I can honestly say with the programme they have set up for Gus we are already seeing improvement within 5 days which is a miracle as I was sceptical that anything could be done. He is already calmer, loving the games and this morning for the first time in months he and our other dog played together. We are all learning together and our house is full of fun again. They do what they say and are lovely to work with. Dr Bea who was assingned to Gus feels already like a family friend.

records.title: understanding and informative meeting…
records.text: understanding and informative meeting with Lily and sensible tasks for me to put into practice to help Doris with her anxiety issues.

records.text: Helpful to chat about being more laser -focussed and having half sessions more frequently

records.title: I was a little unsure about booking…
records.text: I was a little unsure about booking with Behavet as my first instinct of the website and sales call was a lot  about how the services are 'free' if you have insurance with certain companies. It felt a little like that was the main 'selling point' of the consultations, however it was recommended by a friend so I signed up. I wish I had gone with my gut. Although the vet was very, very lovely, and tried to help with my situation, after the first consultation for £635 I felt that the company was only charging this much as it was being paid out via insurance. Something didn't sit right with me about claiming that cost - free or not. The first thing offered after session one was medication for my dog to calm him down which also wasn't an idea I was keen on as I knew the issue was with an addition to our family and how he was responding to that change. He had never been on any sort of medication in the 6 years I had owned him. In the end I didn't give him the medication and he improved over a few weeks regardless. I don't know... the vet was really lovely but I'm not sure I received £635 worth of advice and support in a 1.5 hour session to justify continuing any more sessions. That coupled with the suggestion of medication straight away put me off continuing. That was my first insurance claim in 3 years, and I'll be really disappointed if my premium goes up further because of this claim.**EDIT**:Hours after submitting my review I received an email from Behavet telling me how 'incredibly upset' I had made their vet by posting my review and would I consider removing it. To comment to the further response below, the medication was collected as there was no other actionable options given other than feeding kongs and keeping him crated to rest, and with weeks of sleep deprivation because of the situation, I felt I had no other option. I decided after speaking with the vet on collection, that it wasn't essential and so he wasn't given it. Thank you.

records.title: Slightly disappointed
records.text: Liz was very nice and informative. After a discussion she provided a plan with further information and resources. Unfortunately most of the plan l have tried or am already doing. I realise consistency and repetition are key but I had hoped for some fresh ideas on how to improve life with my dog who became reactive after my other dog died.

records.title: Not a great service, don’t waste your money
records.text: I thought I would give Beha.vet a go as the offer they advertised regarding claiming through my insurance seemed very good. The process to book an appointment was done via email and was very quick and straightforward (to the point of being railroaded) I requested a quick chat with someone after I had booked an appointment just to make sure I wanted to go ahead as the consultation process hadn’t really been explained and I wanted to know if I could have an ‘in person’ consultation with my dog rather than a video call. I was told I couldn’t have a phone call as a consultation had been confirmed and if I wanted to cancel I would be charged a fee, so I kept the appointment. RVN  Liz was very good, she explained things very well but I found it really odd that she couldn’t see my dog or get to know him apart from asking me questions about him. I don’t feel the training was particularly tailored to my dog and the videos that were sent to assist the training were not good at all! They ere boring, repetitive and unclear. I would not recommend using beha.vet, don’t waste your money, use your insurance money better by having a face to face in person consultation with a qualified and registered professional behaviourist. Behavet don’t offer in person consultations. Very odd 😡

records.title: Extortionately overpriced for a zoom…
records.text: Extortionately overpriced for a zoom call. Much better off using an in person behaviourist rather than racking up your insurance premiums. I wish I never bothered.

records.title: We have a VERY specific problem with…
records.text: We have a VERY specific problem with our rescue dog. He won't get into a car. He's terrified.Our 1st consultation was very wishy washy and did not address his issues. We were given generic videos to watch which used exceedingly well trained did who knew what they were doing.Our 2nd consultation was a little better and a bit more specific but failed to help us improve our dogs issue. He remains resolutely terrified of the car. This was a HUGE waste of money when I could least afford it and we are expected to pay more hefty fees to continue.I'm afraid this was a huge waste of money, time and effort.

records.title: I'd give 0 stars if I could
records.text: I'd give 0 stars if I could - filled in the enquiry form with quite a ot of detail as the issue was specific. Got a very quick response listing all their very expensive courses and it was very obvious they hadn't even bothered to read my request form. Then got a load of nonsense about them sending me promo codes - absolutely rubbish.  Clearly only interested in selling courses for a lot of money without looking at what is on the enquiry form. Now I'm being bombarded with their promo email. Very unprofessional.  As an update to their response - there was no way I was giving any financial information to an unknown company I'd found on Instagram. I put a lot of information on the form about my dog and what I was looking for as I didn't see any information on 1-2-1 session. They couldn't be bothered to read what I had asked for and jumped straight to trying the hard sell of extremely expensive courses. records.title: Highly recommend VetBox to all the pet…

I contacted customer support using their form on the website, my question was if I could get two boxes in advance as I am taking my dog on holiday with me over October and November. Danielle replied via email almost instantly and organised everything for me, the boxes have been sent out today, my account paused for the two months as I will already have the product and set to automatically continue for December when we are home meaning my dog is covered and I don’t have to remember to do anything. Thanks so much Danielle for sorting this for me! These products have covered my 21kg mix bread dog who spends most of her time in lakes, puddles and running through long grass clear of Flees, ticks and worms. Thanks again!

After a visit to the vet, they have advised most fleas are now resistant to fipronil (which is the active ingredient for vet box) and they recommended a different flea treatment. Vet trip cost £150 so this has not been cost effective for me and has caused a lot of stress for my cat. In their favour, the boxes always arrive on time, are nicely packaged and the free treats in the box are a nice addition.

records.title: Unfortunately didn't work for my Cat

Although, a positive point was that cancelling my subscription was easy. We have switched to a different provider where you can choose which treatment you get so we will return to our preferred flea and worm treatments.

records.title: Doesn’t cover lung worm

description:
Equine America UK is a traditional, family run business, founded in 1997 by Phil and Julie Middleton and now run by their son, Lee. Wishing to maintain the trusted image of the Equine America brand, whilst moving it into the 21st century, Lee brought on board world-leading equine nutritionist Deborah Lucas MSc.Eq.S., CBiol., R.Nutr. in 2018 and moved all production from the US to the UK.  Deborah is now instrumental in the design and formulation of all Equine America products, from the original Cortaflex to an extensive range of highly effective supplements and external applications for horses, dogs, cats and people.
 
All our products are manufactured in the UK, in food industry standard factories, using only the freshest, most innovative and effective ingredients available from approved suppliers. We use state of the art, unique, fingerprint laser quality testing on every single ingredient to ensure a uniform strength and quality along with an exclusive mixing process to ensure that each scoop contains equal amounts of active ingredients. Our BETA NOPS and UFAS accreditations reassure customers that our products do not contain prohibited substances. We also comply with the regulations administered by the UK Veterinary Medicines Directorate and the Food Standards Agency.
 
Our “30-day money back guarantee” serves to reinforce the total confidence that we have in our products.

I notice the formula has been changed and is far off what I remember the strong odour to be hence why I bought it for my horse with a respiratory issue. I prefer the old formula with the more potent smell.I will use it and  see how we get on with it. I also asked about dosage as my horse is 280kgs over the maximum weight they have stated on their product. I haven’t heard back

records.title: Great product as always but the "Sale
records.text: Great product as always but the "Sale - Save £9.00" on Cortaflex Ultra Advanced is a bit of a con. It doesn't mention that £9.00 is added to the price before being taken off in the sale !! I paid exactly the same price for two of these as I had done back in April.

records.title: Product presentation and packing need improvement
records.text: Delivery time was good, however the packing was poor. The plastic tub of canine cortaflex arrived smashed in a large envelope, even the inner seal was broken and powder was everywhere. Obviously something heavy had been thrown onto it during transport and the new tubs are not as robust as the old ones. Had it been packed in a small box with some bubble wrap, this would not have happened. A further point: the new measure included in the tub is a 5ml liquid measure, and the dose recommended for a large dog is 3g. I presume this would equate to a level measure. All in all, sloppy.Have not yet assessed efficacy compared to the old product

records.title: I was offered a free gift if I spent…
records.text: I was offered a free gift if I spent over a certain amount, I followed the link and my free gift was supposed to be added. When my order arrived, no free gift!!I was ordering anyway but bit disappointed in this ☹️

records.title: Dispenser needs review
records.text: Product is good, but the instructions say to give 3ml with food, but the dispenser you supply is 5ml, so how do you expect your customers to know how much to give other than guess work.

records.title: Sadly it did not arrive when expected…
records.text: Sadly it did not arrive when expected and was two weeks late but the product itself was perfect.

records.title: Good service but the item I wanted was…
records.text: Good service but the item I wanted was out of stock with no indication of when it would be back available.

records.title: My product didn’t come when it was…
records.text: My product didn’t come when it was supposed to I had to email you and then it was really quick

records.title: Product bought ok
records.text: Product bought ok, but not as good as previous product which they’ve discontinued!

records.title: The courier took far too long to…
records.text: The courier took far too long to deliver, but product good

records.title: Have seen a slight change but nothing…
records.text: Have seen a slight change but nothing dramatic

records.title: Delivery problem
records.text: Product excellent, but delivery problem. Package was left in an old telephone box 1/4 mile away from our house. Never had problem before

records.title: Great product pointless subscription
records.text: I've been using the vegan human cortaflex for years and so decided to sign up to the monthly subscription for the 5% off however there is absolutely no point as this then takes it to just under £28 and then I'm charged £3.99 delivery making it more expensive than the original price with free delivery. Why not offer a discount for buying 3 or 6 months at a time and save some postage?

records.title: Ordered not received after 8 days
records.text: Ordered horse supplements, and after 8 days has not arrived. I emailed your company and was very apologetic, promised to resend. I have no tracking advice or nothing to say that it has been resent/despatched.I have now received my order , thank you for resending so promptly

records.title: Not 100% waterproof
records.text: Great fit, however not 100% waterproof, worn for 1hr on my 1st lot of the day and wet sleeves! DisappointedThank you for your reply, it was the 1st time I wore your jacket, so it’s not the fact it didn’t remain waterproof, it never was! It was a steady constant rain not even heavy, I work with race horses so am quite used to the elements. Just annoying you purchase a jacket at an expense, advertised at 100% waterproof and you get wet the 1st time you wear it!

records.title: Awards redeeming is awkward and limited.
records.text: Date of experience: 16 March 2023

records.title: I ordered So Kalm on Tuesday last week
records.text: I ordered So Kalm on Tuesday last week, believing it was on 24hr delivery and thought I would have it by Thursday or Friday at the latest. I have only just received it today, Wednesday which is too late now as I needed it for a show at the weekend just gone. The products are great but very disappointed with the service this time.

records.title: Wrong tablets
records.text: We have a 13 year old labrador that  has problems with her back legs we were recommended some tablets from equine America and they were working great together for  2 years   , then they decided to change the tablets we then began to purchase what they told us was the replacement and if they didn't work they would refund the money  , after  2 months she was  deteriorating and struggling to walk , we then  found out the tablets we were using was a food  supplement and not for joints I rang and emailed the complaint but got no reply,  we have since got a different item that helps her,  don't think it's as good as the original one but seems to help   , so I'd say the product is good but the customer care is very poor

records.title: Incorrect item sent
records.text: Incorrect item sent. Unfortunate as usually really good service

records.title: Product ordered on 17 Feb and not yet…
records.text: Product ordered on 17 Feb and not yet received by 10 March.

records.text: Not had my last few orders yet

description:
Prioritising animal well-being every step of the way, Animed Direct is one of the biggest online pet retailers and veterinary dispensaries in the UK, selling affordable, trusted pet supplies for your furry friend. 

We deliver everything from prescription medications, non-prescription medications, health supplements and specialist food to stimulating toys, accessories and treats, stocking a wide range of leading brands such as Hills, Royal Canin, Feliway, Frontline and Lily’s Kitchen.

Animed has always had the health and happiness of animals at its heart, we believe that looking after our furry companions should be affordable without compromising on quality. That’s why we source all our medications from the same suppliers as vets, and stock the most trusted leading brands at prices that suit all pockets.

records.title: Great all round experience
records.text: Great all round experience. We managed to get food supplies for a dog rescue from Animed much cheaper than anywhere else. They were delivered on time and in good order. I also had contact with customer service which speedy and helpful. Definitely recommend

records.title: Always reliable
records.text: I regularly order my cat's special diet from Animed Direct and have found their process easy and straightforward. Items are delivered well packaged and on time, great service!!

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast delivery. Although items were damaged from being thrown over the fence by royal mail. Animed soon sorted it out and replaced the damaged items. First class   Thankyou.

records.title: Vets are for Pets not Drugs
records.text: It makes so much sense to not expect the Vet to look after these drugs when they should be looking after animals, it costs time, effort and energy.  Animed are the professionals.

records.title: Needed pet meds for Christmas but the…
records.text: Needed pet meds for Christmas but the vet was late sending over the prescription.  Animed dispatched the meds as soon as prescription was received and items arrived very quickly. Excellent service and good value for a repeat item.

records.title: Great service from Animed Direct
records.text: A completion of a six month prescription and a seamless start of a new one, thanks Animed for keeping our medication on track, let’s hope with your website overhaul you continue the good work.Regards Margaret Wakes c

records.title: I rang up to order Metacam for our dog…
records.text: I rang up to order Metacam for our dog a week prior to Christmas.  The order was delivered on the 27th, so bearing in mind it was Christmas  week but I did not expect it before Christmas. The package was well packed so no damage to goods. Ordering process was quick and easy. Thank you, I will be ordering the same in about thre months all being well.

records.title: I bought these tablets hoping they…
records.text: I bought these tablets hoping they would help my dog who now struggles to get on the sofa he has only been having them 10 days I hope soon I will see a improvement

records.title: Getting your prescription first makes it easier
records.text: Ordering my cats medicine was very easy and quick. Having a recent prescription makes the whole ordering process so much quicker. Thanks again, I will use Animed again.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Best price. Easy to use website and ordering process. Consistently reliable delivery. Product has been very good for our golden retriever.

records.title: Couldn't order on the website
records.text: Couldn't order on the website,  so phoned,  it took a while to get through but once I got through they were super helpful and my dogs medication was ordered and delivered in a timely fashion.  If they make the website more user friendly I'd give 5 stars. Much cheaper than ordering from the vet , even after paying for the prescription.

records.title: It was a good service, but!!
records.text: It was a good service, but you would have earned 5 stars if you had been more prompt with delivery. My dog had run out of his meds by the time you sent them after much chasing up.  As this will be ongoing meds, I am hopeful, when you get the next prescription, that it will be actioned more promptly

records.title: No trust.
records.text: I feel I am paying twice each time I want to buy something as even though I have used the same flea med for years this company do not trust me and insist on a paid for prescription each 6 months

records.title: Just a Small Suggestion
records.text: Very efficient and quick and always kept me informed. Very pleased with the order online to my doorstep. The only small suggestion I can make is it would be helpful if the person delivering can just wait a minute, instead of just ringing the bell and leaving it on the doorstep in the rain. Or have an option when ordering to give instructions for the delivery person. As my special renal diet and very expensive cat food would have got ruined in the rain.

records.title: OTT Security - the depth  so unnecessary
records.text: Well the tablets are excellent no issue what so ever,& our elderly Dobbie's walking has improved ten fold  However the HOO-HA & waiting time  to obtain these tablets was so frustrating waiting far too long for the meds to help our dog who was quite poorly !!           This long  wait soured the pot a great deal !!!!

records.title: They were a bit slow letting me know…
records.text: They were a bit slow letting me know about a problem with a prescription (the vet's fault). They were helpful once we spoke, but we ran out of medication and I had to pay nearly 3x as much to get an emergency supply from the vet. As Animed and our vet are linked companies I felt everyone could have done better and been more generous about the cost.

records.title: Generally pleased
records.text: Generally pleased pretty much the cheapest prescription meds out there, but we paid for wednesday delivery due to running out. Friday would have been free, but didnt arrive untill friday anyway luckily as it was the last day of our dogs meds that we had. When i had chased up with animed they refunded the postage as a gesture of good will. For future reference we will order sooner but it was our first order after the vet had issued the first tablets.

records.title: They kept me informed of delivery and…
records.text: They kept me informed of delivery and it was fast delivery. I was happy with purchase

records.title: Would have awarded 5 stars
records.text: Would have awarded 5 stars , but the delivery took longer than I expected.Price and product very good.

records.title: Prompt service
records.text: Prompt service, especially just before Christmas when I feared my delivery might be delayed.

records.title: Everyone makes mistakes sometime!
records.text: Easy and straightforward to renew my order by phone -once the long wait to speak to someone was over. Frustrating having to hang on for so long. Pleasant, friendly person took my order. Unfortunately the order was duplicated and there was a second delivery a few days later. Pleasant DHL delivery man who took the order back.

records.title: The product took a while to be…
records.text: The product took a while to be dispatched but I was kept informed once this was done.

records.title: Prescription checking takes too long
records.text: There is now a much longer wait for prescription items to be checked and sent which is quite disappointing, and means that I have to order much further ahead. Non prescirption items are dispatched much quicker.Generally happy with the service as long as I'm not in a hurry!

records.title: Always helpful and patient with me
records.text: Always helpful and patient with me. Thank-you.

records.title: Animed have been great but…
records.text: Animed have been great. However, this time, I submitted my prescription as usual and waited a couple if days for final approval. This was refused as the rules around certain wording had changed. I think this should have been picked up immediately. By the time the vet had resent the prescription and it was dispensed i had got down to my last tablet for my dog. The amendment needed should have been picked up earlier!

records.title: It may not be down to Animed
records.text: It may not be down to Animed, but I have had a tin of dog food so squashed it was unusable (Hills). They often have small dents which is acceptable as long as the coating inside is intact, which this wasn’t. On the plus side I’ve always been impressed with the speed Animed ships orders and they are also competitive.

records.title: Quick and easy
records.text: Website is easy to use the only thing I’d like to be able to use is Apple Pay

records.title: Animed are fantastic
records.text: Animed are fantastic. Their website is easy to use and items are dispatched very quickly. The only thing that stops this being a five star review is the atrocious delivery service which is not down to Animed. My parcel contained food for a renal cat and medication, total value of about £150. I wasn’t home and wasn’t expecting the delivery for a couple of days and it was dumped on my doorstep in full view of passers by for anyone to steal. This is the second time it’s happened with that particular delivery company.

records.title: Always delivered on time and reasonably…
records.text: Always delivered on time and reasonably priced.

records.title: It would been 5 stars but for the time…
records.text: It would been 5 stars but for the time I had to get in touch about the order

records.title: When I placed my order I sent the wrong…
records.text: When I placed my order I sent the wrong attachment- I should have sent the prescription. It was obvious that I had sent the wrong document but instead of letting me know it sat as "pending" for a week  until I rang up. The lady I spoke to apologised but by then it was the week before Christmas. To cover the medication over Christmas I had to go to the vets to buy a small bottle of Thronorm ( over 3x the price).

records.title: Poor product. Prompt Refund
records.text: I bought 4 Chuckit Tennis Balls for dogs. The first of these split after the fifth throw from a ball launcher. I requested a full refund and received this promptly. Full marks for customer service but why sell such a sub-standard product?

records.title: Frustrated by length of time it took to…
records.text: Frustrated by length of time it took to get medication and communication issues. Phone lines closed early for Christmas. Great price once we did get it.Good customer service once I eventually spoke to someone.

records.title: Problems with the prescription from…
records.text: Problems with the prescription from your end. It took several emails to resolve the issue. You couldn't fulfill my order due to image resolution, that is until I asked for a refund, then suddenly the medication for my dog's eyes was dispatched. Unnecessary delays which prolonged the treatment for my chicken spaniel's conjunctivitis.

records.title: Delivery takes so long I ordered on the…
records.text: Delivery takes so long I ordered on the Monday thought I would get at least before Christmas which was 9 day later I didn't get it delivered until the Friday after Christmas

records.title: Unable to speak to anybody
records.text: Tried for 3 days to speak with somebody, limes always busy.Was unsure if we would receive order before run out out of medication.Had to get vet to supply meds ,on the Friday then got order on the Monday.Ended up paying £70 more for meds and now have extra.First order hopefully no further issues.

records.title: Ongoing issues with orders being taken…
records.text: Ongoing issues with orders being taken not able to provide or delayed. Several times taken order express delivery for it to be delayed. Whilst they refunded express delivery when I complained not overly helpful when it is specialist food. I had an email advising if I ordered by 19th standard delivery I would receive the order before Xmas. Placed order on the 18th express delivery to be told delivery would be 27th onwards. On contacting told reason being placed it after they closed! It was online order and still before 19th. Had just enough to last till 27th. Now been told 5 days later run out of the dry food and cancelled order. My cat has large and small bowel disease and tri tric. Without the dry food she will eat substantially more wet meaning I will now run out of wet food by the time I place another order. This food is required for medical reasons and I placed it in plenty of time to ensure I did not run out. Any other food will make my cat extremely ill. Will be looking for new supplier in New Year that is reliable once OK it happens, but this is the 4th time at least in last few months.

records.title: My parcel was damaged and contacted you…
records.text: My parcel was damaged and contacted you but to date have not received a reply.

records.title: Missing worming item from order
records.text: Being a regular customer each month I was not happy by the response I received when part of my latest order was missing.I could not get through on the telephone to discuss the matter and when I sent an email I received one back wanting packaging details. Unfortunately the packaging had been put out for rubbish which has been picked up that day. There was no paperwork with the normal item I receive. I wrote an email back but have not received a reply.I have used your company on a regular basis and will continue to do so.

records.title: The amount of time it took to receive…
records.text: The amount of time it took to receive my prescription wasn't good.

records.title: The process was fine but the delivery…
records.text: The process was fine but the delivery side was a nightmare.

records.title: Prescription reorder
records.text: Once my prescription has been passed off everything is fine. It's that interim period of several days to get there that is the problem.

records.title: poor needles
records.text: delivered on time, scanner good. Ended back at the vets as needles were of no use to gain a blood sample. Vets tried as well

records.title: Unfortunately due to the past two…
records.text: Unfortunately due to the past two deliveries either not being sent or delays with Royal Mail, I have lost faith in using this website to order from. Can’t fault the customer services staff….when you eventually get through.  I was waiting for 20 minutes, only for the call to be disconnected and then had to wait a further 20 minutes to talk to someone.  Suffice to say, I will now be making my purchases elsewhere

records.title: Terrible customer service
records.text: Terrible customer service! The whole order process was terrible. Couldn’t get in touch with anyone to resolve my issues. Even the vets practice that I use spent a long time over a few days trying to speak with someone. Took days for emails to be replied to.

records.title: Contact and customer care issues
records.text: My order was sent in two parts, the most important part was a prescription medicine which was delayed.  I managed to speak to someone on the Friday the order had been placed - the day on which it should have arrived, but the information they could give was limited. The order did not arrive for several days more and it was impossible to get hold of anyone, a customer care email enquiry took four days to be replied to.  I really think that I will look at switching to a supplier that answers phones, it is so frustrating not to be able to speak to someone when you need to have an answer. Sorry, I have been using Animed regularly for several years but this is not the first time I have had similar experience, it is a shame as it is my preferred website for choice etc.

records.title: Having my telephone number on the order…
records.text: Having my telephone number on the order form it would have been more efficient had someone notified me that due to recent rules my email address and/or telephone number was required on the prescription form.  It was only after I became concerned after 7 or so days that I rang your organisation to be told of the necessity ofthis information.  I  contacted the vets who again resubmitted the prescription and again it was several days before my order was processed.  As I required the medication for my dog who was going into to kennels as i was going abroad this delay caused me anxiety in case it didn't arrive in time

records.title: Delivery for insulin now 2 weeks
records.text: Delivery for insulin use to be 3 days. It now seems to be 2 weeks. And no communication until the end.  Not very good when you have a diabetic family pet. Seems this company is going through some kind of change. And not a good one.

records.title: I’ve ordered from Animed a few times…
records.text: I’ve ordered from Animed a few times without incident, but due to new regulations and Animed rejecting the prescription from my vet for not having info on it that was definitely on it, my dog was left without tablets for almost a week. Then they admitted error but still “couldn’t” send the tablets on a next day delivery.

records.title: My order is delayed for over a week
records.text: My order is delayed for over a week. I called up the 0330 number waited 21 minutes then reached position 1 in the queue and was immediately cut off. I tried the automated chat- it was hopeless and not at all helpful. I asked it for a person, it refused and kept looping me around to send an email. I sent an email asking for a call back and animed did call me back and we able to cancel my order and explain why the order had been delayed.  As a result I have increased my rating

records.title: Bad communication and delivery time
records.text: Last couple of orders have taken much to long to process and deliver.  it was a good job I phoned up to ask why my order was taking so long, I was told I needed to upload my prescription again due to ‘cropping’. Otherwise I’ll be still waiting. 🤷🏻‍♂️

records.title: Slow service
records.text: Product arrived late, an email days later to say they needed a written prescription, so had to post them a few days later a second email to say it wasn’t actually required. Why not just pick up a phone?

records.title: Bad ordering process
records.text: Good company, however every time i called, no answer saying busier than normal. Takes them a few days to respond to emails. Once items received, they were good. Just expect a long wait from orders to receipt.

records.title: Paid for express delivery
records.text: Paid for express delivery, but took ages to come, only dispatched on day it was supposed to be delivered.

records.title: it took fa too long to set up my account
records.text: it took far too long to set up my account, i had to purchase goods from my vet in the meantime at a higher cost

records.title: Vital medication was not dispensed
records.text: Vital medication was not dispensed due to prescription error made by Animed. No notification received advising of problem. Impossible to get through on phone. Sent an email and only dispensed when I chased, No apology received. Appalling customer serviice

records.title: Driver lobbed the package into bush…
records.text: Driver lobbed the package into bush where it was difficult to retrieve without breaking the bush and heavy for me at 87.  |Next time if not in, leave on porch

records.title: Communication issues with Animed
records.text: Although I realise due to changes in Prescription laws, Animed was in a difficult situation.  My experience trying to communicate with them was not good, for example   ...  Ring and choose option 2 to discuss an existing order, go through the ordeal of listening to a load of spill, just to end up being told 'Sorry we are very busy at present - ring back later'   ..   Not good Customer Service at all. During the process, I sent in excess of 10 emails ,  this should not be necessary.  I was also on eventually talking to a Support desk person my order would be 'fast pathed' and being re-assured I had supplied all the required / necessary information  .....     Nothing happened.   The whole experience was very difficult and unpleasant  .....  I really feel they let down their Customers  and more importantly the Pets waiting for medicines.  Ian Bradford

records.title: Takes too long for a prescription to be dispatched
records.text: Takes too long for a prescription to be checked and dispatched, the chat bot is useless if you work a 9-5 job like me. Just hope my little doggie gets his meds in time for Xmas I should have ordered from my regular supplier, will not use Animed again!

records.title: Delayed dispatch and no response to emails
records.text: Ordered medication for my cat for the first time on Wednesday 11th December. Estimated time of delivery stated was Friday 13th. It is now Tuesday 17th and my order is still pending vets approval (prescription was uploaded at the time of order). Tried calling but no answer and also no response to email. Disappointing level of service to what would otherwise be a cheaper alternative to buying direct from the vet.

description:
We've been selling online for 25 years and are the preferred place to get Everything for your Parrot for thousands of happy customers.
We've got the widest range of literally hundreds of safe, unique toys, all the major foods and supplements, quality cages, stands and accessories and much more.

records.title: Excellent service as always.
records.text: Really easy to use the site, no problem with the order, fast delivery. Came well packaged, non of the items were split or in bad shape. Love Northern parrots and will continue to be a loyal customer.

records.title: Faultless service …
records.text: Northern Parrots is a brilliant company to deal with and so easy to order with. Have used them for a few years and don’t look anywhere else. Know that the order will be dealt with promptly and arrive in a few days. They seem to stock exactly what the Vets recommend.

records.title: Long time shopper
records.text: My parrot is 23 years old and I have been using this site since she was a baby. Always reliable delivery. Good quality toys and tasty food.

records.title: The best place to buy all your parrot
records.text: The best place to buy all your parrot. Seed. Toys. And health requirements. Everything you want. Well packed and superfast delivery . They have everything and can advise you what's best for your bird. They are Just 1st class.

records.title: Excellent products
records.text: Excellent products, excellent service. I can't fault them.  Once a delivery went wrong, the fault of the courier.  They put it right immediately.  My Amazon Grey, Mozart, agrees with everything I say!

records.title: We have found Northen Parrots very…
records.text: We have found Northen Parrots very helpful we have a conjor for over thirty years  and have alway shopped with them for our birds food and toys.

records.title: VERY PLEASED
records.text: Always despatch quickly and they use good carriers. Very rare items not in stock.  Been dealing with this company for quite a few years now,   never let me down,     I highly recommend.

records.title: Great Value pack (purchased half price) …
records.text: My Indian Ringneck loved this Christmas pack, lots of different toys in this pack to keep him entertained, also looked great to give his cage that special Christmas decoration effect.

records.title: Excellent products
records.text: I honestly cannot fault the products from this company. I’ve bought several things now and I keep coming back to buy more. My bank doesn’t thank me for it!

records.title: Top class all around
records.text: Top class all around , easy to order online and delivery was well informed and arrived in perfect packaging and items

records.title: Nice and easy to order
records.text: Nice and easy to order, quick delivery.One star deducted as stock of some products take time to come back in.All in all good shopping experience.

records.title: Very good choice of products and quick…
records.text: Very good choice of products and quick delivery

records.title: Very good quality and price Tommy the…
records.text: Very good quality and price Tommy the parrot loved his new toys

records.title: Decent Review
records.text: I like this company and generally they are great but since becoming bigger / taken over , prices have gone up quite a lot and the spend before free postage has now gone up too . As a regular customer over many year , I also feel that money off coupons and codes would be good sometimes . Money off coupons are very rare . In fact I believe I have only ever had one . I also sometimes got little free  trial packs with my order and this has also stopped . Perhaps less personal service with the growth of the business has happened

records.title: Everything is always in stock,I love…
records.text: Everything is always in stock,I love they send out a book with everything in it , sometimes a free sample, which is nice and should be done more often

records.title: The amount you have to spend to get…
records.text: The amount you have to spend to get free postage is a bit high. You should be able to make a small order for a reasonable postage price, as sometimes a couple of items will be out of stock and to order just them when they come back in stock is costly.However, the items ordered and service are consistently good.

records.title: Usually 5 stars for service and…
records.text: Usually 5 stars for service and products.Unfortunately this time round our 3kg bag of cockatiel food was damaged and had spilt out in the box. Not ideal, especially when I don’t have a container big enough to transfer the seeds. Box it arrived in wasn’t damaged, so I’m assuming the bag was damaged before it was packed up for delivery.

records.title: The Birch Parrot Perches
records.text: The Birch Parrot Perches I bought are rather bigger in diameter than I expected. The product description said average of 2.5 - 3cm and mine are 4cm. Unsure how suitable they are for an Amazon. He is still viewing the perch with suspicion, so can’t comment as to whether he likes it! Hopefully he will take to it.

records.title: Happy
records.text: Ordered UV-light, works prefect & birds seem to like it, simple to put together, although I think some sticky pads were missing so I have to use blu-tac to attach the reflector nothing major. Had an issue with postal address Northern Parrots were really responsive and resolved it will 100% use them again.

records.title: All OK
records.text: OK, so the parcel didn't arrive this time quite as quickly as usual - but 'usual' is exceptional!  Perhaps that's down to the postal system.  Otherwise, as efficient as always:  what would we do without you?

records.title: Good customer service and some good toys
records.text: Their shipping is often quite fast and the toys are usually high quality. A while back I had bought food from them and my bird had gotten a bacteria infection from it. They refunded me no questions asked and spoke to the supplier/company of the food I'd ordered which was very nice.A few toys i do tend to avoid due to possible safety issues such as crop impaction from the cotton preening toys. There are also some toys that are not the best quality but they are easily avoidable if you know what you're looking for / what to avoid.

records.title: Huge choice of toys and food
records.text: I just love that there is such a big choice on offer.However, when I sent you a question for a particularitem, your reply never did address my problem and all I got was a generic answer. Nothing whatsoever to do with what I asked. Not very satisfying at all.

records.title: I been with NP many years brought off…
records.text: I been with NP many years brought off eBay they were a different name parcel arrived next day from Amazon logistics Europe paid alot of money to get zupreem as been stopped by EU for a while then after delivery get lots of messages from NP don't see why they did not use their name such a good company

records.title: Excellent company with great knowledge
records.text: I love what I can get for my two African Grey parrots. There’s such a lot of choice. I can spoil them rotten. The food and treat options are exceptional and on the occasions I’ve had to ask for advice over the phone, they have been so helpful and knowledgable.  There are times when the pellets I get for the boys are out of stock, which isn’t great. But I guess that’s as frustrating for these guys too. They usually have an expected date under the product, but not always. That would be my only gripe and only reason it’s not 5 stars. I’ve had to change food three times because of a U.S.A./ UK import issue so not being able to get pellets worries me as I think I’m going to have to do it again and need to prepare for that.

When delivering my parcel Royal Mail was three days late but Northern parrots refunded me the full delivery fee. Very happy overall and great customer service. Will be buying from them again. Great company poor delivery time by Royal mail.

records.title: I never received my order
records.text: I never received my order.  I emailed Northern Parrots twice, to let them know and had no response nor have I received a refund.  Am very disappointed and cannot recommend them.Further to the above message.  My messages (reply to message sent with receipt) were not received, but after calling NPs, they have swiftly dispatched  a replacement.  Suggest that a contact email for queries is clearly documented on email receipts as they reply I sent did not get through.

So unfortunately, I do not feel able to give them the five Star review that I think they should deserve. Usually the customer service is fantastic And the quality of products is too. I think this is poor as I have had people telling me on the phone that they even send things to Europe. So how come  sending it to a place up north where other large complex items can get to is so impossible. records.title: Disappointing, not up to the usual standards.
records.text: The toy pack wasn't up to the usual standards, hence only three stars.  I'm not convinced that the toys are safe enough.  The climbing net is basically just thick string, and too easy for claws and necks to get caught in.  The colourful wooden toy was falling apart, and appeared to have been glued in places, and I had to trim the long ends of the thin rope.  The sneaker toy has very dangerous loose and long laces, and small metal loops on them which don't make good toys, and I'm not convinced that the plastic/rubber (?) is bird safe. The wooden holder isn't much use unless you buy the jellies to go in it.  Even at the sale price, this pack wasn't worth it.  Too risky.  I hope it's just a hiccup, because I've always been very happy with Northern Parrots before.
