description:
Hey there fellow dog lovers! Let me tell you the tail (pun intended) of how our brand came to be.

It all started 3 years ago when my furry best friend Dudley had a bad reaction to a bag of shop bought treats from a well-known supermarket chain. Little did we know that the treats were chock-full of hidden nasties such as cereals, corn, sugar, derivatives, preservatives, and flavourings. It didn't take long for Dudley to develop a runny bum and a bad tummy - talk about a total paw-saster!

We rushed Dudley to our local vet who ran a few tests and discovered that he was allergic to wheat. After a lot of research, countless emails, and car miles, we finally stumbled upon a handful of fantastic natural treat suppliers who we now partner with to bring you the best of the best natural dog treats today.

But we didn't stop there. We realised that there were so many dog owners out there who were also struggling to find healthy, safe and delicious treats for their fur babies. That's when we decided to create a community of like-minded dog owners who share our passion for all things natural, nutritious and delicious.

So, we started a private customer Facebook group where dog owners could come together, interact, and share their stories, tips, and tricks. We wanted to create a space where people could feel supported, educated and empowered to make the best choices for their dogs.

And that's exactly what we did! Our community has grown into a tight-knit group of dog moms and dads who are passionate about giving their furry family members the very best. We've become a go-to resource for dog owners looking to go raw hide-free, learn more about the benefits of natural dog treats, and connect with other dog lovers who share their values.

So, whether you're a seasoned dog mom/dad or a brand new puppy parent, we're here for you. We're excited to be a part of your dog's journey and can't wait to see what the future holds. Thanks for being a part of our pack! 🐶💛

records.title: Company good, Star rating and review is on products received (please read)
records.text: For clarity, my stars are given for the products received. The company responded well to my inquiry regarding the issues I speak of below, and their delivery was fast, if a little pricey, but that's the world we're in now.These treats have all the hallmarks of natural ones, especially given their eau naturale smell! I purchased the "long lasting chew box treats" and unfortunately these were not at all long lasting. Its been stated that a "long" session for a chew is 15 minutes, apparently, but only 1 of the 5 (haven't gone through all 15 yet) has lasted more than 4 minutes - I bought this box as a test so I could stop buying the rather expensive Yakkers chew but Ive since had to go back to them in order to keep my dog still for more than a few minutes.The split antler however, was a success and lasted 3 or 4 sessions, but at 3/4 used, my Lab is no longer interested in it - Most likely cause its dried out, but that's a guess.Overall the company seems decent and I appreciate that a review of 3* for one box of treats that wasn't what I had expected could be seen as a little unfair but its currently all I have to go on, so I hope its been useful.I would use this company given their aim is to deliver natural treats to your dog, but I wouldn't expect anything different to some of the existing long chews out there.

records.title: Always been satisfied with my order

records.title: Service is very good from your end but…
records.text: Service is very good from your end but safe delivery is questionable. records.title: The service is good as is the price but…
records.text: The service is good as is the price but unfortunately my pets medication ended up in  Henley which is not where I live. It had to be redirected which meant I waited nearly a week for it. This was not really the fault of pet prescription so I will continue to use them.

records.title: Regular Customer
records.text: I would normally rate PP with 5 stars; however due to a delay in receiving my latest order a lower rating has been given. On contacting PP to check on my order, ref previously provided by email, it apparently hadn't been despatched due to a computer issue. The young lady I spoke to was extremely apologetic and organised a courier delivery when I received my order the next day. Have always been happy with the friendly/ helpful customer service team so will definitely continue to do business with PP.

records.title: I am very pleased with PP as they are…
records.text: I am very pleased with PP as they are very prompt with the order which I am grateful for. My only niggle is that I was not aware that my prescription was dated and I had missed the cut off date so I had to order another script which cost me more money. Other than that I am more than happy with the service.

records.title: Most definitely would have been 5 stars…
records.text: Most definitely would have been 5 stars apart from glitch with computer not recognising my change of address,I have had prescription fulfilled to the new address earlier so too sure what the problem was.As soon as sorted v quick delivery, staff just lovely to deal with over the phone.

records.title: Professional and prompt service
records.text: Professional and prompt serviceAlthough there was a delay in accepting the prescription because it was folded in half, which was frustrating, the customer service was excellent. Prompt, regular contact that was not automated but an actual person, and a reminder as well to re submit the prescription. Once the prescription was accepted the delivery took place quickly.

records.title: Not received..but may be on its way
records.text: Update.... received Unfortunately I never received my dogs medication.  When I called I was advised they would resend it but a couple of days later they called me to advise it was out of stock.  Still no medication.  Worked out rather expensive as I have paid my own vet £18 to get the prescription and also paid for the medication. Update....received a call today that the medication has been returned and is being posted.  Should receive it in 2 days.

records.title: Not a Good Service
records.text: Changed rating from 1 star to 3 star since finally getting through to Customer Services.Problem described below lies with Royal Mail, albeit that it still took a while before the prescription was verified and the order processed.  -------------------------Absolutely impossible to get information on very important medication that should have been sent within two or three days. It's now been 7 days (5 working days) with no delivery and I may now have to  visit my vet in order to pick up a small supply of the necessary tablets should my dog suffer any ill effects. This will obviously increase my costs as well as my anxiety.Tried calling twice and eventually got through 2nd time after 25/30 mins.May revert back to their sister company or make sure I have a good week's current supply.

records.title: Poor Customer Service
records.text: I placed an on-line order with Pet Prescription and subsequently received an email to say the item was not in stock. It stated I could cancel the order which I immediately requested they do. I needed the item fairly urgently and managed to source elsewhere expecting they would cancel the order as they have indicated but despite a further attempt which they also indicated they have on record to cancel the order the next thing I get is DPD giving a delivery slot. I phoned Pet prescription and they said there was nothing they could do and I would have to pay to get the item returned to them through no fault of my own in order to get a refund!Poor service I’m afraid and there are much better outlets out there in my opinion. Disappointing experience.EDIT: Following eventual follow up on my e-mail strings a much more considered representative made contact and saw the validity of my points made and agreed to arrange collection of the cancelled order. Common sense finally prevailed and for this particular representatives’ due care I am grateful so have upped my rating to reflect this.

records.title: Quite long wait to get through on the…
records.text: Quite long wait to get through on the phone and increasingly slow deliveries although perhaps forgiveable in the run-up to Christmas. They do not appear to process prescriptions quickly on arrival causing big delays in dispatch which is always notified and accurate.

records.title: For reassurance I like to place my…
records.text: For reassurance I like to place my order on the phone and email in the prescription. I think it's great that Pet Prescription allow you to do this when other such sites insist that everything is uploaded and done online (really difficult for those with limited technology). However some of the call handlers can be quite short tempered and rude when doing it this way. The last couple of times, however, have been with polite and helpful people, before that (over 6 months ago) not so good.

records.title: Price brilliant
records.text: Price brilliant, on line not so good tried 3 times in the end had to phone, but then the task became easy and the people I spoke to were brilliant, they were pleasant and very helpful so ln future I will just phone those lovely people without any stress, thank you 😀.

records.title: I sent pet prescription a repeat…
records.text: I sent pet prescription a repeat prescription for 6 months, I had my first prescription in January, when I ordered in February I did not receive my pills until I emailed and rang to ask where my prescription was, it had not been downloaded on the system. I wouldn't of minded so much but my dog should not have a break between pills, so took me a week to get them, considering you pay £2.99 postage this is not good enough.

records.title: I usually have no issues with this…
records.text: I usually have no issues with this company, however with my last order, it seemed that my prescription had expired. Previously if something had stopped the issuing of the prescription, someone from the company, usually Paul, would call or email to advise there was an issue. This did not happen and until I discovered this was the issue I was expecting the medication in the post, so a lessing of the service.

records.title: Slightly confusing on how the…
records.text: Slightly confusing on how the prescription works, says its valid for 6 months but what that means is you can get the medication over 6 months, I ordered some medication but only had 5 tablets left, as my dog has 1.5 tabs a day, instead of the 30 I needed.No communication from Pet Prescription, I waited 4 days then looked on my account to say it was on hold.needs to be a little clearer on how it works.Other than that small glitch I've been very pleased

records.title: Terrible first experience
records.text: Terrible first experience. Will not be using them again. They only sell the tablets in multiples of 100. My prescription was for 90 (3 months) which I’m sure will be more standard than 100 days. Instead of refunding me for having 10 less (90 instead of 100), they charged me removing them, and will then be able to resell the 10 removed, effectively selling them twice.

records.title: Excellent at supplying meds and spam mail
records.text: Excellent at supplying meds, all fantastic A! 5 stars on that front. I now have the once a day nagging spam email about things I might or might not like. I can't understand why these companies can't get it in their head that they lose business by hassling people, I certainly never saw the opt in button as I would have made sure it remained unticked. Not yet registered as spam with Google but will be soon unless there's an improvement, which is a pity.

records.title: Not a good experience this time

I was told it would go 1st class that day , it did NOT arrive next day. By then I had run out and I had to g to the vet and pay full price. So no t as god as my first experience

records.title: Have had good service over the last …

I contacted Pet Prescription to ask if anything could be done to be told NO IF YOU DON'T WANT THEM GIVE THEM TO A CHARITY. At this time both myself and wife thought that this attitude stank. For this reason Im not sure if I would use them EVER AGAIN

records.title: Have previously gone with other website …
records.text: Have previously gone with other website vets scripts but decided with these on this occasion as they were cheapest for meds I wanted. They struggled to make out order as it was one script with 2 repeats making 3 lots of meds altogether but this seemed to throw them (first time this has happened) but they promptly contacted me to sort out which was done but will go with someone else next time to save hassle.

records.title: My own delivery arrived without a …
records.text: My own delivery arrived without a problem. But a delivery for someone else arrived too so we had to sort that out. That went very smoothly and they were very helpful- but that made it a less than ‘great ‘ experience.In response to the reply of Pet Prescription:I am grateful for how efficiently you sorted the problem.My own order experience would otherwise have gained 5 stars!

records.title: Prescription lost in post!!!!
records.text: Unfortunately I waited a while for my item, them e-mailed to ask where it was, they stated they hadn't received my prescription sent 7 days Before I ordered online, luckily I had photocopied prescription before I sent it off so had to scan it via e-mail to them, I am hopeing the prescription may come very soon. This obviously may be the fault of royal mail not pet prescription so I can hardly say it's their fault.

records.title: telephoneing

records.title: Inconsistent
records.text: I have used Pet Prescriptions on 3 occasions ordering a double pack of the same product on each occasion. The prescriptions were also exactly the same. However, on the last order I was told I could not order a double pack as the prescription was not repeatable. I questioned why the position had changed but was not given a logical response. The service had always been great up to this point.

records.title: Took a long time to come.
records.text: Maybe I'm expecting too much but I normally expect animal none prescription type products to arrive by return plus one. This took much longer and I was obliged to buy it over the counter. I also didn't think the packaging was wonderful. Boxes with flea treatment ampules in were crushed and skew wiff. records.title: 12Kg prescription dog food

records.title: Wrong item sent

records.title: A bit disappointing this time
records.text: A bit disappointing this time. I sent a prescription by email and it took a week to process it. We almost ran out of meds. Unusual this, the service is usually tip top

records.title: Dreadful customer service

No reply on calls and recording gives. Different company name to website so disconcerting. I requested a call back to my mobile and was called back on landline which i missed. Hopeless. Still waiting …… Have ordered meds elsewhere now

records.title: Problems placing order
records.text: Having received prescriptions from my Vet by attachments to e mail I simply forwarded to Pet Prescriptions requesting them to send the drugs and contact me with the details provided for payment and delivery instructions. I received an e mail stating that my request was being checked by in house Vets and I should phone to place an order (this I thought I had done by my initial e mail. However tried numerous times to contact by phone without success and waiting endlessly for replies. Nothing except listening to recorded messages about how important my call was to the company and how wonderful their service was. I don’t think so. Eventually after waiting 1 HOUR I eventually got through and finalized the process. A less than good experience I think you would agree.

records.title: Customer relations
records.text: Although our vets sent prescriptions at the same time by E-MAIL for our two dogs medication, one was overlooked which caused us a good deal of anxiety in trying to get the issue resolved as the continued good health of both dogs  is dependant upon this medication being taken daily for the rest of their lives.As this is not the first time that administrative issues have occurred with regardto our orders we are seriously considering taking our custom elsewhere.

records.title: Sent my details to my daughter's…
records.text: Sent my details to my daughter's account by mistake. We live in the same house and have the same surname but my daughter has a cat and I have two dogs. We have separate accounts, emails etc. Data protection was not adhered to..

records.title: Slow despatch and short expiry date

records.title: UNHAPPY My email requesting my dogs meds were…

description: Our nutritionist-designed recipes are freshly cooked in our kitchen from high quality, 100% British meat and delivered directly to your door. With no grains, legumes or cheap fillers, every mouthful is fussy-dog-approved; we guarantee an empty bowl or your money back.

records.title: Mealtimes just got a lot easier …….
records.text: I was getting to the end of my tether with my Westie Hugo.  Mealtimes were starting to get very stressful, always having to make sure that I had fresh beef or chicken in the fridge to go on top of his dry and wet food, even then he would just eat the beef/chicken then go back at night for the rest.  To be fair to him, he is nearly four and it is only this last 3 months where I could tell he was getting even more fed up with it, even though I think I had tried every brand going for him.  Then I came across Different Dog, thought I am going to have to give it ago, was a bit nervous at first wasn’t sure how he he would react to it, omg what a relief, he is now behind me when he hears me in the fridge, his bowl is licked out each mealtime and I feel a lot better knowing each meal is very healthy for him….think sometimes his meal looks healthier than my own….thank you Different Dog so glad I found you.

records.title: Different dog...First class.
records.text: DIFFERENT  DOG.. First class.. my shiz tzu Hugo has suffered with terrible tummy issues and I have finally found different dog has answered my preys.. Cannot fault different dog.. from quality ingredients to sustainable packaging

records.title: Happy dog happy owner
records.text: The food arrived exactly as scheduled. Beautiful eco packaging and much more importantly my dog who was always a fussy eater devoures Different Dog food and asks for more. She also just overcame being very unwell (pancreatitis) and went from not eating to absolutely loving her food. It seems a new world opened up for her. 😀 we are thrilled!

records.title: We have used this product for 3 years
records.text: We have used this product for 3 years. Our dog and now her puppy loves it demonstrably versus other dog food. The logistics associated with ordering and delivery are constantly faultless. Thank you.

records.title: Levi has been on Different Dog for…
records.text: Levi has been on Different Dog for almost 2 weeks now. The transition has gone really smoothly & he absolutely loves the food, to the point of him chasing his bowl around the kitchen floor just in case he’s missed the tiniest morsel!! We have definitely made the right decision!!

records.title: Such an excellent company and so very…
records.text: Such an excellent company and so very easy to use.  My dog loves the recipes which are healthy and varied. The website is just great and what I love is that you can dib in and out of orders, pause orders and re start whenever you are ready. No hassle, no fuss!  if you need to speak on the phone the help is always there.  Frankly, I cant fault them!  The bonus is that my dog enjoys it and I know he is getting a varied and balanced diet!

records.title: Buddy absolutely loves his new menu of…
records.text: Buddy absolutely loves his new menu of good from Different Dog! He finishes every last scrap of every meal - something he has never done! Every time we go to the fridge he looks up in anticipation hoping that he is going to get another tasty treat!!We have struggled for years to find a food that he enjoys, at last we have found it.

records.title: My dog loves Different Dog
records.text: My dog, Hugo is the fussiest dog I’ve ever had. He is 18 months old and until now I’ve failed to provide him with food that he loves, and I’ve tried so many different foods. But from the first bowl of Different Dog he licks it clean every time. Even the kibble (to gradually introduce Different Dog) that he previously turned his nose up at was wolfed down. His tummy has settled down and he now asks for his dinner which he hadn’t done before! I am blown away! It’s such a relief to see him eating normally and to know he’s eating healthily. I’m so glad I found Different Dog. Thank you for taking the stress out of doggy dinner. I definitely recommend Different Dog to all dog owners, especially if you have a dog with a delicate tummy and/or a very fussy dog.

records.title: Meal Times are Enjoyable Again
records.text: Our bulldog Penny loves the meals from Different Dog. In putting together a meal plan, I’ve been surprised at just how much variety there is. I’ve also been really pleased to see meals that contain extra vitamins and minerals to help with sensitive stomachs and maintaining supple joints. The flexibility of changing my plan and adding or removing extra items is really easy to manage. Penny loves the taste and is really excited by meal times again. I would really encourage people (and their dogs of course) to give this a go.

records.title: A very happy switch
records.text: I switched to Different Dog for our lovely rescue Lulu about a month ago and am very pleased with the decision.Lulu is not a fussy eater but she isn’t particularly fond of fruits and veg hence I was curious to see how she’d react to DD which has a wider variety of it. I was happily surprised she loves it and knowing she gets more nutrients supporting her health is great!Her poos are much more consistent now with no more visible legumes, which means she’s actually digesting properly.Well done to the Different Dog team - Lulu is definitely giving it a big “paws up’. 🐾

records.title: Good product but my fussy dog doesn't…
records.text: Good product but my fussy dog doesn't like it, I can only get him to eat it by hand feeding him and pretending to feed dogs on tv (he hates sharing he's food). The other issue is i find there is too much vegetables in the food and my dog started to get very gassy and acid reflux followed by upset tummy and then diarrhoea. I really hoped my dog would love this food and off course be good for him, so it's back to home cooking for him. I'm not saying this is not a good dog food, it is very good but not for my dog, being a Lhasa apso he requires a diet high in meat protein that is moderate in fat. I know 2 dogs that thrive on Different Dog but not mine unfortunately.

records.title: Looks fresh and tasty
records.text: Looks good and tasty. However Freddie seems to be the fussiest cavapoo on the planet. Sometimes he eats it immediately, other times he walks away or he tries to bury it usually with his bedding. Despite this I won’t go back to another brand or cook fresh twice a day. I have never owned a fussy dog, Freddie is gorgeous in every way except mealtimes.

records.title: IF IT AIN'T BROKE
records.text: Having been a customer and fan of DD for almost 3 years I was baffled when my Border Terrier had diarrhea following a meal of the new batch of Stay Supple Fish. At first I didn't make the connection to the food. However, today I called DD to ask if there had been a change to the recipe and there has. Flaxseed oil has been replaced with Coconut oil and the fat content has gone up slightly. It's a great shame because the previous recipe suited his needs perfectly (history of Pancreatitis) and unless the diarhhea settles down I will be left with no choice but to cancel my order. I am awaiting a call from the consultant nutritionist Bianca who I hope will be able to explain why the switch was made. I have learned that some dogs who are prone to pancreatitis cannot tolerate any increase in fat no matter how small with just the slighest increase edging them into an attack.  I thought I'd found the perfect food in Stay Supple Fish but sadly I think those days are coming to an end. All the other recipes in the range use Flax oil which judging by the amount of positive reviews has been an excellent choice with no issues.

records.title: Good, healthy food for dogs
records.text: UPDATE:After having a chat with Charlie and understanding what they're doing to resolve the issue, I'm much happier with the service and understand now where things went wrong and what they're doing to resolve it. My dog does love the food, and hopefully can continue to.-----Disappointing. Multiple times now, our packs of food have been underfilled. Some by nearly 100g on a 600g pack. It's just not ok. Each pack I use I would expect to have no more than a ~15g difference, yet most seem to have a 50g+ more difference, leaving my dog hungry that night where he gets less.But they "live" to make dogs healthier

records.title: This is our first experience with the…
records.text: This is our first experience with the fresh food and my dogs love it. The only reason why I am giving 4 stars is that one of my dog's eyes got dirtier since we moved to DD I have never fed them low-quality food and they were a long time on the super premium food which is anyway meant to be lower quality than the fresh so I hope I did a better choice for them

records.title: Excited for dinner time!
records.text: We have two dogs, one will eat anything but is a chunky monkey and the other has multiple health conditions and wouldn't eat. She is now eating every meal and it's amazing to see her enjoying her dinners and getting excited for meal times! She is very underweight so looking forward to seeing some weigh gain and hopefully losses for the other pooch. I would say to make sure the website is up to date as we ordered food that then arrived different because it was out of stock. With health conditions etc we pick certain meals for this reason. records.title: 3.5 marks from me, to be honest..
records.text: I am probably around the 3.5 mark for an honest review, but good points, the food looks and smells good and its easy to serve up. Two of my dogs prefer it to RAW, which is what my other three dogs eat. We have had these two of our five on DD for some time now and had to switch them from a premium raw food.   However, we are having to feed more of DD, to keep them up to a slim, healthy weight as I believe there are simply too many vegetables bulking out the recipe.  I am curious as to why there is so much cabbage topped up with other vegetables, such as Parsnips, Cauliflower and Swede, carrots, which make up approx. 26% of your recipes? This I believe is over the recommended guidelines (25% max) of how much vegetable a dog should eat, with the advise that 10% is more than ample in dog foods.  So I am curious (and a little concerned) that I might be feeding too many unnecessary vegetables and not feeding enough meat (less than 60% in your recipes) Both of mine are very active and of working breeds. I am questioning whether this diet will sustain them long term.  This is an expensive food, which unfortunately, loses some points from us, because of the high vegetable content, but feel that 'you're on to something, just not quite there yet'. I'm relieved that there is a fresh food cooked company that doesn't use legumes, Pea starch, Tapioca and beet pulp, but feel it would be more nutritional if meat protein was increased and or egg/cartilage for example were used instead.  Having said that it would most likely make it unaffordable to most consumers, if more premium ingredients were used instead and its already expensive as it is. Shame really, as I do think this is a good alternative, but imo, there is room for improvement.

records.title: AMAZING!!!!!
records.text: Our very fussy little Shih Tzu Bella is loving the food provided by Different Dog!We have tried lots of different types of food and also another company which to begin with she enjoyed eating, but then quickly turned her nose up at it.She has been happily eating the meals provided for over a month now ftom Different Dog.Tbe large variety of food offered is brilliant and keeps Bella from becoming bored.The only thing that could be better for us is that the food in the large containers could do with being cut up into 8 cubes before being frozen.Our tiny dog only has a little tummy and because of her fussiness we like to give her a different flavour at each meal time so that she doesn't become fed up. We have broken our electric knife trying to cut the food up into 8 cubes per box and really struggle to saw through even with a good sharp knife.We put the frozen cubes in to small tupperware pots the evening before and defrost the meals in the fridge.The bone broth is amazing and this is a must for our fussy little lady! She LOVES it!The tear and train pork and beef are also a really big hit as well as the chicken Chews which she adores.We have to break the chicken chews up into tiny crumbs for her as she unfortunately chewed a piece off that was too big and sharp and choked on it. Luckily I did a sweep with my finger inside her mouth and retrieved the piece. Chew sticks are generally better for Shih Tzus due to how tiny they are. Bella really loves the chicken chews so we continue to buy this for her.The company are very polite and friendly and we recieved a lovely personal Welcome phone call from them which really is a great touch!Thank goodness I have found Different Dog!

If there are courier issues, which the company clearly knows about, use a different courier, or send it a day earlier so I don’t run out of food. Or, simply keep customers updated in advance. records.title: Large chunks of fat
records.text: I genuinely thought I'd found the quality of food I was looking for, and my dogs seem to really enjoy it. My only problem however is the large chunks of fat that have recently featured in some of the meals (mainly Hearty Beef & Berries & Lamb Hotpot). I need to point out that these chunks of fat have been a recent thing - whilst there has always been some smaller pieces of fat in the meals (which I know is important for a balanced diet), these chunks of fat have been quite large and have been a feature of my last 2 deliveries. I reached out to Different Dog but in all honesty, I wasn't satisfied with their response. They told me that dogs are not like humans and don't eat with their eyes, that fat is important for their diet (which I wasn't disputing) and that I should feed them the chunks of fat as they are. I even sent photos to show them that these weren't small pieces, but I was told to feed them or warm them up so I couldn't see them. I don't feel comfortable in feeding big pieces of fat, and since the food has not always been like this I questioned whether they had changed ingredients, which I was told no. I'm not sure how many people would feel comfortable feeding chunks of fat either, I feel like I wasn't heard tbh when I contacted them and when you are paying a premium for quality, I don't expect that.

This was the just of the response. Absolutely gutted as I like this company they're easy to deal with & Daisy who it a faddy eater likes the food. I don't subscribe but do order regular probably each month & I spend a lot of money...very loyal to the product & have recommended to many friends prior to the excess fat issue who are all subscribers...I'm an animal rescuer & I've consistently told all of my animal friends how great the food is. My point is I've been having diff dog for some time at least a year maybe more & this never used to happen...seriously its a recent thing of the last few months...As your customer care person said of course you expect to have some fat in meat especially those Daisy prefers...However not this much...I've literally just photographed a piece of fat about an inch in diameter along with several other big chunks. This is unacceptable. As is your response. I hate complaining but this is wrong...Daisy's a small dog who cannot digest this level of fat nor should she...So I'm picking it out for her...Again this is recent never had this issue before & I see someone else has. I will say it doesn't happen all of the time but I'd say at least in 10 out of 30 meals it's now happening. I don't want to stop buying diff dog as Daisy loves it...I want the responsible considerate response & the issue to be addressed by you otherwise I will have to. description:
We offer 100% natural dog chews & treats!

We are careful and very conscious when it comes to sourcing our products.

Our dogs are part of our family. We know they deserve nothing less than the best. But in reality, most dog chews and treats have big marketing budgets but inferior quality. Also, most dog chews & treats advertise as "natural", but they come from Asia with uncertain, unknown and often harmful ingredients, produced under poor environmental and labour standards and cost a lot. Commercially available chews left a lot to desire. Eventually, after much trial and error, we realised that fresh and natural treats worked best for dogs.
We don't like eating junk food, so why should things be different for our four-legged family members? Our chews & treats are suitable for dogs with sensitive tummies. Many commercial dog chews & treats do not suit many dogs, so we researched the different types of chews and treats. Our sourcing products are either UK or EU-produced. We visit our suppliers and talk to them regularly to ensure that our products are 100% natural, with no added additives, chemicals, or flavourings. Also, these companies follow EU laws regarding animal welfare.
Today, we are proud to offer an exciting line of dog chews and treats made from a single or limited ingredient, 100% natural and as nutritious as delicious. 100% satisfaction guaranteed.

Let your Dog be a Dog. Unlock his natural instincts the healthy way!

description: Local, Independent, 24 hours companion animal veterinary surgery in Denny (Near Falkirk,) Scotland. Dedicated to the health and wellbeing of your pet. 24 hour emergency service is available.  Where your pet is part of our family.

records.title: Greeted with a friendly smile
records.text: Greeted with a friendly smile, id have to say walking into Apex vets feels like a second home. I say this on how I feel, but of course for some of my visits it’s a sad time as animals are sick. But I’ve always had the best advice, my questions answered. I’ve also loved the fact that they respect my knowledge of my animals, I truly believe they go above and beyond for their clients animal and human.

records.title: As always myself and my dog were…
records.text: As always myself and my dog were treated with total respect and compassion on our latest visit.Our vet Glenn taking the time to help my dog to relax and discuss all aspects of her treatment  plan and listening to my concerns and questions while genuinely taking great interest in  how my girl is doing. The nursing and desk team are equally as considerate. Great practice!

records.title: Amber is 8 and we have used Apex since…
records.text: Amber is 8 and we have used Apex since moving back here 7 years ago. Their staff and the service they provide have always been excellent for both big matters and small. Always recommending them to others.  Like the fact that out of hours is with her own vets and that our dog walker uses them too.

records.title: Initial VET appointment
records.text: Care and confidence of the Vet. This was our first visit to the practice.  The Vet had read up our dog’s notes from the previous vet and was very thorough with her examination.  The reception staff were very helpful and friendly.

records.title: As always I can’t rate Apex Vets…
records.text: As always I can’t rate Apex Vets enough. From my present pets Ollie and Sophie right back to when we had Jemma and Jorja the staff and in particular, Glenn has been a big part in all their care. Nothing is too much for the staff and vets to make life a bit easier for you. When my Jack Russell, Jorja passed away in August at the age of 16 yrs, the reception staff were so caring and understanding. Today I was down with Ollie to see Glenn and as always, Ollie received first class care. He tends to be nervous when he’s there but Lorraine offered us the quiet waiting area which helped. Great service and quality staff. Thanks as always Apex.

records.title: Above and Beyond Exceptional 🤩
records.text: My little Cat Daisy is currently healing from a spinal injury. Everyone at Apex vets are being so professional and supportive. Going above and beyond in her ongoing needs and care. I’ve never had a vets that’s so caring. Can’t thank you all enough 🥰

records.title: Sophie Sophie is recovering from her…
records.text: Sophie Sophie is recovering from her operation and is doing well. She has started her physiotherapy. The vets are very helpful and explain everything to us. The nurses are amazing and showed us both how to do physiotherapy on Sophie's leg so that it will strengthen.😊

records.title: Sophie underwent her surgical procedure…
records.text: Sophie underwent her surgical procedure on September 30, 2024. The surgery was a success, but she will need some time to fully recover. We have always trusted Apexvets with Sophie's care, and they have consistently shown their expertise and compassion. Sophie, now six years old, has been under their care since she was a puppy.The staff at Apexvets is exceptionally caring and goes above and beyond to ensure our comfort and peace of mind. The surgeon took the time to thoroughly explain every aspect of the procedure, which greatly alleviated our concerns. We appreciate everything you have done for Sophie. Thank you very much. 😊❤️🐾🐾🐕

records.title: Outstanding care from all staff for pets and their humans
records.text: I have two cats both very different personalities. Both have been treated by apex and both have received outstanding care. One is more temperamental for a nice way of putting it from being scared rather than nasty. The other is so placid. He has most recently had to be in overnight and all staff went above and beyond to help him and reassure me. He is still being treated but now as a day visitor and again great service. Thoroughly recommend. Would hate to think how I would of coped knowing I would have to take him further afield when he needed out of hours care. The personal touch of what's app pics and updates during his stay also helped.

records.title: Phoned for an emergency appointment
records.text: Phoned for an emergency appointment. Receptionist professional, efficient at taking a history and friendly. Appointed same day with clear advice on what to do if any concerns inbetween times. I moved to this Practice insummer as unhappy with previous vet overall plus outsourcing on-call. Staff and systems  in place (appointments, ordering drugs et ) Excellent and vets lovely.  Fabulous shop and spacious clean waiting area with separate cat area and entrance for nervous:aggressive dogs.  Very impressed I have to say.

records.title: Required an emergency appointment which…
records.text: Required an emergency appointment which was allocated within the hour. Receptionist and vet very friendly and helpful. Had to leave my dog for sedation to look at and dress a broken claw which was bleeding profusely. Clear instructions given to us when we collected our pet and further check up booked. Only gave 4 stars as like most people finding vet costs very expensive!!

records.title: Claire is fantastic
records.text: My dog is nervous due to past traumatic experiences at another vet clinic. Apex has been amazing for the most part.  Claire is spectacular with my dog, she takes the time to fuss over her and reassure her that it’s not a scary place and her confidence is building slowly but surely. This was set back previously by one of the other vets in this practice who didn’t explain anything to me and shoved a muzzle on my very anxious dog with no prior warning when she was hiding in the corner of the room. My dog got so distressed that her nose started bleeding with the muzzle on and I had to take it off. I do appreciate any dog under distress could be a cause for concern for a vet but the way this was previously handled was completely unacceptable and set her back again, this vet didn’t seem to care. Unsure if it was because of her breed or if there was another issue at the time. If it had been explained to me that a muzzle would be recommended then I would have put it on her myself with great care and not shove it on her face with force when she’s trembling in the corner with fear. I would now only go to Claire as she is so calm and good with my dog that we’re building up trust again (not.a muzzle in sight!) Overall knowing I will never make an appointment with the other vet I am very happy with the care provided. Reception staff are welcoming and friendly both on the phone and face to face.

records.title: Today was the first time I am…
records.text: Today was the first time I am disappointed with my visit. First time I'm leaving a review.I feel that apex has lost its personal touch with its rapid expansion.You are asked to make appointment and I've found I not seen during the time booked and kept waiting for considerable amount of time. No apologies are given, which is the opposite if you are late. I am told you cannot hold the appointment and I would have to wait and I am the one that apologies.  Can you see the irony in that.Today, I was kept awaiting again, no apology or explanation given. I was there for annual booster jabs.I felt that vet did not give one dog particular once over and inspection but was more thorough with the other. For the first time when been given the injection, one of my dogs yelped in pain. Was told that serum was cold. I am sorry, but I do not accept the explanation given, as the many visits to this surgery my dogs have never done this with any other vet.When settling the bill, you are no longer given the option to have itemised statement just a receipt. When I checked when statement sent, it still had outstanding balance(this is another issue, as one of my dogs had mass removed in may, I explained to vet my financial situation and that my insurance would be running out in July and I was assured the paperwork would be rushed through,it wasnt; it was sent in September and now anxious time waiting to see if the bill will be settled) plus treatment I did not ask for. I contacted vets to query and mistake was noted as there was even a note from vet saying I declined kennel cough treatment. Yet the vet charged me for both dogs. I was assured I would receive a call back with a resolution.I waited over 30 mins and called myself and i get the impression the person who took the initial inquiry had not done anything and was told conviently that they were just about to call me back when i called. I eventually  sorted the refund and it was processed over the phone. If I hadn't checked then I would be none the wiser!So I go back to opening statement, I feel with the vets rapid expansion they have lost the personal touch and attention to detail.

records.title: Poor service
records.text: Waited for 40 minutes before my dog was seen. My dog gets very stressed visiting the vets and was later in the evening before she calmed down. If they were running that late they could have called me & I could have delayed my visit.

records.title: Beware - owners’ opinions not welcome!
records.text: My dog was in the practice to receive his vaccination for the year. He also had an ear check and the vet found they were a little swollen so prescribed anti inflammatory medication ear drops. My dog was quite distressed when in the vet consultation room and the vet did not demonstrate to me how to put the ear drops in (if she would have done so I would have recognised that my dog would not have allowed me to put them in).Once I got home, I tried to administer and my dog became very distressed, would not allow me to administer. I persevered and kept trying for two days, tried two of us, tried a different person trying to administer but still he was quite distressed.I phoned Apex on the Saturday and asked if I could bring the ear drops back in exchange for another treatment. The nurse on the phone told me I should bring my dog in for a demonstration on how to put the ear drops in, I explained I did not require a demonstration as I knew how to administer, the problem was that my dog did not want me to administer them.I asked to simply swap for another alternative treatment. I explained he had just been seen by the vet. The nurse told me she could not offer this unless I brought my dog in and paid for a consultation and alternative treatment - I had just been in the practice two days prior and paid for treatment which if the vet would have tried to put in my dogs ear, she would have known my dog would not tolerate. Dissatisfied, I felt the practice were just trying to make money from me and felt very uneasy about the situation so put the phone down and went back to trying another method of putting my dogs ear drops in. Luckily, a distraction technique worked (for anyone struggling- try to administer whilst your dog is waiting at the door to go out for a walk/to the garden).My dog is seen nearly every two months to have his glands emptied, we are always straight on the phone to the vet if anything is wrong, we are probably on the phone to the vets a little too much! But want to make sure he is looked after as he is like our child! We would pay for anything he needed - but we felt we were being taken advantage of in this case.My faith was shattered in the practice from then on - at the beginning I thought I had found a genuinely great practice but unfortunately, the owner shattered it even more on the Monday following my phone call with the nurse.On Monday, I found an email in my inbox from the owner asking me to call him to speak about his concerns which the nurse had escalated to him. The owner had asked me to work with him to “better understand each other” and “take feedback”.So, I sent a very detailed email allowing him my feedback on what I though was handled wrongly, what I thought could have been said better, even giving my opinion on what the nurse could have said on the phone.I felt that the nurse was very condescending on the phone and let the owner know this on my emails. He let me know that he had worked with the nurse in question for over 11 years and he had never heard her being condescending over the phone. This may be the case, however, to basically make out like I am lying about her sounding condescending is very unprofessional and I really did not appreciate this from the owner.He let me know that if I had spoken with him on the Saturday, he would have waived the fee. However, the nurse never mentioned any of this on the phone.I ended my emails by asking why, if they had known and worked with one another for 11 years, had the nurse not offered to exchange my dogs ear drops for an alternative - waiving the fee?For asking this question, and offering my feedback - which the owner did ask for on several occasions - my dog was banned from the practice.In all my years of being a pet owner, in fact in all my years of dealing with ANY business at all I have NEVER experienced bad customer service like it.So, BEWARE, if you feel strongly about anything, or have an opinion… be careful you may be banned from the practice for sharing it.

description:
Collared Creatures was born out of a passion of all things dog. We make a full range of beautiful and simply styled, luxury handmade dog accessories for the home and outdoors.

We started our business way back in 2014, it grew from wanting to find beautiful dog collars for our dogs, that was practical and hardwearing but didn’t compromise on style – we really struggled, so we decided to make our own collars.

One passion led to another and before we knew it our family, friends, and the local neighbourhood started to ask us if we could make collars and leads for them too – and before long, we were making our first ever Dog Cave Bed and very own Dog Drying Coats!

Eight years on, we’re proud to have expanded, to offer a full range of beautiful and simply styled, luxury handmade dog accessories for the home and outdoors.

We offer doting dog lovers an exclusive range: Luxury Dog Beds, Luxury Blankets and Sofa Throws, stunning Dog Collars & Leads, and Practical Dog Drying Coats.

We delighted to have also launched our own bespoke Signature Collections of different styled Dog Collars and Leads.

Collared Creatures are a small and family run, independent British Business.

Our business is all about ‘Nurturing Love’, making products that create special moments for you and your dog and helping you build that amazing dog and owner bond.

We take the time to source the finest quality materials and constantly perfect our product designs to deliver real comfort, ideal fit and practicality – giving you dog accessories that keep your dog feeling warm, safe and utterly loved.

At collared creatures our mission is to provide fellow dog lovers with the finest range of beautiful products for your pooches! We have a great selection of beds to make sure your furry companions feel safe, cosy & warm. We also have a large selection of exquisite hand crafted collars & leads.

We’re inspired every day, by designing beautiful and gorgeous dog accessories for you and your dog to enjoy in the home and wear on outdoor adventures.

Following our passion for dogs and doing what we truly love makes every day special for us.

We understand dogs and how delighted owners are when they see their dogs having a soft and cosy bed to rest and relax in, collars that make feel safe and dog drying coats that get their dog dry, warmed up quickly and feeling cosy.

Like you, we cherish the strong bond that we have with our dogs and love nothing more than to create those special moments for you to share with you dog too.

Take a look at our collections of luxury handmade dog collars and leads, cosy and warm dog beds, our luxuriously soft dog blankets and our perfectly practical dog clothing.

Would order from again would just appreciate more communication next time :)

description: We prioritise the health and happiness of your pet. Our specially designed pet health plans are aimed at providing preventative healthcare for your pets. description:
Find An Emergency Vet
Pet Care Advice
Customer Hub



About Vets Now 


Pet emergencies can happen at any time – including when your regular vet is closed.
That’s why our nationwide network of out-of-hours pet emergency clinics are open through the night, at weekends and on bank holidays, so we’re ready and waiting to provide expert pet emergency care when your regular vet is having some time off.

Our pet emergency clinics are the pet equivalent of A&E and our purpose is to give you and your pet the care and support you deserve, at the time you need it most, whether it’s four in the morning or in the middle of Sunday lunch.
Vets Now provides this trusted service to more than 1000 veterinary practices across the UK — from over 60 dedicated out-of-hours clinics and two 24/7 pet emergency hospitals. In total, we treat around 200,000 small animals every year — our highly-skilled team works hard throughout the night, weekends and Bank Holidays. So whether you’re in Aberdeen, Belfast or Portsmouth we’re there for you and your pet when you need us most.
We’ve also pioneered other ways to help pets, pet owners and the veterinary profession, such as our comprehensive referrals service and providing our staff with industry-leading training and development opportunities. We also support the pet blood transfusion charity, Pet Blood Bank UK. Meanwhile, our two hospitals — in Glasgow and Manchester — are home to some of the UK’s leading specialists in the field of emergency and critical care and provide care 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
