Their support was very much appreciated to a worried pet parent on Christmas Day. Thank you.

records.title: The vets were very caring and…
records.text: The vets were very caring and understanding about my dog’s welfare, and the service was absolutely outstanding. The team at Witham were excellent and I can’t thank them enough for helping to make my dog well again.

records.title: Fantastic Christmas Eve  Team
records.text: Cannot thank the team  enough especially Gorka, Bex  and Debbie who went over and above  caring for us and our beautiful boy on Christmas Eve night.Unfortunately he had to be euthanised but the service we received was exceptional. People complain about the cost but we  couldn't see him in pain and he went down hill fast and  we accepted that to help  him we needed to pay. We know what working in this sevice is like first hand. Been there, done it! Many thanks again. Keep up ,the fantastic work. Millington Family

records.title: Staff were professional
records.text: Staff were professional, helpful and guided us well throughout. Regular updates provided throughout and all options discussed and covered ensuring our pooch could come home for Christmas despite having major surgery. Super speedy and efficient. From us arriving at the vets, problem diagnosed, operated on and back home despite feeling sorry for himself in less than 24 hours! Guided us through insurance process having never needed it before. Felt pooch was in safe hands

records.title: There when you need them
records.text: There when you need them.  Needed emergent-help on Xmas morning after our poodle found and ate an oat cookie with raisins in. Vets now ere brilliant! They arranged for us to be with a vet within minutes. The whole team are so polite and pleasant and reassuring- can’t thank everyone there enough - huge virtual hug to everyone 😀

records.title: Forever grateful!
records.text: My dog became very ill (gastroenteritis) over Christmas and they saw her straight away and started giving her the care she needed. The vets/nurses involved with her care were all kind, knowledgable and reassuring at such a worrying time. She was able to come home Christmas Day to be with us. She is now doing well & making a full recovery. I can not thank them enough for taking such good care of her & for this amazing service being available.

records.title: Excellent Emergency Veterinary care
records.text: My dog became acutely unwell one evening and I didn’t want to risk leaving it til morning for our usual vets to see her. I arranged to take her to Vets Now Coventry, who were very busy when we arrived however we were seen within an hour, she was admitted for X-rays and supportive treatment. Luckily she didn’t need surgery and I was able to collect her a few hours later for follow up by our own vets. My dog is a rescue, and a nervous girl who gets quite stressed in kennels. They were very patient with her and I felt very confident she was receiving excellent care. She’s now much improved and feeling much better. Thank you so much.

records.title: Very helpful
records.text: Had to call at 3am Xmas morning ! - was given advice and directions by text - I was seen straight away by a friendly vet at a very early hour and I was given all the options and the cost bandings - my cat was looked after for the day and felt reassured that she was in safe hands and discharged as soon as she was feeling better.

records.title: Saved my dogs life on christmas day
records.text: I brought my dog in on Christmas Day after he managed to eat a dangerous amount of chocolate. Everyone was amazing and we left an hour later with a healthy dog after they gave him treatment. They saved his life on Christmas day and I am beyond grateful and thankful for everything they did for him.

records.title: Above & Beyond — thank you so much.
records.text: We cannot fault the care of the staff & we are incredibly grateful that they had sacrificed their Christmas Day to help families like ours; our dog is doing really well & I don’t know what we would have done if there hadn’t been any vets available on Christmas Day. They were kind & understanding, & very empathetic to us & the other people we saw there that day. I don’t have the words to explain how grateful we are.We’ve left one star off simply because of the high cost of the consultancy fee — her actual treatment was a fair price but the people in charge of the company must make a fortune on out-of-hour appointments & I doubt much of it actually goes to the staff who sacrifice their time; if all the money went to the people on the frontline we wouldn’t mind but it doesn’t & that’s not right. Give the staff a payrise.

records.title: Mia the vet ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
records.text: Mia the vet made me so reassured very quickly in a stressful situation. She explained everything really well. She answered all questions calmly, professionally and seems like a lovely lady. The receptionist was also very friendly. My dog was treated so quickly. The only reason I knock a star off is the cost!! It is extremely expensive but as to be expected with emergency vet consultations unfortunately.

records.title: Great walk in.
records.text: We were seen by ira she was absolutely amazingThe nurse prior unfortunately did not seem to be very aware of our kittens condition with how dehydrated he was but we were very glad the vet picked up on this.Would definitely go again to walnutree in an emergency.

records.title: The staff are fantastic ,service and…
records.text: The staff are fantastic ,service and help great. We felt put at ease. The only downside is the massive expense.

records.title: They where very supportive of ourselves…
records.text: They where very supportive of ourselves and our dog under the awful circumstances we where in.

records.title: Very good vet
records.text: Very good vet, she spent time examining our pet and reassured us. I would have given Vet Now 5 stars if the visit wasn’t so expensive. I know it was a Sunday morning but over £300.00 for a 15 minute consultation seems a lot of money.

records.title: Good but not that good
records.text: The vet was fantastic she gave my up a good exam. Payment was mental £300 just to be seen out of hours plus the £148 for drugs and what ever else. Stung with an admin fee for insurance claim. Had to ask for my invoice to be sent overas it wasn't sent as promised. Given a leaflet about claiming on insurance which contradicts what reception said and I feell I should have only had to pay my excess rather than full whack but was told I had to pay then claim.will I use this service again not if I can help it

records.title: Good care at eye watering prices
records.text: I can't fault the vets themselves - they were amazing. However since Vets Now have taken over the out of hours service at this hospital (which I have been registered at for years) the cost of an out of hours consultation has skyrocketed. Minimum now £325 before anything else added in, which is 5-6 times the day consultation rate.

records.title: First visit
records.text: From initial call into Vets Now the staff were all very calm and considerate.  At the hospital it has a beautiful, clean and spacious waiting area. The vet explained everything very well. Again all staff very helpful and kind.  Just a rather expensive consultation fee.

records.title: They were very friendly and short…
records.text: They were very friendly and short waiting times yet INCREDIBLY expensive (over £300 simply for the consultation appointment itself, I never ever had to pay THIS much for ANY out of hours nightly/weekend emergency). The given treatment didn't work (made it worse unfortunately). But we managed to take care! Appreciate that they didn't try to do lots of upsells like our local vet would. Thank you.

records.title: From calling to getting my pet seen was…
records.text: From calling to getting my pet seen was very quick, the orices are a bit high even though i had insurance, i was quite happy with the service

records.title: The Vet Reese was compassionate and thorough
records.text: The Vet Reese was compassionate and thorough, he informed us that following the Pit Bull Terrier attack, there was neurological problems affecting Honeys rear legs and made her incontinent. She was to be referred to the Anderson Moores specialist vet at Winchester.   Apologising for not having a driver available could we drive her there? They made bed of blankets and incontinence pads to keep her comfortable for the journey. Sadly their kindness did not save her. She went to heavenly sleep later that evening

records.title: As above
records.text: I cannot give you a top rating because your fees are obscene and I mean that. Your staff are helpful and caring but I really think you are exploiting the Insurance Companies via the clients who ultimately pay . Your pharmacy charges border on criminal when compared to market charges and you appear all too eager to prescribe on undiagnosed issues. Call me if you want to discuss further. Fees aside, a good service

records.title: Telephone advisor out of hours call
records.text: I phoned the phone number for some advice to see if if could wait for the morning, the telephone advisor said I need to take my dog to the vets straight away. When I got to the vets, I was sent back home with my dog and on reflection it could have waited until the morning.I spent near £400 and most of that was on the emergency vet fee which feels like a lot of money for something that could have waited.I felt under pressure as the telephone advisor told me I must take my dog straight away so I followed her advice. The main thing is my dog is doing well but I do think I was made to go immediately so they could get more money out of me as a company.

records.title: Good service in an emergency on a Sunday
records.text: It was a fairly good experience as they fitted us in at short notice on a Sunday and the vet was pretty thorough in examining our new puppy..£350 quid though. But I'm not sure I need the vets to work as an intermediary between me and my insurance company. Why don't they just give customers a copy of the invoice....job done....instead of fill this form out do this don't do this, it was all pretty confusing....I filled a claim out in my account on the Manypets website and the money was in my account the next day.

records.title: Veterinary care is excellent at a cost. But some reservations
records.text: I can find no fault with the veterinary care my dog received as the vet effectively saved his life by operating on the stomach torsion he had suddenly suffered from. I appreciate that you are running a business but I found the mercenary nature that you take rather off putting. When people are obviously upset and making life and death decisions about their pets to then have to cope with the companies demand for 50% of the cost of the operation, (in this case £2000) at 1 o'clock in the morning prior to the operation taking place, only adds to the stress. While I could cope with the cost I dread to think what would happen if someone could not.

records.title: The out of hours service was excellent
records.text: The vet was clearThe nurse was kind The overall experience was positive For me personally, it was a regrettable loss of almost £500 because I had thought my dog had eaten a painkiller. 💊 The next day I discovered he hadn’t.The service was great but I feel ridiculous (my bad)——- ADDEDI don’t neee a FINANCIAL breakdown because I can read my invoice What might be worth considering In a busy night time service with many calls - asking a customer who has serious anxiety issues and states them “Are you absolutely certain he ate the pill? Do you want to check in the room?”By the time Mr Google and the call was made… the customer was in full on “let’s sort this” mode. Nothing done badly but maybe better MH awareness training for the next customer?

records.title: Nursing staff very helpful and kind.
records.text: Nursing staff very helpful and kind.Stressful when you first arrive. Very busy, limited seating, you are left to wait not knowing when you will be seen.Poorly sign posted and could do with some lighting at night time. Vet was quite rude and dismissive. I understand they were busy, a little more customer service would be appreciated!

records.title: Emergency visit
records.text: On our emergency visit to Vets Now, The receptionist kindly greeted us & asked us to take a seat in the waiting area. After an hour, the vet took our dog done the relivent checks on her to find out what was causing her to stop drinking and eating. The vet  gave her some medication to make her feel better. She even opened a tin of dog food to get our dog eating again, which I think was very good of the vet. The 2 women on the desk were very nice and helpful.

records.title: I was not happy to have to pay £320…
records.text: I was not happy to have to pay £320 just for the privilege of walking through the door at our own vet practice. I expect to pay for an emergency visit, but your prices are completely exuberant  and un̈eccesary. If I had a choice  I would never use your service again

records.title: Good service
records.text: Unfortunately had to take our dog on Christmas eve as he had eaten a mince pie. Fantastic service from all the staff. Only negative was the price. I understand the vet fees on a holiday but the bill of over £500 seems a little steep!!

records.title: Altho the vets were good
records.text: Altho the vets were good , they are constantly sending us bill reminders , we paid our bill £1350.71 , two weeks ago ! Stop upsetting us more Pls

records.title: Cost
records.text: I understand it’s an emergency vet centre but the cost just to walk in the door is extortionate

records.title: When we called the out of hours vet via…
records.text: When we called the out of hours vet via our regular vet number  we were told it would be  £327 to get an appointment. When we arrived with our 7 month old puppy the receptionist was vaping in the door way. Once we were inside and sat in the waiting area the floor was covered in blood stains which I mentioned to the receptionist which she then cleaned. We were seen within 20 minutes and the  young vet was amazing. I'm still struggling to understand the  invoice tho. £327 for an appointment which includes a full examination,  then the vet advised on an injection to relieve the sickness which they charged another £100. All of this in less than 10 minutes. Shocked.

records.title: We waited more than 2 hours to be seen…
records.text: We waited more than 2 hours to be seen with a very poorly cat. I requested a blood test but the vet wasn't keen to do one, so suggested I call the Croydon PDSA when they were open. She examined our cat and gave her an anti sickness injection. The staff on reception were very good at keeping us informed but it was a long wait as they only had one Vet and one nurse on duty. I was glad that we were eventually seen. Thank you.

records.title: It is a truly shocking amount of money…
records.text: It is a truly shocking amount of money to pay for a consultation and for reasons I didn't find out, your pet is taken away and treated out of sight which I found confusing. My regular vet will dispense vaccinations in front of me allowing me to help calm my dog. I found myself wondering what was being done.. and worried!

records.title: Your costs are much to high considering…
records.text: Your costs are much to high considering what you actually offer in the way of treatment.

records.title: Patronising and abrupt vet!
records.text: I've given three stars on the basis that our dog was seen very promptly and the receptionist was lovely.  We took our dog to the vet following her first seizure so to say we were worried is an understatement,The vet we saw had a very abrupt almost uncaring attitude and seemed more interested in showing us harnesses that she thought we should buy from a website/company we'd never heard of.  She also made quite a big issue about our dog being overweight and said she needed to lose a kg which then went to 1.5kg and then said "if people say she's skinny she's the right weight".Had she been going for a regular check up then I probably wouldn't have minded but when you are paying £350,  I don't expect to hear things like "that's an awful harness - mind you,  you aren't to know".To be clear my dog spends a lot of time in and out of the vets as she receives immunotherapy,  so is regularly weighed and has been wearning the same harness for two years.  At no point has any vet ever said she needs to lose weight,  nor have they ever commented about her harness.Maybe it's me but when I see a vet for my dogs I want to feel that they genuinely care for animals.  This vet didn't give me that impression at all and seemed more interested in making unhelpful comments,  completely unrelated to the purpose of our visit.

records.title: Both vets my cat seen where amazing
records.text: Both vets my cat seen where amazing. She had to spend the night so staff changed over. Wish I could say the same for the receptionist who checked us in.  Made me feel really stupid. Spoke to me like a child.

records.title: My dog was treated very well
records.text: My dog was treated very well, but the £345 bill for walking through the door is far too expensive for me. As a result, I have changed vets to one who doesn't use this service.

records.title: Expensive for the service as this is a…
records.text: Expensive for the service as this is a PDSA vets being charged extortionate amount to be seen as it’s also used as a out of hours vets

records.title: Staff were lovely courteous and helpful…
records.text: Staff were lovely courteous and helpful and provided treatment for my dog . However extremely dissatisfied with high out of hours consultation fee for out of hours appointment.  I’m sure this is a barrier for many people seeking urgent treatment for their pets resulting in the animal suffering. I’m aware that getting staff to cover out of hours can be challenging but this charge is extremely high when staff are already in building, I’m also very aware how much vets can charge for a single overtime shift which frankly is obscene when profit is put first . Whilst I value vets expertise and I’m sure many also morally struggle with this charging policy ,there must be a better way to run this franchise without extreme overheads passed to customers which ultimately has an effect on them seeking treatment for pets

records.title: Good Treatment but Insurance Claim Process Slow
records.text: Cannot fault this vet service for the treatmentent of my pet Hugo. They were brilliant ,however,the insurance claim procedure is disappointingly slow. It is far quicker to submit your claim yourself as my claim still hasnt been submitted 5 days later. I was told that it would be quicker for them to do this on my behalf . This is why I have adjusted my star rating .As the costs were over £1000 it's alot of money to be out of pocket .

records.title: What you'd expect from an emergency vets
records.text: We were seen to as soon as we walked through the door. However,lack of communication after handing over our dog with no explanation of why we didn't see her for a whole hour or any option of being with her. Bleak ,dated waiting room. Very depressing wait.The veterinary surgeon was lovely though.

records.title: Horrendous out of hours charges
records.text: The cost of attending out of hours is horrendous, cost £288 for consultation, £341 altogether and I left with a tiny tube of diazepam. Don’t know what the hell people without insurance do? Then talking of insurance £25 of the £341 was for admin charges to tend to my insurance! 😡 how can they justify charging these prices? God help the sick animals 😢 the only reason I gave 3 stars was for the lovely vet who looked at my dog.

records.title: Operates like an NHS Hospital where you…
records.text: Operates like an NHS Hospital where you are triaged and can wait 4-6 hours for your pet to be seen but with a hefty price tag at the end. Would seem more of a private service if you were given an estimated appointment time to attend, obviously emergencies would come in and you may have to wait a little longer but I think most pet owners would be understanding about that.

records.title: Mixed feelings
records.text: Service was great, very speedy and easily accessible but, the bandage wrap just fell off my Dog after we’d been home for a few hours. So we paid the emergency out of hours Vet fee of nearly £300 plus treatment costs totalling over £400 for the bandage to need to be redone anyway.

records.title: Out of hours medicla care
records.text: Out of hours medicla care Really long wait time with no updates as to how long it was going to take to be seen. The receptionist was rude and unhelpful when sorting out the insurance and made me feel uncomfortable after a stressful day. The vets however were fantastic and did everything they could to make us feel at ease and treated my pet with excellent care!

records.title: Great support but extortionate fees.
records.text: Vet and nurse were very helpful and sorted our dog out very well.The initial fee was, however, extortionate - how many animals do not get the treatment they need because people cannot afford £309 to walk through the door.

records.title: They will try to rip you off if they can.
records.text: Vet was more interested in making as much money as possible than to actually advising what was best for our dog. Vet try to offer unnecessary procedures just to rank up the bill, which we declined as we knew it wasn't necessary. Hopefully won't need them again.

records.title: Outrageously expensive weekend appointment!!!
records.text: I had to book an emergency appointment for my dog after she hurt her paw while playing in the garden.The stuff was lovely and very helpful but I was shocked by the extortionate charge of £313 for the visit and £65 for the tiny  bandage that was put around my dog’s foot. She’s a  Jack Russell so the bandage was not that big!

records.title: Very Poor Emergency Service & Complaints Process
records.text: Had a very poor experience at the Bournemouth surgery back in September, it took VetsNow over the 30 days to come back to me with regards my concern related to one of the Vet at the location and the lack of empathy or support. After, reviewing the investigation report it was clear that they had not taken everything I had raised into account and offered very little in the way of an apologia. They have now take another 25 day PLUS to resolve the issues, and have said they are short of staff and overwhelmed with complaints. So not only do they not give a caring service when you take a very poorly dog in, but their complaints procedure seems designed in the hope you will forget and move on, 3 months is totally unacceptable. I would avoid VetsNow, and go with a company that takes complaints seriously and where the Vets are caring an loving to the animals.       You can respond to a Trustpilot review with in minutes, but take 3 months to respond to a complaint, unbelievable. Even when I have responded to emails sent to me, you always say, we are still looking in to it. Your service poor, that’s a fact.

records.title: Extortionate consultation charges
records.text: The OOH consultation charge is absolutely scandalous - Mon to Sat expect to pay £40 to £50, have the misfortune of having to use the services on a Sunday and the consultation alone ( which was done and dusted in just under 8 minutes) rockets to over £313 !!! I accept you have people working on a Sunday morning but do you honestly believe that charge to be fair, equitable and fully justified ? I do not - double, treble the norm, fine but a c 800% increase/premium !

records.title: Loss of my pet
records.text: My 14yr old beloved pet was put to sleep a week ago. When I rang Vets Now I was told it would be £300+ to just see someone. I have read about your costs, (so please do not direct me there) and I understand why they may be more than in hours costs, however when I was told it would be £100 retention fee for my deceased pet to remain in the practice until the pet crematorium could collect her (which I arranged myself), I was horrified and distraught. There is NO justification for that. She obviously did not require any care whatsoever.  I took her to the pet crematorium myself, which was by far the best option. I lost another dog just 2 weeks previously and the care & compassion from my own vet practice was outstanding. There was no offer ofmemory making with yourselves, fortunately the pet crematorium did this for me. With the outrageous prices being charged, this is the least you could have done.

records.title: Pet Care - good, after service - horrible
records.text: Although the treatment of my pet was good the after service has been terrible. When taking my cat into Vets now they asked for a £250 deposit on the treatment and was assured this would be fully refunded once my insurance had sent payment through. 17 days ago payment was sent through and Vets Now apparently can’t see the payment because their accounts dept is backlogged. What’s the bets I still get charged the administrative fees!!

records.title: Vet care was good and efficient, admin poor
records.text: Vet care was good and efficient. The follow-up administration has been awful however. I paid a deposit up-front on the understanding that any money unused for my insurance excess and an admin fee would be returned once my insurance claim was settled. It’s now been over two months since my visit, the insurance was settled quickly but I still haven’t had my refund which should amount to £125. I have emailed and phoned but each time I’m just told they haven’t been able to match up the insurance payment with my account. No-one takes responsibility and it just feel likes it’s gone into a black hole. I’ve now tried to email the complaints department and have been told it will taken them 35 days to investigate. It’s very frustrating.

records.title: The actual veterinary treatment at Vets Now
records.text: The actual veterinary treatment at Colwyn Bay was good but that is as far as it goes.  My dog had to have emergency treatment and we were told we would be sent an invoice.  This has not been received.  I have finally got the money from my insurance company a month later only to find that Vets Now have made a donation to the blood bank at out cost without consent.  I would have said yas if asked but no-one did!! If this was a human I would be taking legal action right now.  Will be using Animals Trust next time, lots cheaper, same distance from home and hopefully fully upfront.

records.title: The receptionist was very nice
records.text: The receptionist was very nice, we was not very impressed with the vet her self she was very abrupt and it sounded like everything was about how much it was all going to cost when you’ve got an injured pet. That’s not what you want to wear. I do think an out of hour service is extortionate, the vet literally moved his legs gave him an injection and that was it plus we was sat in reception for over 2hours waiting to be seen

records.title: Mixed feelings
records.text: The vet was friendly, but unwilling to examine our cat beyond a quick visual inspection as our cat was distressed (always gets distressed during vet visits). She said she felt bad taking our money as she couldn't do much. Still charged us the £310 appointment fee, though. A lot of money spent and no further forward. Not terribly impressed.

description:
We’re part of IVC Evidensia, Europe’s leading veterinary care provider based across 11 countries around the world. As such, we’re also a registered veterinary practice and are governed by the Royal College of Veterinary Surgeons. This means you are guaranteed that the products we ship are sourced from the same suppliers as your own vet. 
We’ve been awarded a Platinum Trusted Service Award from Feefo for 2020 and we’ve won the Gold Trusted Service award three times in a row.

records.title: Excellent and very professional and the…
records.text: Excellent and very professional and the staff answering phone call are a credit to company: I have regular delivery of Vetmedin for my chihuahua s : However for first time my delivery was stolen on 23 December 24 Lucky a had some pills for 15 days for my two chihuahua s Daisy asked me to check and really supported me : I was very upset and stressed as needed medication as life saving for my two chihuahua s : Daisy at company listened and advised me what to do I followed instructions.Have Crime Reference and my pet medication speedy sent out . I sincerely trust this company Thank you

records.title: Ww have used pet drugs online for many…
records.text: Ww have used pet drugs online for many years. Efficient, less costly and quick delivery. Customer service representatives are always very helpful.

records.title: Thank you
records.text: Used pet drugs online for a while now with no issues. I ordered some prescription tablets for my dog and unfortunately my dog Woody passed away the following day. Pet drugs online were very apologetic for my loss, cancelled my order and gave a full refund. Thank you for making a very hard time a little easier x

records.title: Great Service
records.text: Really quick service, everything as it should be used them a few times never a problem and always good value

records.title: So happy I can't get smaller boxes off…
records.text: So happy I can't get smaller boxes off my cat food but I can get my cat specialist diet on here. That is nowhere near as expensive as pets at home would be at over 12£ of box of 10 super happy but I do wish I could get my guinea pig supplies off here as well order arrived super quick and efficient and was dispatched really quick even though I ordered at a weekend for standard delivery

records.title: The staff are really pleasant to speak…
records.text: The staff are really pleasant to speak to and they explain everything and they sent me an e mail with information that was very helpful to myself and the vet

records.title: Excellent service and delivery
records.text: Excellent service and delivery This is my go to place for all my pet needs as it's the cheapest i have found check out their eBay store as well

records.title: Pet drugs Online were recommended by my…
records.text: Pet drugs Online were recommended by my vet to keep costs down due to prescription for allergies.  I can purchase the same product less and have also seen other helpful products on this site less than I would pay at pets at home.  Not sure about the courier service as my first package of apoquel had clearly been opened by the courier who swiftly ran off after handing me the package face up!!!

records.title: I ordered some drontal cat tablets,and…
records.text: I ordered some drontal cat tablets,and renal food.which i needed ASAP.The food came on sat,i ordered on Friday.The tablets came via royal mail post on monday.good selection of reasonably priced products.   Petsdrugsonline,use reliable couriers.package was well packaged.I will be ordering from this company again.

records.title: Pet Drugs Online were as usual quick…
records.text: Pet Drugs Online were as usual quick and efficient, but the Royal Mail delivery did not deliver as indicated. The package says  No Signature, yet Royal Mail called but did not push the Jiffy bag through the letterbox and instead advised they would deliver the next day. So I have had to stay in until 2.05 for that to clatter through the box. This has never occurred before, but I do have a monthly prescription for my elderly dog.

records.title: Prompt service
records.text: Prompt service, great products at a good price. Attentive, polite and helpful staff. A pleasure to do business with.

records.title: Happy with Customer services
records.text: Happy with Customer services.  Not happy having to phone every time I wish to place an order. My prescription is not showing on my account, despite them merging it to my account each time.

records.title: Unusually delivery was slow and I had…
records.text: Unusually delivery was slow and I had to phone to chase hence only four stars.

records.title: Recommendations
records.text: A friend recommended this company for the medication that my dog was put on for the rest of his life, but it’s very expensive to buy from vets . But more affordable through pet drugs online with a prescription from the vet. It’s easy to order even for a non Technical dinosaur like me.

records.title: Telephone order worked best
records.text: I didn’t manage to complete the order online over the weekend but I telephoned on Monday & a very polite young lady smoothly completed the procedure with me. We’ll done that person!

records.title: When I ring Pet Drugs Online they are…
records.text: When I ring Pet Drugs Online they are always polite,helpful and patient with me.

records.title: Good products and prices but poor web site
records.text: I found the web site difficult when trying to pay for my dog’s prescription so I resorted to placing the order over the phone which worked far better I will give it one more try but if it doesn’t work again I will just ring up every time

records.title: Good service
records.text: After. Few hiccups getting the prescription sent it was very smooth. It took a bit longer than I thought for delivery but perfectly acceptable. Great prices compared to the vets charges so all good.  Will be ordering some more in the future. Thank you.

records.title: Reliable service
records.text: Once I managed to upload the prescription which I always seem to have trouble with, I found it a reliable service.

records.title: DHL wobbly but came eventually in good time.
records.text: Swiftly dispatched followed by DHL kerfuffle. No time window. Number 90 didn't drop. Tracking changed to delayed until Tues, THEN Suprise Surprise it turned-up Monday. We need an order or tracking option to deliver to a Parcel Shop for convenience. (DHL only has depot option)

records.title: Brilliant  service
records.text: Brilliant  service always comes fairly  quickly I always purchase from them and also .get some prescription for my dog from them

records.title: Promptly dealt with missing item
records.text: Good value products, promotions and offers, easy to navigate website, fast delivery. Would have given 5 stars but an item was missing, it was dealt with promptly by customer service but took weeks to be delivered.

records.title: Good company let down by courier
records.text: Have used this company several times now and was impressed with the service and quality of product. Unfortunately my latest delivery is showing through DHL as delivered & handed to me when it wasn't (I have a Ring doorbell to prove this). Trying to get through to Pet Drugs CS was a bit of a waiting game, but once through an incident was raised with a promise to resend if I don't receive within 3 days. My parcel eventually turned up a week later. Has it put me off ordering through this company again? Unfortunately it has.

records.title: Thank you for my order
records.text: Thank you for my order, which was delivered promptly. I was grateful for your help in dealing with the order over the phone so efficiently. The food is the perfect answer to stomach problems in my cat, which I also used for my very old cat aged 17, without the need to chew with few teeth. I was pleased to order extra food this time and expect to be placing further orders.

records.title: Great experience
records.text: Placed my order with customer service which arrived in less than 48hrs, very happy with the service I received.

records.title: I found the online account difficult to…
records.text: I found the online account difficult to use the second time around but the operator, when I phoned was very helpful.

records.title: I can’t pay for goods after I have…
records.text: I can’t pay for goods after I have ordered luckily I can ring you and then pay very happy otherwise

records.title: Always excellent service from pet drugs…
records.text: Always excellent service from pet drugs online.However the courier let us down the food took longer to arrive. The tracking details were not accurate, due to continued delays, over a few days . So I ended up ordering more food from Amazon. Very disappointing courier service.

records.title: When I got through on the phone the…
records.text: When I got through on the phone the person was very helpful and efficientI had tried calling and said yes to call back it wasn’t long before they called but it didn’t ring very long and I was in a different room so missed it and had to start all over again this was today

records.title: Had to purchase full qty now
records.text: To be fare this is not directly Pet Drugs Online fault but my vet issued a prescription for 3x2 monthly pain relief prescription for our pet. As the vet ticked single use box I had to purchase all the 6 months quantity!… at £130 extra. Just because the vet ticked the wrong box I couldn’t order just part of the prescription… I wasn’t asking for more I just wanted to part order the prescription like I had before and have the prescription available for the next order.

records.title: No longer competitive
records.text: For several years I regularly ordered needles for the vetpen for my diabetic dog and was always pleased with the service. Like everything else the price continued to rise and now they've stopped the free delivery. I looked online and found I can get them cheaper elsewhere, even paying delivery, so placed an order and service was just as good. I will be ordering from this company in future.

records.title: Frontline
records.text: The frontline supplied did not work . We suspected it was faulty( no smell and did not show on our dogs . Was passed from one to another. In fairness the company replaced the product with advantage which had an immediate effect but it took too long to resolve the matter . We are long standing customers and will continue to use pet drug on line .

records.title: Every time I try to order online I have…
records.text: Every time I try to order online I have a problem with the order and end up calling the order in. There is always an issue viewing the prescription

records.title: Mixed experience
records.text: I like that the orders arrived on time and well packaged.I don't like the faulty website that wouldn't allow me to change my order.I don't like the fact that had to resort to phoning and was charged for 2 deliveries

records.title: OK, eventually
records.text: I have been buying boxes of cardisure for my dog for the last 4 years.  I recently bought a box of 100 at a cost of about £100.  My dog recently passed away and I'm left with 8 blister packs of 10 tablets untouched fresh in the box, thats 80 tablets worth around £80.  Contacted them about selling them back, even if it was at 50% of their value at least I would get some of my money back.  They didn't want to know, their customer service rep sent me an automated response and shut the chat down.  Will now look for other places to source my pet drugs.UPDATE: received a phonecall from a very nice lady very different from the customer service rep I originally spoke to.

records.title: Misleading offers .........
records.text: Great easy ordering and upload of prescription however , offer 10% discount on registering , send a code , code does not work , and then tell you afterwards that you cannot use a discount against prescriptions. This is not clear anywhere on the website.Also offer free delivery on spending £39.00 or more but do not tell you that this is the slowest delivery of 4-6 days until you check out.All a little misleading really which isn't a good start!

records.title: Very difficult to get repeat…
records.text: Very difficult to get repeat prescription ordered one at a time, so I had to call customer service but they were really helpful. Probably something I may have been doing wrong but I didn't want to buy all repeats in one order.

records.title: Must say this is the first time we've…
records.text: Must say this is the first time we've used this company. Had a prescription from vet to submit the order, all fine, but we're now 6 days into submitting the order and prescription and still no delivery, only a despatch confirmation today. Not what we'd call a speedy service. Let's see what the delivery brings, hopefully all there.

records.title: Overall impressed with service.
records.text: We’ve held the policy for 10 years. Initially difficult to process, due to not following the complicated process but in last couple of years the claims have been paid without any query being raised. The only reason I cannot give 5 stars is above inflation premium increases from the start and unjustified latest increase.

records.title: I had trouble ordering online
records.text: I had trouble ordering online, my prescription was not on my online account. When I phoned I was told that I had two accounts. I was told that the accounts would be merged, I later tried to place an order but the problem was still there. So I had to place my order over the phone. This was very easy but it was a bit worrying not to be able to see my current prescription.

records.title: I wasn’t aware that a prescription for…
records.text: I wasn’t aware that a prescription for controlled drugs is only valid for 28 days, before the Christmas period DPD wasn’t able to deliver to my postal address so had to get the drugs from my vet. When I order the drugs from the prescriptions which were cancelled I was told that as two of the items were controlled drugs and the prescription no longer valid, I have gone back to my vet for the medication, I have lost £22, I think customers should be informed about this

records.title: Online problems
records.text: I tried to order on line using my password and email but it would not accept it..and then blocked my account!!..even the next day  it would not let me access it..so in the end I found a phone number and a very  pleasant lady  took my order. Will have to reconsider  the company if I have more problems.. but here's hoping that after the hectic post strike I might get my delivery

records.title: Not as efficient as previously
records.text: I have used this company for many years for my dogs epilepsy medication and have always been highly satisfied. However, my most recent order took over a week to arrive. This wasn't down to the post as the order wasn't processed until quite a few days after I placed the order. Usually it's within 24/48 hours. I rang and was told that they were very busy due to them taking business from a rival company. This is all well and good but will probably put me off now if I need something quicker.

records.title: order was lost in post
records.text: order was lost in post but had to wait 10 working days before it could be investigated ( was sent 48hr delivery)

records.title: Processing vet script for my dog
records.text: I dislike the fact that my highly trained and experienced vet's prescription needs authorization from the Pet Drugs Online vet team who do not know the condition of my dog.  The script was authorized but this took longer than it should and I was not advised when it happened.  I had to chase.

records.title: I found the whole process exhausting
records.text: I found the whole process exhausting. I don't have a printer and that appears not to be a good start because I couldn't scan the prescription. Then we had endless wait whilst you were caught up with the postal strike and I felt that the staff really did not understand the anxiety that the customer was feeling.

records.title: Bad communication
records.text: Bad communication from a young man , who took payment , yet did not tell me my prescription had not been received. Which I was on the understanding you had received,  so apoquel was received but too late for me. So I had to buy 10 tablets from my vets , to tie us over , till my order was received.

records.title: Too long to deliver but prices are good.
records.text: The prices are nice but the time to deliver from ordering a product is too long, especially where medicine is required.Also, why did the first-class delivery option disappear from options?  The second-class option takes a week to ten days to arrive.Communication requiring a day or more between responses is also a little poor.I will continue using them because of the prices, but everything else needs improvement.

records.title: Prescription for my 5 year old cat.
records.text: Been ordering for years online at first there prices where great then all of a sudden there prices went up not just once but three times over a space of a year. Also on the website most of the items are out of stock. When you email they don't reply very disappointed.

records.title: Jobsworth/OTT person at the company
records.text: Jobsworth/OTT person at the company. Emailed a photo of the prescription for our super senior cat but for whatever ridiculous reason it wasnt good enough even when all the information was visible.

records.title: Called as some medication is human meds…
records.text: Called as some medication is human meds (gabapentin) and also propelin. Orderplaced, payment taken but wasn’t asked for prescription, called to enquire when medication would arrive, told not dispatched as no current prescription, resulted in my dog having to go without medication until it arrived.Not ideal

records.title: Bad customer service
records.text: After being a loyal customer for two years, I’m extremely disappointed with the appalling customer service I've experienced. A prescription issue that took months to resolve was finally addressed, but instead of resolving it properly, my account was credited along with an admin fee. To make matters worse, the credit can only be used over the phone — in 2024, this feels completely outdated and inconvenient. Even though my prescription was valid, the deduction of an admin fee (and the expiration of my previously valid* prescription) has left me unable to purchase the products I need. As a result, I’ll be taking my business elsewhere for all future prescriptions and pet supplies.

records.title: I am chasing and chasing all the time…
records.text: I am chasing and chasing all the time for my cats metacam. As a result I have now ran out. To me do they enjoy seeing and hearing animals in pain?  UPDATED its now arrived but i having to chase all the time!

records.title: Totally appalling company
records.text: Totally appalling company , sent prescription. A number of times still claim it’s blurry paid an over inflated delivery cost for next day delivery as my pet was running out in four days and still messing me around can’t call as it says wait time 37 minutes emails say response 48 hours I now have a very poorly pet because of this Company .. paid £80 for Medication they can’t supply

records.title: Certificates were requested each time…disappointed
records.text: Certificates were requested each time costing a small fortune  !The worst is the original order got overlooked ! I had to ring and chase it up.Finally I have tge correct password yet I ACTUALLY can't use it to reorder

records.title: Wording of prescription was not…
records.text: Wording of prescription was not explained on first order but you still supplied it Unfortunately second order was delayed in post even though sent signed for so had to go back to our vets to supply it as we have to rely on efficient  supply of medicine even events not completely due to anyone's fault apart from postal service

records.title: Ordered from pet drugs online and they…
records.text: Ordered from pet drugs online and they promptly sent order out, however DHL are a total joke, three times they have said it will be delivered to my local shop, my dog needs his medicated food, not happy at all, order number, 60120167789811 postcode M23 0GP My dog needs his medication !!

records.title: I was ready to reorder prescriptions…
records.text: I was ready to reorder prescriptions medication online, website obtained from email, unfortunately I’d forgotten password, I followed instructions and awaited the email to reset password, I waited more than an hour, it didn’t arrive. I then use the phone which was much quicker and satisfactory experience.I

description:
Hey there, pet lovers! 🐾 Welcome to SmartTrace, where we're all about keeping your furry friends safe and sound with our top-notch microchipping and database services. With over a million registrations under our belt, we're your go-to pals for pet ID solutions in the UK.

At SmartTrace, we know your pets are family, and that's why we go above and beyond to ensure their safety. Our own awesome microchips are paired with a super-smart database system to give you peace of mind like never before.

Have an emergency? No worries! Our 24/7 helpline is here for you anytime, day or night. And if you shoot us an email, we promise to get back to you on the same working day. Because when it comes to your pet's safety, there's no time to waste!

Our website? Oh, it's a breeze to use! Say goodbye to confusing forms and hello to easy-peasy registration. We've made it simple so you can get back to cuddling your furry pals in no time.

We're not just about microchips and databases – we're about reuniting families with their lost pets. And boy, have we done it thousands of times across the UK! There's nothing that makes us happier than seeing wagging tails and happy faces.

So, join the SmartTrace family today and let's keep those tails wagging and those purrs coming. Your pets are our passion, and we're here to make sure they're always safe and sound. Trust SmartTrace – because we're not just pet lovers, we're pet protectors! 🐶🐱

records.title: Massive thanks to Bree
records.text: Massive thanks to Bree who was amazing, efficient, patient very conscientious and caring in helping to resolve our issue.Many thanks Bree

records.title: I had the pleasure of dealing with Bree…
records.text: I had the pleasure of dealing with Bree over the last few days about my dogs chip registration.  She was extremely helpful & patient with me whilst we tried to sort out a problem we encountered due to our original registration being processed on a scammed website.  Really glad it was finally sorted. 100% happy. Thanks

records.title: After receiving a scam email regarding…
records.text: After receiving a scam email regarding the registration of my pet microchip, I contacted Smarttrace and spoken to Joanne one of Smarttrace staff and she was extremely helpful with my enquire and gave excellent advice. It was a pleasure to be assured by Smarttrace staff. Joanne done a security check and confirm that it was a scam email.Thank you Joanne, an thank you Smarttrace.Cmora

records.title: Great admin help, fast response
records.text: Great customer service. Diane dealt with my enquiry and got me registered swiftly and efficiently.  Now I can search the information I need promptly, enabling swift owner identification and reunion with lost pet. Thank you for your help Diane and a thumbs up to Smarttrace.

records.title: I was so extremely grateful for the help of Joanne
records.text: I was so extremely grateful for the assistance of Joanne yesterday.  I learnt that I had not been officially launched with SmartTrace and therefore if my dog had gone missing his chip on the website gave the breeders name!  With clear and precise instructions from Joanne, I was able to rectify this situation, thank goodness.

records.title: Microchip chip fraud
records.text: I receved a email saying my dogs microchip was going to expire smarttrace was so prompt and helpful. Diane sent me an email straight away confirming it was a scam and put my mind at rest knowing my dog was all up to date . Great service .

records.title: Diane as ever acted very quickly to…
records.text: Diane as ever acted very quickly to resolve an issue I escalated to her, always first class service, thankyou so much.

records.title: Simply the best
records.text: Very efficient. There the best and easy to use. Very good always on the end of phone if you need them to answer your questions

records.title: Dianne is great member of staff,after…
records.text: Dianne is great member of staff,after sending my email with in 15 minutes or less Dianne answered and dealt with my enquiry. We sent a few emails but Dianne messaged back straight away.Very fast very helpful and problem solved straight away

records.title: Pet microchip scam email…
records.text: I received an email from a company called petchip.network stating that my dogs microchip had expired and yes you guessed it they wanted money to continue his microchip tracking which obviously is important should he go missing.My dogs microchip was registered with Smarttrace so the email rang alarm bells for sure.I immediately contacted Smarttrace for their advice.Joanne from Smarttrace replied to my email and confirmed that petchip.network is a scam site and to not pay them any money which luckily I hadn't.Joanne was extremely helpful and by answering my query quickly and efficiently she put my mind at rest and prevented me from worrying any longer than necessary.10/10 Joanne at Smarttrace!

records.title: Reassured customer. We brought our puppy home this week and…
records.text: We brought our puppy home this week and promptly transferred the ownership using the chip number on the documents provided. When we then went to the vets to register our new family member they scanned our puppy to confirm the chip number. We were advised it didn't correspond with the documentation. We promptly contact SmartTrace. It wasn't long before Sam contacted us and efficiently sorted our the original error and confirm we could then transfer our ownership.Many thanks Sam, very reassuring. (Please note I never give full marks)

records.title: Thanks Joanne
records.text: Thanks Joanne, u was really helpful in sorting my issue out,thanks.

records.title: Okay, a promise of a discount!?
records.text: Smarttrace have offered to reduce the Fee from £19.95 to £17.96 (10%) if i left a review so i am doing. i will come back to edit depending on how this works out. I did have to contact smart trace a few times as their 24/7 line wasn't very helpful worryingly but i received a response over email from Bree who quickly directed me to the correct path on how to register my new puppy.

records.title: Easy to set up and use
records.text: Easy to set up and use.  Very user friendly and peace of mind knowing that if i loose the dog it will help having the microchip to get the dog back to me.That said i did the review as i was promised a discount on the price of membership if i did a review which after doing the review i never got.  I still paid full price so that bit was a con... no 10% off for a review.......so i have now taken one star off the review.

records.title: My journey started a little rocky as I…
records.text: My journey started a little rocky as I was having trouble logging into my account and seemed to be going around in circles.  I had a Provisional Certificate but needed an Ownership Certificate for an upcoming trip.It was such a relief when I heard from Joanne who provided me with a new password and the procedure from then on was so easy.Thank you Joanne for your help.  I truly appreciated it.

records.title: Prompt and Helpful
records.text: Provisional Registration of a recently adopted dog was quick and easy. Upgrading to official registration was slower than expected. However, the very prompt and helpful intervention of Bree brought immediate results including provision of the corresponding Certificate of Registration.

records.title: Not the best but not the worst
records.text: The process of changing pet details was a bit of a task. Certainly other microchip companies make the process much easier. I work in a vet surgery and found this company to not be as good as other. However, having said that, Bree who dealt with my request over email has been absolutely brilliant. She has sorted it all out for me and made the issue much easier to handle without me needing to shout at my computer.

records.title: Not possible contact company directly
records.text: I got a puppy and as it became clear - breeder messed up with microchips and provided me with completely different details. I had a trouble to contact smarttrace, as my direct email was sent back as invalid and they are not taking calls, unless it is emergency. Only option left to fill out contact form directly from the website and Bree contacted me. She solved my problem effectively and fast, could not be more happy.

records.title: I emailed the SmartTrace website
records.text: I emailed the SmartTrace website, I didn’t expect a reply until tomorrow. But Diane replied almost straight away - she was very helpful 👍🏼

records.title: Prompt and efficient service when required
records.text: Just taken over ownership of five year old dog already microchipped with Smartrace. Online administration problem promptly and efficiently dealt with by Bree and all now set up should the dog go missing, though clearly I hope we never have cause to call upon that service.

records.title: thank you Bree
records.text: My contact at your service was very good and got my problem resolved. The only delay in your response was caused by your system allocating a new Ticket number midway through the process which caused confusions at both ends. I did find your actual process to set up a new account  etc. was not as intuitive as others I have used, however as stated above the response by Bree was great.

records.title: I contacted the sales team twice only…
records.text: I contacted the sales team via the telephone twice only to be told that my missing cat wasn't on their system, which as you can imagine was extremely stressful when my kitten was missing and it was -2C outside. It wasn't until I emailed Bree on the support desk that I was told she was on the system but I needed to transfer her details from the breeder to myself, which I was unaware I had to do. Bree responded very quickly to my requests via email and everything is now sorted. I just wish the telephone team were as knowledgable about the situation, as this would have caused a lot less stress at a very stressful time.

records.title: Damn
records.text: Damn, I'm so glad I ran into your company! I have a German Shepherd and it is quite moody and constantly runs far away on walks, thanks to your microchip, I immediately find my dog, but at first it was difficult to figure out how to track it. Keep up the good work!

records.title: Great customer service from Bree
records.text: The functionality on the website to update my personal details did not work, despite charging me the fee to change my details. Bree in the customer services team responded to my query very quickly and was able to resolve my issue within the same day. Thanks, Bree!(Only marked down to 5 stars due to the error with the website)

records.title: Registration payment problem
records.text: When I first registered I got an error message at the end of the card payment. As there was no confirmation I went through the process again using a different card, with the same result. On going back to the dashboard there were 2 pets registered. When I checked my bank 2 payments had gone through. After 4 days without a response to my email via the help I emailed again. Joanne contacted me 2 days later. After a couple more emails Joanne corrected the dashboard and refunded one of the payments. She was very helpful and deserves 5 stars. I have only awarded 4 due to the website payment process and the slow initial response which I assume was down to the system which only deserves 1 star but that would reflect badly on Joanne who deserves better.

records.title: Microchip registration problem
records.text: Bree and Joanne at SmartTrace customer Support were very patient and helpful in dealing with a problem that I had with my dog's microchip registration. They responded to my questions very rapidly and guided me through what I needed to do. A big thank you to both of them.

records.title: The quick response and sensitivity they…
records.text: The quick response and sensitivity they handled my issue. It would make things easier for people if was an option with the pet details for someone to report that a pet has passed away instead of having to email or ring

records.title: I had a wonderful experience adopting a…
records.text: I had a wonderful experience adopting a pet from this store. The staff was informative and made sure that I was prepared to give my new furry friend a loving home. I would highly recommend this store for anyone looking to add a new pet to their family.

records.title: Discount for review
records.text: A company is offering a discount for this review. It has bugs for registering but we got a puppy with this company microchips from the previous owner so there is no other choice, just to use it.

records.title: Didn't initially respond to dogs home…
records.text: Didn't initially respond to dogs home requests to transfer our new puppy to us and didn't reposed to our emails either. Took a day to sort but all good and now in our name and registered to out address. Phone number is no real help as its automation and limited. Good result but frustrating

records.title: A telephone call would make any issues more easily resolved and stress free!
records.text: I telephone call would make any issues more easily resolved and stress free! Although Diane was most helpful today, responding to my emails promptly & efficiently without Diane's help I don't know what I would have done.

records.title: My dog’s chip was incorrectly…
records.text: My dog’s chip was incorrectly registered. The wait time to have my query addressed was unacceptably long due to site upgrade(!), more than 2 weeks. However, once assigned to a member of the team I was reassured. Once I could provide a photo of the scanned chip, Bree was brilliant at actioning the transfer.

records.title: Take a bit of care before registering your pet
records.text: Easy to look up & transfer details but everything seemed to be aimed more at dogs than cats.The transfer charge options are misleading. When I first looked at the site, I didn't realise that there was the basic plan as the plan first shown was unlimited at double the price of the basic.

records.title: Difficult to Action
records.text: difficult to "speak" to someone for advice - so on line only option Now hoping this works to keep our rescue woof safe and registered to usExtra Note added offered discount if this was actioned and went to pay - No discount allocated

records.title: Almost too easy to transfer a dog
records.text: I recently transferred a dog on to my account.Smarttrace didn't check with the old owner that this was OK.Makes me very concerned that someone could steal a smarttrace dog and transfer without the owner knowing

records.title: Contacted by Petscammer telling me dog was fraudulently registered
records.text: Easy to register, thought I was registered already and they should have contacted me before. Site ok, was contacted by another party with a threatening manner saying my dog wasn't registered! How did they know to contact me?

records.title: Difficult to Register!
records.text: Returned again today to try and register, link to trust pilot still not working!Smarttrace did email me stating that if I pay in full they would refund the discount to my card. So that sounds good I hope they keep their word.If they cannot get a simple registration process right, it does not give me the best confidence in the company should I every need there tracing services!

records.title: Could be improved
records.text: I'm not a fan of contact having to be made via email ‐ sometimes you just need to speak to a human to go through a few things.  The phone numbers that are shown on the Internet for Smarttrace don't work.  I got sent microchips that had puppy pack vouchers in them - I had to email to find out if they were valid and was told they weren't, they had now stopped, they just had residual stock to use basically.   One of the needles, so far was broken so had to email and request a replacement.  This may have been due to the way they posted with no real packaging inside. I'm also not a fan of having to set up an account for the customer but as long as they have an email, this is fairly simple.  I like the nano size and also that I can do a free transfer to the owner - If it wasn't for these two factors, I don't think I would particularly use this company.

records.title: The problem was resolved quite quickly…
records.text: The problem was resolved quite quickly and Bree was helpful. However I would have preferred to have resolved the issue by speaking to someone rather than back and forth emails. This is a smart trace issue not the issue Bree from customer service she was very helpful. It would be more helpful if there was a help line number that could be called.

records.title: No phone contact, NO GOOD
records.text: First of all, a massive thanks to Joanne. Once she got involved, my problem was solved. My main concern to begin with was the difficulty in getting in touch. As I am over 70 years old, the fact that no phone contact is accepted, and everything must be done online, I found the contact system to be diabolical. Thanks again Joanne, you are a saviour

records.title: Smart trace has been very good with all…
records.text: Smart trace has been very good with all of the details about my puppy but when it comes to paying for the transfer of the address on the microchip, I get this message MERCHANT ERROR-AN ERROR OCCURRED INVALID PHONE FIELD Please can you help me

records.title: I had an issue with the wrong microchip…
records.text: I had an issue with the wrong microchip details and received an email from Diane who helped me resolve this problemThe only negative is there is no contact number to phone only an email address so takes longer

records.title: Didn't have any particular experience yet..
records.text: 3 stars as asking for review in return for a discount is a bit cheeky at the time of the registration. At least could have given some grace period to get accustomed to the service etc. How can I give some proper review when we just got the pup and registering it?!

records.title: Tracking unavailable so couldn't judge…
records.text: Tracking unavailable so couldn't judge when they'd arrive

records.title: SmartTrace Registration
records.text: Firstly I should say that I agree with a lot of people, that the lack of a Contact Number (for SmartTrace Customer Services) is counterproductive in my opinion. Also, the Registration process was frustrating, because once the fee was debited, it was unclear whether the Registration process had actually completed! This meant that I had to raise a Ticket to ascertain whether or not the Registration had actually been actioned! Anyway, to cut a long story short, I raised a Ticket on 11th June. JOANNE replied on 13th June requesting all the information I had previously input myself and confirmed the Transfer request had now been actioned. Sure enough, the SmartTrace site now showed a 'pending' Transfer and on 20th June, the Transfer was completed!It's a difficult one to 'Rate' because although the Registration process  leaves a lot to be desired, once a 'human being' got involved, it went very smoothly - surprise, surprise - (Ref initial comment on Contact Number!).Anyway, I think 3/5 is fair.

records.title: I am a volunteer for a canine rescue…
records.text: I am a volunteer for a canine rescue organisation and am in regular contact with SmartTrace regarding the transfer of microchips of surrendered dogs.  I find their system to be longwinded and it often takes at least 2 or 3 days before a microchip becomes available for transfer to the new owner.  I have recently had help from Bree at SmartTrace who managed to progress my transfer requests quickly, which was much appreciated.

records.title: Registered by the breeder and the first…
records.text: Registered by the breeder and the first transfer was supposed to be free. It's costing me more to transfer than it would to have the chip done myself

records.title: Dont exploit people who want to protect…
records.text: Dont exploit people who want to protect their pets. Service should be free the technology doesnt cost much.

records.title: £25 to change an address!
records.text: You can't speak to a human on the phone unless you call the emergency line (which one probably shouldn't do unless there is an emergency), and if you need to change your address (ie if you move home), there is a one-off £25 fee that you have to pay, to allow you to change address and phone number. This seems ludicrous.

records.title: Just been notified my pet micro chip…
records.text: Just been notified my pet micro chip number has been transferred without my authorization. What is this company all about. Just logged in and my chip number is registered to different dog. Just sent in a ticket.Update: They fixed the issue. Still no way to contact them on the phone. Only way to communicate was through website.

records.title: Issued refund which clearly stated it…

Her details had not been updated despite my request and payment in 2018. Needless to say I got in touch straight away!  The only reason I gave 2 stars and not 1 is that they rectified the situation immediately as they should. However they can stick their derisory apology!  My advice is to avoid SmartTrace!

records.title: No response. no contact. will transfer to another service

No phone number, or at least the phone wnumber given gets through to a recorded message giving options but is 'only for emergencies'. The lack of response, not being able to call to speak to someone gives me no faith if i needed help in a more concerning situation. If the website was clearer showing that I was the registered keeper, I would not have made the error.  I will now try to register the chip with the service my other pets are registered with. The email said if it didn't answer my query I would need to ring them which I did. I had a struggle to understand the agent who answered as he had a very strong accent. I'm sure he was polite and he cancelled my order for me. It was going to take much longer than expected and wouldn't arrive any time soon. I would have thought a company like Viovet would keep people informed. If something is out of stock please do what other companies do and say so on the website. Every other company I have dealt with has had an option for you to receive an email when something comes back into stock. At least then you know there is going to be a delay and you have the option to buy elsewhere. UPDATEViovet have offered to resolve the issue, but I had already cancelled the order and I have ordered elsewhere. They have been okay with previous orders that they have had in stock. They just need to make the customer aware when an item is going to take much longer than expected.
