records.text: Delivery and process was very good, however the calming tablets purchased gave my dog really bad constipation so have ceased giving him them.  Only used 3 tablets so didn’t have time to assess whether they worked or not.

records.title: I've only given a 4 star rating
records.text: I've only given a 4 star rating, which covers, ordering, delivery and cost.  Hopefully I may be able to upgrade later. As it says that we should get results in 4 weeks. Our little Cockapoo won't eat them unless they are hidden in cheese!

records.title: Anxious Labrador
records.text: My Red Fox Labrador “Oakley” has always been wary of bangs & firework’s even to the point of knowing if an engine revs high it might backfire! And unfortunately this problem seemed to be getting worse, I was aware of Dorwest so I decided to investigate & tried the Skullcap & Valerian the result was amazing. The evening walk no longer required me persuading him to go outside and any background bangs are totally ignored. It has totally changed his nervousness over bangs etc.

records.title: Speaking to a human on the phone who…
records.text: Speaking to a human on the phone who helped with the order was perfect for me. The delivery was quick and goods carefully packed.Web site helpful for full details and the products have all been great especially the garlic tablets, for my dog, which help against ticks. If there was a simple way of delivering to places in Europe that would also be helpful.

records.title: Ordering and website orientation was…
records.text: Ordering and website orientation was very good, simple and quick, not sure if the medication worked as I expected but our dog did seem slightly to cope a little better than last year's fireworks but she was still very nervous.

records.title: Excellent products and reasonable…
records.text: Excellent products and reasonable delivery. However the product that came in a tub is devilish difficult to open. The plastic tear off strip left too much material clinging to the lid. I had to shave some more off to get it open.

records.title: Good service but products haven't had the desired effect
records.text: Easy ordering process and speedy delivery. I'd hoped that the Vitamin B with kelp would help boost my 14 year old little Jackapoo's appetite but it's not had much affect, if any. I'll keep persevering. I bought the keepers mix again to boost any lack of vitamins she may have but she doesn't like the smell (which is quite nice) so I have to work out a way to get her to take it. All a bit frustrating.

records.title: Quick service
records.text: The item was received very quickly but unfortunately I had a real problem opening the container. Not had this with this product before. I had to get my son to do it and even he found it very difficult.

records.title: Good ordering experience but...
records.text: Good ordering experience but unfortunately I cannot get my dog to take the tablets (Movewellia) as they are quite large, can't be broken up, and are too hard for me to to crush. I have a pill dispenser but my dog hates it so I don't want to have to use it every day. Sadly, a waste of money for me.

records.title: Great products
records.text: Your products are amazing and truly help my dogs, one has gained a title he would have struggled to do without them.I do struggle being overseas with orders and freight calculations, my last order caused grief as no freight was shown until I was contacted days later to pay for the freight, if that could be rectified you could get 5 stars.Having said all that the shipping was super fast, even in December.

records.title: Product came quickly and the package…
records.text: Product came quickly and the package was intact. Don’t give 5 stars purely because I’ve been giving them to my dog for just over 3 weeks and therefore can’t really say whether he benefits from them. One thing I can say, they smell like real turmeric. Will definitely purchase again.

records.title: The service was great but unfortunately…
records.text: The service was great but unfortunately the powders didn’t work for my dog who didn’t get better & a scan revealed severe pancreatitis & a bacterial infection.We are now into the 7th week of him being poorly & since the scan has been on loads of meds which have worked. He was put on medication to speed his system up so the pancreas didn’t have to work so hard. This is contrary to the powders which slow things down so I had to stop them. He finishes his meds tonight & goes back to the vet for a checkup tomorrow. Time will tell if his pancreas has recovered. Fingers crossed.

records.title: Ordered some digestive tablets for our…
records.text: Ordered some digestive tablets for our dog. A bit of a sensitive stomach at times and they sort it out quickly. Order arrive quickly but only one bottle arrived. Contacted Dorwest and was sorted very quickly with no fuss. Recommend them for their products and service.

records.title: Only gave four stars as in a mixed…
records.text: Only gave four stars as in a mixed order one item not what l ordered, dorwest resent correct item quickly. Have begun to use their herbs regularly and am pleased with results, particularly easy green has stopped my Labrador itching.

records.title: Value for money
records.text: Prompt shipping arrived when promised ,can't say the skullcap and valerian worked well on my stresshead hound but he did calm down a bit,they are value for money

records.title: As good as people say it is
records.text: Very quick delivery, easy website to navigate.  I have a Cypriot 'Bitza' who will pick things up in the woods and deposit the end result in the kitchen.  Found this needs to be mixed with extra liquid even though she's on wet food but it seems to have done the job, twice now!

records.title: Good service
records.text: Good service.  Giving raspberry leave to my dog to see if it will help prevent a phantom pregnancy.  She is happy to take them but I can't say if they'll work as she's only a few weeks in to the recommended dosage.

I’m going to be very honest here, but hopefully provide some justification for comments.The ordering and delivery from Dorwest were easy and fast.We have a retriever who is a nervous/anxious boy, especially to noise stimulus, strangers to home and dogs that get excited around him. He has no anxiety around his ‘uncle’ (our other retriever). Originally he was using another brand of ‘calming chews’ but, on recommendation and reading reviews, we decided to make the change to the Valerian and Skullcap tablets; also getting the compound which we have yet to use. He has been on the tablets for just under 3 months.At the moment the jury is out regarding their effectiveness to this point. We have taken a view of trying on them longer given he had been on the other brand previously. However, we will be introducing the compound this weekend in preparation of the firework ‘season’ as this is a real trigger to him.I would add that we have tried de-sensitising, training, calming music, etc, etc, but nothing has so far been successful so really hoping this is effective to reduce his stress.

records.title: A steady start…..
records.text: I was pleased with the speed of delivery and supply. My dog has taken quite a while to get used to the product, but after several weeks seems happier. It is quite usual to find a small amount of unconsumed residue left in her feeding bowl. Being a Springer Spaniel that’s a rare thing! I have another slight whinge, I find tightening the lid on the 500g plastic supplement container quite a struggle at times. It is not easy to get the thread on the lid to tighten onto the main container.

records.title: Disappointed that I had to call to…
records.text: Disappointed that I had to call to confirm that my 4kg dog should only have half a tablet of garlic and fenugreek.The packaging/ dose on the container says one per 10kgs but doesn’t mention if it’s less and to adjust accordingly.Whilst one may think it’s obvious it wasn’t until I thought about it and called. Hope it hasn’t done his organs any damage.

records.title: The service was great
records.text: The service was great. The item was delivered on time. We got it to calm our anxious cats but unfortunately it didn’t suit them. We mixed it in their food but it smelled so strong they wouldn’t eat it but I’m sure it will work for other cats, our two are just very fussy don’t tolerate anything different from the norm.

records.title: Great product,  misleading discount offer though
records.text: Ordered my dogs usual garlic and fenugreek tablets which are great but the 20 % off code didn't work at the checkout. I appreciated a quick reply to my email but it was clear the offer was misleading and you had to buy two different products to get the discount. Hopefully a relevant discount code will be offered next time.

records.title: Raspberry Leaf given to stop phantom pregnancy caused bile sickness every morning following giving it to her after her meal the night before
records.text: Delivery fine, website good, product (Raspberry Leaf) made my dog sick (bile) every morning.I was giving it to her to help with phantom pregnancy symptoms.   I started the course at the beginning of her season as directed.  She was sick every morning after giving it to her with her evening meal.  I continued with the course as they are herbal and i've bought 200 of them but I quickly reduced dose from 6 to 4 every other day.   She has not even finished her season yet so the reason for buying them has not come into play yet.    Obviously I cannot continue to give them to her so they are a complete waste of money and probably not healthy otherwise she would not have been sick every day.

records.title: Excellent but why sugar-coated?
records.text: We use several of the Dorwest herb supplements for our dog, and she is definitely better for them but I don't understand why many of them are sugar-coated.  Refined white sugar is not good for any of us, least of all our pets.

records.title: Ordering and shipping was fine
records.text: Ordering and shipping was fine. The product itself did not help with my dogs chronic diarrhea issue as we are still having that issue. Might be good for occasional diarrhea but not chronic.

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: They arrived on time but we didn't think they made any difference to either our resident dog or the foster dog

records.title: The commutation with Dorwest was good.
records.text: The commutation with Dorwest was good.I had bought some tablets for my doggie. But decided not give it to her anymore after giving it to her a few times. I had put it in her food and she ate it fine. But I noticed through out the day she seemed like she was gagging/uncomfortable.I stopped it and tried again but she was same. Maybe for other dogs it works but not mine.

records.title: The produce seems ok in theory but I…
records.text: The produce seems ok in theory but I can’t get my dog to eat it!  Its smell is putting her off and mixed in water it looks disgusting and she’s not tempted at all!

records.title: We think the relaxation herbs have made…
records.text: We think the relaxation herbs have made a bit of difference to our dog's anxiety but not as much as hoped.

records.title: Valerian compound
records.text: Bought the Valerian compound for my dogs as they’re terrified of fireworks.Didn’t work for us at all I’m afraid.

records.title: Shipping not tracked, takes weeks to get it
records.text: No overseas shipments are tracked ...you have no idea if or when they will arrive. And it take FOREVER to get your product.  WEEKS!

records.title: Samples sent insufficient for number of dogs
records.text: Quick service when requested samples but only very small quantity sent not sufficient to trial on multiple dogs for tolerance as explained when requesting samples.

records.title: Delivery issue
records.text: Very happy with the product but DPD did not deliver to my door and I had to drive a few miles to a town to collect it.

records.title: Thanks for the keepers  mix
records.text: Thanks for the keepers  mix. Unfortunately it didn’t include a scoop. It was a huge one too. Please can you send one.

records.title: Scullcap & Valerian Tablets For Dogs
records.text: The response to our order was first class.We consider that our assessment of the products performance will be more long term and there refrain from commenting in this instance

records.title: Paid for fast delivery but still took 3…
records.text: Paid for fast delivery but still took 3 days to arrive

records.title: Not a good product
records.text: My dog had a very difficult labour, her blood levels dropped she was exhausted so this product had had no effect at all. We couldn’t get hold of our usual product Won’t be recommending this product to anyone

records.title: I'm afraid the compound hasn't made…
records.text: I'm afraid the compound hasn't made much difference to my poor dog's anxiety levels when she hears fireworks. I've given it to her 2 hours before anticipated fireworks noise but she's still panting and trembling for at least 2 hours after the noise has ceased.

records.title: Scullcap & Valerian
records.text: My order arrived promptly. After taking calming tablets for over 3 weeks my dog has shown no signs of her anxiety improving. This last week I have increased her dosage to the maximum she can take and I will continue to use the rest of the tablets to hopefully see some improvement

records.title: I recieved the summer brochure &…
records.text: I recieved the summer brochure & ordered garlic & fenugreek tabs & green relief tabs large dog. He has pollen allergy. For 3 weeks with his weight 12 tabs a day. Spoke to dorwest regarding him being on piriton(from vet). He's been on this trio for 3weeks & no change from just the piriton. £56 wasted.

records.title: Decline in the quality of customer service
records.text: I  started using Dorwest Herbs many years ago and the customer service was wonderful . Unfortunately it no longer is,  I was disappointed with  at least one of your associates I dealt with.  I  always felt that as a company you had  put the pet's welfare first, this now does not seem to be the case .

records.title: Sent wrong parcel
records.text: Sent wrong parcel, you sent again with a return box for wrong item. Return label just said Dorwest Herbs Limited FREEPOST.  I rang to ask if address needed, you said no. Two trips to post office, two emails and no apology or reply!

records.title: No mention of how many tablets per dog…
records.text: No mention of how many tablets per dog kilo weight. Worked out our Newfoundland and needed about 12 tablets a day which worked out very expensive

records.title: Dorwest seem to have good products
records.text: Dorwest seem to have good products, but they don’t reply to customer service emails. Shame.

records.title: It's what in the ingredients slippy elm…
records.text: It's what in the ingredients slippy elm barley which my shar-pie has allergies to elm barkSo I can't use it again

records.title: I've no problem with the service but…
records.text: I've no problem with the service but the valerian products have not helped our dog one iota after 3 weeks of taking them.

description:
Eat Shih Tzu and die, fleas!

Never forget to protect your pet. We’re here to help you keep your pet flea, tick, lice and worm free with a tailored treatment subscription delivered to your door for free, exactly when you need it.


Tailored dose, personalised to your pet
Vet approved, scientifically proven ingredients
Delivered when you need it, so you never forget
Change, amend, cancel anytime



Your first Itch Flea treatment is free.

We partner with world-leading pharmaceutical experts, incredible chemists and scientists with over 40 years international experience to produce our hero products Itch Flea and Itch Wormer.

Tried and tested by fellow pet parents
Trusted by over 120k pets
3 million packs sold


Get in touch with our crew of qualified experts, fully trained on our products in veterinary medicines advice. There’s no problem too big, small or even too gross. We’ve heard it allll before.

hello@itchpet.com

020 3370 0905

Monday-Friday from 8am-4pm

records.title: What a fantastic company
records.text: What a fantastic company! Everything works like clockwork it’s delivered on time each month and any enquiry is dealt with quickly and efficiently. The staff are so polite and helpful and so friendly to the point that the first time I spoke to them I felt like I was talking to a friend!  I highly recommend this company

records.title: Unlike some subscription services this…
records.text: Unlike some subscription services this company sends product prior to requirements so it’s ready when needed and I don’t need to chase it!Very pleased with product and service

records.title: Very confident for delivery
records.text: Very confident for delivery. They sent all you need at a reasonable price. Happy at present with itchy. Highly recommend.

records.title: It is a piece of mind and is easy to…
records.text: It is a piece of mind and is easy to use. The stuff works straight away no adverse reactions from my 2 dogs. It is great knowing they wont suffer with fleas at any time. It is also great getting it sent through the post when required other wise it would probably have doses forgotten due to having a very busy lifestyle.

records.title: Easy to set up the subscription
records.text: Easy to set up the subscription, good value for money, my dog loves his calming treat!

records.title: All good all the time
records.text: Always come through when it’s time for cat meds and one of the few products that works and doesn’t irritate the cat. Plus the subscription is cheap as chips - no excuse not to keep your feline friend flea free and happy. Would recommend, especially if you’re rubbish at keeping track of time or are wasting money on cheapo pound shop flea gear :D

records.title: Complete peace of mind that I get my…
records.text: Complete peace of mind that I get my dog's flea & worming treatments on time once a month without having to remember to order and at a fair price!

records.title: Issues with shipping but very helpful & issues was resolved :)
records.text: Had issues with shipping (probably because of the time of year) but itch helped update me & already issued me a refund due to the length of time it has been since it was shipped. Lovely customer service, I believe it was leigha I spoke to via WhatsApp & they couldn’t have been more helpful & attentive. Thank you very much :)

records.title: It's made very personal
records.text: It's made very personal, our dogs are referred to by name, their medicine is labelled and itch company keep us informed when they need their medicine by sending it to us. I'm very pleased with it all.

records.title: Itch is the best product to control…
records.text: Itch is the best product to control fleas, the service has always been excellent and I would recommend them to other pet owners

records.title: flea treatment…
records.text: The flea treatment has arrived in good time and the price is excellent Spot on treatment may not be the best for my dog as it's very hard to find skin on his low neck area as his coat is so dense but will persevere

records.title: Good product but subscription not so cheap ould help to be a little more…
records.text: Would help to be a little more competitive I've stopped subscription as I could the same product cheaper with your company on Amazon but cheaper  !!?

records.title: Flea treatment is good
records.text: Flea treatment is good, maybe a tad expensive when you have more than one pet, no discount for multiple purchases!Recently there was a hiccup where my payments kept going out because of a glitch, after contacting their main office this was rectified within days and I was refunded. Overall happy with the service

records.title: Nice (but no warning about added free treats)
records.text: Great customer service, overall easy to manage subscription, but a bit fiddly if wanting 3-month wormer intervals (does seem to be offered yet). However, no complaints about the wormer -- unlike previous oral wormers, my cat didn't notice the wormer tablet in her food and ate all of it. She also helped herself to the free treats that came with the last delivery, shredding through the packaging. For cats who are finickity eaters, it would be nice to have an all-in-one spot-on product available that tackles fleas/ticks and worms (i.e. similar to NexGard COMBO).

records.title: Customer service is very good.
records.text: Customer service is very good.Unfortunately I am out of pocket for postage and packing as I received a package without warning that I wanted cancelled. It was too late for cancellation so I have to return it. Before receiving a refund… this is all fair and square but I wasn’t prewarned or reminded that the subscription was due…and to be refunded costs me postage !

records.title: Thankyou
records.text: Thankyou. It's working

records.title: Fab concept, finding great so far!
records.text: Really simple to order, quick delivery, effective treatment and great set of instructions inside, along with very simple application process.Love the personal touches in/on each box and the fact a lot of it can be recycled or used (my daughter used the name stickers to decorate her bedroom door).My only minor negative is the smell. It smells almost fishy and it's not pleasant. But that soon wears off.

records.title: I have been very happy with Itch.
records.text: I have been using Itch Pet for some time and have been very happy with the service.  However, my dog passed away this week.  Going to the site to cancel his subscription it was quite difficult to do so, having to go through requests not to leave etc.  There didn't seem to be any consideration of the possility that a pet has died and THAT'S why you are cancelling.  I would suggest that maybe they add something to make it easier in future for those whose furry friends have recently passed away.

records.title: Easy to manage subscription
records.text: Easy to manage subscription Have seen a big improvement on flea reduction however still not completely flea free (3 months in) Did start with a non itch household spray on the first month. No issues with the cat wormer, but the dog wormer doesn’t agree with my dog. He’s puked it up on both occasions. Bought treats this month and the cat loves them I’m hoping it improves her skin/coat but early days

records.title: Convenient and affordable
records.text: Convenient and affordable. Very good customer service when there is an issue. I'm still struggling to get the Fleas under control but it's early days so will keep going. I like that it doesn't bother the cats when you apply it like other products. They barely notice you've done it.

records.title: This is only my second month of using…
records.text: This is only my second month of using Itchpet on my cats. I’m yet to feel totally confident with the product as we have had such a problem in getting rid of fleas using other products previously. Up to now my cats seem pretty much flea free. Hopefully this continues and I will happily give a new rating of 5 stars.The delivery has been punctual and is very easy to apply. Has an unpleasant smell when you first apply but it doesn’t last very long. Cats don’t seem to mind having applied which is a bonus.

records.title: Good
records.text: Really good, fast service. Only downside was the dog names were mixed. Not a problem as weight and size is on the packet but was a good job I was observant to spot this having 4 dogs of complete different breeds ranging from a mini dachshund - large cockapoo.

records.title: Item arrived fairly quickly (problems…
records.text: Item arrived fairly quickly (problems with Royal Mail) it was packaged with our dog’s name on it. Clear instructions and information. Our dog has had no side effects will definitely use again!

records.title: Good service shame it didn't work though.
records.text: The service is great unfortunately the items I ordered did not work very well on my dog, I have tried numerous different types of spot ons and they have failed also.

records.title: Generally good.
records.text: It's easy to order and quick delivery. Applied to my cats once I've received the flea treatment. Unfortunately, they still have fleas.

records.title: syncing data
records.text: With the cost of living crisis, it would be helpful to have an exact date that ITCH are going to take their monthly fee. Also to have the treatment/merchandise arrive in sync with said payment.

records.title: Don't really like them
records.text: Don't really like them, the products havent worked in the past.Thought I'd try them again as I can't make it to the vets to pick up their version of the treatments every month.Do not like the personalised packaging at all;I think it's a fair price though.Generally I'd say try this after the supermarket brands have failed.

records.title: It's a great idea to get it delivered…
records.text: It's a great idea to get it delivered every month, so you don't forget to do it.Unfortunately the flea treatment didn't really work for my two boys, and I stuck with it for a couple of months. But in the end had to buy frontline plus, to erradicate the fleas totally. Thats the only product that actually worked for me, and believe me when I say I've tried every brand 😏. However the wormer worked fast, can't fault it.I have currently stopped my subscription, due to the flea treatment failing to work for my cats. But they are a great company, and for people who forget to flea and worm their pets. It's ideal

records.title: Prompt service in posting products out…
records.text: Prompt service in posting products out but it is on the expensive side and I'm not sure it's totally reliable

records.title: one out of two cats...
records.text: One cat likes the anti-itch treats and they seem to be helping her. The other hates the taste and I can't get him to eat them, even hidden in other food.

records.title: I ordered itch for my 2 cats
records.text: I HAVE SINCE RESOLVED MATTERS WITH THIS COMPANY AND THEY WERE VERY FAIR.  HOWEVER I DID HAVE 1 POINT REGARDING REFUNDS WHICH I HAD TO ARGUE.   THE PERSON REPLYING WAS VERY POLITE AND RESPONDED DAILY.  I HAVE BEEN ISSUED WITH A REFUND OF MY POSTAGE AND PACKAGING FOR WHICH I AM GRATEFUL .....I ordered itch for my 2 cats, I have used flea treatments for 20 years , I decided to give this new company a go as they wete offering a free trial.   I administered the treatment on both my cats who have been successfully treated their whole lives by myself......I popped it on at the skin between shoulder blades ....NO EFFECT WHATSOEVER,  fleas still on the cats and very lively. I simply gave feedback to website.  I have been asked many many questions as if it's my fault when all i really expected was "perhaps this treatment does not suit your cats and possible a refund in the postage and package,  but no, simply constant questions that I've already replied to. I shall not be purchasing more, I'll go back to advantage

records.title: Didn’t work for my cat and dogs either
records.text: Didn’t work for my cat and dogs either, after trying this for two months, bathing them, washing and cleaning everything multiple times, had to go to the vets and get prescribed treatments. But even more annoying is that they kept taking payments even after I had cancelled. Have written to them. Currently awaiting a refund (hopefully). ***UPDATE*** customer service got in touch and have issued a refund very promptly. It seems when you cancel you probably need to also contact customer services to ensure it is done. Fair play they refunded straight away once i’d sent proof of return posting to them.

records.title: Sadly ineffective
records.text: I have to say the website service and delivery were great and convenient, and the questionnaire thorough, but sadly the spot on treatment wasn’t effective against fleas on our cats. I got some calming treats, which two of our 3 cats will eat. One has gone off them.

records.title: I like the product and its worked..but well
records.text: I like the product and its worked well. However time between taking money from my account and delivery is a joke....over a week, meaning my pets each time go over the recommended 4 weeks between treatment. The 1st order I placed was here in 2 days when it was free so doesn't make sense. I never hear delivery updates from them and constantly have to chase where my order is. Real shame as it ends up making me anxious thinking the fleas will be returning as delivery is never on time.

records.title: Ineffective
records.text: Although this product seems very appealing due to the low price and monthly subscription, I would not recommend. We stuck with the flea treatment for three months but alas, our cats were still flea ridden. We ended up taking them to the vets for treatment and it cleared up right away. However we did find the carpet spray very effective and will buy that again if necessary. If you are struggling with a bad flea infestation I would go straight to the vets. It may be more expensive but there's a reason for that!!

records.title: don't ask for reviews without checking whether the item has arrived!
records.text: the product (flea repellent) is fine but Itch kept asking me to review the product, but it hadn't arrived. It was very late being delivered, due to Christmas period. Maybe ask people whether their item has arrived before asking them repeatedly to give a review?

records.title: First dose only ok
records.text: The product is essentially good ,but only lasted about 2 weeks before cats were itching and biting again .All instructions followed hoovered and sprayed whole house .Maybe another dose maybe be better but not doing great at present .

records.title: Several teething problems…not the time saver I thought it would be.
records.text: I ordered subscriptions for my two cats at the same time. They arrived on separate days so a huge waste of packaging. I’d ordered an Itch flea spray but was sent a generic brand that I could have bought much cheaper. Month 2 - my payment declined and it looked like the expiry date has changed…despite month 1 payment being correct. So have now broken the cycle of flea treatment as my delivery is going to be a week or so later than it should be. I got Itch expecting it to be easier than buying it in the shop every month but so far it’s been a bit of a pain. I’m hoping the products and service improve within the next few deliveries or I’ll probably cancel my subscription.

records.title: Still waiting for scoops treatment
records.text: Still waiting for scoops treatment

records.title: Im giving it 3 because even after using…
records.text: Im giving it 3 because even after using the flea drops on my pets theyve still got fleas, im going to see if they work the next time and maybe they just needed another dose to help. I have used other methods too and nothing seems to be working

records.title: Great product- bad service
records.text: The Itch products are great but unfortunately the subscription and fast delivery just isn’t efficient.  I thought by subscribing that my treatments for my pets would arrive on time or before the day they were due.  Payment is always taken on the 8th of the month, the treatment is due on the 12th of the month but it never arrives and I have to keep chasing the  order.  It’s now the 18th and it still hasn’t arrived.If Itch could get the delivery right I’m sure it would be a great service but unfortunately for me I’m left disappointed.

records.title: Great product - rubbish delivery
records.text: Whilst I'm happy with the products, delivery leaves a lot to be desired. It's difficult to keep flea and worming treatment up to date when Royal Mail deliveries are so haphazard.

records.title: Fleas despite treating several times since April
records.text: My cat is an indoor cat (British blue - no common sense!). I have been treating her with itch pet as a preventative measure as she was in a cattery in June for our annual holiday. A week after collecting her from the cattery she was showing signs of fleas. I treated her again (3 weeks after her last treatment), thinking if she has them they wouldn’t last long - itch kills fleas in 24 hours apparently. Thoroughly vacuumed the house, washed all bedding etc. She still has fleas - in varying sizes so varying stages of life despite the treatments. I ordered some more but having checked her with a flea comb and pulling out 11 fleas, she is now off to the vets to get something that will hopefully work. No doubt itch works for some animals but sadly not ours! Have cancelled my subscription.

records.title: It was a good price bit long term is…
records.text: It was a good price bit long term is quite expensive especially with multiple pets. £21 for two cats is a lot when you can play less at other competitors. My cats were sick with the worming tablets bit since swapped brands my cats have been fine.

records.title: Itch take payment but last month I…
records.text: Itch take payment but last month I waited 2 weeks before treatment arrived. This month payment taken on the 8 th. Still waiting for treatment to arrive. Come on itch get your act together and post same day as payments are taken.

records.title: I have used the flea treatment for years
records.text: I have used the flea treatment for a few years now however I don’t think it’s working as good as it used to as my dog is still getting fleas. I have swapped for a product from the vet. I also used the free advice/question option but I never heard back from anyone and my question went unanswered.

records.title: The packages have been delivered…
records.text: The packages have been delivered through my letter box which is great, I have not had to chase this. I have received 2 packages so far (December/January) unfortunately they have not eliminated fleas, my animals are still struggling even though I have bathed them, changed beddings and hovered my entire house and furniture but they are still present.

records.title: Flea treatment
records.text: Flea treatment - great because it doesn’t have a really strong smell but it said it claims to kill adult fleas in 24 hours yet over 30 hours later I’ve combed out 28 (and counting) adult fleas.Will go to the vets in the future for this treatment.Worming treatment however has worked well so far.

records.title: Again no product arrived despite it…
records.text: Again no product arrived despite it being a monthly subscription!!!They haven’t taken the money yet, but they have previously still with no product arrived!!!

records.title: I've used itch twice I'm awaiting the…
records.text: I've used itch twice I'm awaiting the 3rd lot they still seem to have fleas

records.title: This did not work for my cats
records.text: This did not work for my cats, or my best friends cats. Never have they had fleas until now. I loved the idea of a subscription delivery service and the marketing is top notch- however the subsequent clean up has been very expensive. Fleas did not appear until 6 months in. It may work for you.

records.title: No longer effective
records.text: Been using for about 9 months, initially worked fine. But the last few months have been horrific, maybe lasts 3 weeks before she’s crawling again. I’ve treated my house, makes no difference. Fleas become immune so if the formula isn’t changed it stops working. I’ll be visiting my vet to get this infestation under control

records.title: Not help
records.text: Not help. Use 3 months no results.

records.title: I haven’t tried the products yet but…
records.text: I haven’t tried the products yet but ordered the flea, worm treatments and the spray. The flea & worm treatments are ‘itch’ branded but the spray is ‘Virbac’ Indorex Defence Spray and completely different branding, so im sort of confused? Instructions are both the same on the bottle and ‘itch’ leaflet but feel like I’ve brought the same product bottled up as something different or just a completely different product.

records.title: 6 months with no effect from their flea treatment. 1 months of advantage and my cats are flea free
records.text: Cannot recommend their flea treatment at all. I was using itch flea treatment for the last 7 months and yet my 2 cats were still suffering from fleas. I'd sprayed the house vacuumed more often and applied the treatment on time but nothing seemed to stop them. Everything I read online suggested that it could take 6 months to get on top of it so I waited hoping it would work but it just seemed to get worse. Then I switched to advantage and boom a month later I haven't seen a single flea for 2 weeks and counting. I think whatever active ingredients they use are just not as effective as their competitors.

records.title: Flea treatment didn’t work and not recommended by my vet
records.text: I wish this worked as it’s a reallyconvenient system, but unfortunately the flea treatment did absolutely nothing. When my vet pointed out how bad the fleas were and I told them I was using Itch they said they have never had any customers find success with it. Might be a localised problem but regardless. I also tried the worm tablets but they were absolutely huge!! Way too big for a cat, I had to cut it into small pieces which was a real pain. Finally, I found there to be a lack of communication with delivery, I was often unsure when/if it had been delivered/dispatched. The flea spray for the house did appear to work, however, I can’t be sure as we stopped the fleas with different products.

records.title: I set up a monthly subscription and the…
records.text: I set up a monthly subscription and the first month arrived but then I realised (after being asked for my feedback) I hadn’t had the second month. Only been 2 days since I flagged but waiting to find out why.

records.title: I cannot say am that impressed
records.text: I cannot say am that impressed , treatment has not worked on my cat or dog so thinking about cancellingNot really up to me to contact you, I appreciate this is just standard response sent to everyone

description:
Individual, caring and respectful cremation for your beloved pet.

When the time comes to say goodbye to our beloved pets, we all want them to have a loving send off.

At Tranquillity pet cremation, we have been pet owners all our lives. We understand that they are more than just a pet and are a member of the family, so we understand the sorrow it causes when we lose them.

We offer a caring and easy service, where you get to choose the final journey that is right for you and your pet.

records.title: Truly amazing service
records.text: Truly amazing service, they made a really difficult time just a little less difficult. Thank you

records.title: Our Sad Day
records.text: 20/11 we had to have our Ruby put to sleep.  Peter from Tranquillity Pets treated her with so much respect and never hurried us as we were very emotional.  He provided her with own little basket and  blanket and he wrapped her up like a baby  she looked like she was asleep.  The service from start to finish was exceptional and we would highly recommend them.  Thank you so much for making a sad day into something that has created a little memory that she had the best!!!

records.title: Kindness at a horrible time
records.text: We experienced a very prompt, sensitive and efficient service. Peter was extremely understanding, which is so important at the time of losing a beloved pet.  In our case we were in shock at the sudden and unexpected loss of our dog, and the help and advice we got from Peter was very much appreciated.

records.title: A very caring service
records.text: A very caring service. Peter was so kind & reassuring that I felt safe letting my Rosie go with him when he collected her. All pets are individually cremated and the ashes can be returned to you at home. Would definitely recommend.

records.title: Piece of mind
records.text: I was very sceptical with making sure my little boys transition was going to be as personal as possible, once I had spoken to Peter I knew everything would be ok, this guy has gone over and above in every way to help both my family and our boy. It’s so vitally important to make a connection like this to help you through this hard time. Highly recommended.

records.title: Highly recommended
records.text: Unfortunately we have had to use Tranquility twice this year.  Peter has always been great and I would highly recommend Tranquility when the sad time arrives.

records.title: Respectful and Individual Service
records.text: In our moment of sadness, Tranquility were a comforting and gentle experience. They acted at short notice to receive our beloved Dylan dog. He was cremated individually so that we have his ashes. And everything was done with the upmost sympathy and respect for him and for us. We would wholly recommend Tranquility as a quality and respectful service.

records.title: Compassionate, personal service…
records.text: Having first used Tranquillity's services earlier this year, we sadly had to call upon Peter again and he was yet again responsive (being available with less than 24 hours' notice) and most importantly to us, as a family, he is kind and compassionate and provides a low-key personal service, at a time when it is needed most. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Peter and Tranquility Pet Cremation to anyone, in the sad circumstances of saying goodbye to their family pet.

records.title: Highly recommended
records.text: They were very fast to respond, kind in their communications, quick and reliable. I had my dear dog back in three days and in a really lovely package. Would certainly recommend.

records.title: Caring & compassionate service
records.text: Peter offered the most caring and supportive service. It was exactly what we needed, at an incredibly difficult time for our family. I immediately trusted he would look after our gorgeous Indy, as if he was his own dog and I would highly recommend Tranquillity. Thank you again Peter!

records.title: Not professional
records.text: After ringing several times and just an answer phone we were disappointed, eventually someone answered and I was told they weren’t doing any cremations as they were moving! No message on the answer phone and nothing on your website! I was told you would ring and explain to my partner, you couldn’t be bothered to even do this. I’m afraid you have lost us as customers as I prefer someone more professional. Although I like to support local businesses, this time and in future I shall be using Dignity.UPDATE:Reply to TranquilityYou did not ring back at all. I eventually managed to get to speak to someone when I phoned!! You only mentioned Dignity, which we already have used twice before, so had no hesitation in going back there again. I have now come across another Pet Crematorium which has come highly recommended. We wanted to support a local company this time, but at a very sad and upsetting time you let us down

description: Veterinary in-home hospice and end of life care for pets. Our team of vets offers home euthanasia and hospice consultations. We are an independent veterinary practice with a team of mobile veterinary surgeons in the Midlands. We specialise in compassionate consultations for hospice care and dignified home euthanasia.

records.title: Dealt with care.
records.text: On the 27th December we had to say goodbye to our beloved German Shepard Romeo.I made the call to Dignipets to arrange an home visit. Lucían came to us and explained the process with sympathy and empathy for both our dog and us. He did not rush us and allowed us to say good bye at our own pace even after Romeo closed his eyes for the last time Lucían sat quietly giving us all the time we needed. One of the hardest times of our lives Lucían and Dignipets made it that little bit easier. No animal owner wants to go through this but sometimes with animals we have to for them.A big thank you to Lucían and Dignipets.

records.title: Highly recommend.
records.text: Having made the heart breaking decision to help our 15 year old pooch cross the rainbow bridge, staff at Dignipets were patient and understanding of how devastated we felt, whilst we discussed the plans we needed to put in place.  The next day Paula the vet arrived – she was so professional and showed such compassion, keeping us fully informed at each step, and nothing was too much for her.  She took time to meet Harlie first meaning Harlie didn’t get distressed.  Throughout the visit Paula was discreet, sitting in an adjacent room, giving us lots of privacy to say our goodbyes. Nothing was rushed, and the whole process went so smoothly, giving Harlie the send off that she deserved, in the comfort of her own home, surrounded by family.Whilst we had the option for Dignipets to take Harlie away on the day, we chose to spend an hour alone with her before taking her to a local pet crematorium called Willow View meaning we got to see her through to the end.Thank you Paula for the respect and kindness that you showed us all, but in particular the respect you showed for Harlie.

records.title: Thank you Paula for giving our pet…
records.text: Thank you Paula for giving our pet Aggie the best care possible at the end of her life, so much better than going to the vets surgery. No pressure on time, every step was explained in detail, we said our goodbye in our own time.We would recomend this excellent service.

records.title: Heartfelt thanks
records.text: We cannot convey our gratitude to Jamie enough. He was so reassuring and explained every step beforehand so we knew exactly what to expect. Our boy was always particularly nervous but he was completely calm throughout and fell asleep peacefully. Thank you so much.

records.title: A peaceful goodbye
records.text: I was devestated to have to say goodbye to my beloved dog .. my companion for 17 years. The thought of taking her at the vets (a place she always disliked) so that her last emotions were fear and stress was heartbreaking. I was recommended Dignipets by my vet. Jamie came to the house and was respectful and empathetic. There was no pressure or rush and when we were ready, he did what was needed and she drifted away with her head on my lap, being stroked and soothed into the journey over the rainbow bridge. Thank you Jamie for your care and minimising a traumatic event as much as possible

records.title: Dignipets review.....
records.text: Just a few lines to say how much we recommend the service Dignipets provided. A big thank you to the vet Heather for helping us and answering all our 'stupid' questions, for treating our beautiful 15 year old Rough Collie Charlie with the love and respect we wanted him to have in his own home. A traumatic and upsetting  time was made as  easy as we imagine it possibly could have. Highly recommended.

records.title: Compassionate and supportive
records.text: Dignipets have time to speak to you in this very difficult decision to say goodbye to your companion.  On the day Jamie was very compassionate and gave us time, there was no rushing in saying a dignified goodbye.  Would highly recommend.

records.title: Caring and dignified
records.text: Our pet died peacefully in his bed in front of the fire with minimal disruption.  I was there to offer comfort if needed.  I intend to recommend this option to my family and friends.

records.title: Bruce
records.text: Your vet, Bruce, was amazing this morning. It was a kind, caring, thoughtful experience, even though it was one of the worst times in our lives.

records.title: Human animal angels
records.text: Came time for Teddy to cross the Rainbow  Bridge. Heather arrived to personally help Ted on his walk.Professional is. an understatement  So humane, so dignified  and humble during the transition. Cost was so irrelevant  to what Heather brought to our lives this morning . Not enough ways to share the experience to others needing a bridge walk soon. Human angels!

records.title: The loss of Buddy
records.text: Waiting for the vet was awful. I’d have hoped to be kept more informed about arrival time! Instead of being told between 8am-6pm. I appreciate they can’t know about emergencies BUT… Once Lucian arrived the process was really kind, informative, caring & professional. Giving us time & space with Buddy.

records.title: Home Euthanasia for my boy with Dignipets
records.text: My boy Wolf was the smallest chihuahua with the most beautiful spirit unfortunately his heart murmur turned into heart failure and he began to really struggle to breathe and sleep. When medication stopped helping I decided the kindest thing to do was help him cross over rainbow bridge. I’d decided I wanted him to pass peacefully at home but unfortunately my own vet was unable to help so I called Dignipets. Stef the vet called first thing on the morning I’d decided it was time to let wolf go. She worked round us for the best time to come out, she eased my worries and was so very kind on the phone. Stef then came out that morning and was lovely. She gave us space when we needed it and explained everything that was going to happen. Stef handled Wolf with such care. The only thing I would have changed is wolfs first injection made him a little upset but then injections aren’t nice for anyone.After his first injection that sedated him he fell into a peaceful sleep and felt no more pain. He was fast asleep when the final injection was given and felt nothing when he passed dying peacefully in my arms surrounded by family and our other dog frank. Stef was so very good with us. She cleaned wolf up, cut some of his fur for us for a keepsake and wrapped him beautifully in one of his favourite blankets ready for him to take his final journey to the crematorium. Grateful for the care and attention from Stef at Dignipets

records.title: Disappointed and heartbroken
records.text: I have had dignipets recommended to me many times.  When a dog I bred needed to be put to sleep, I recommended them to the owner.  Rang at 7am.  Was told unable to give a time but would be before 5pm.  We have arranged with the crematorium to take this beloved little boy there and booked their last available appointment.  Still waiting.  I appreciate the nature of this makes it very difficult to give exact times, but this is a difficult enough time, without waiting about not knowing.  At the time of writing we are still waiting and this boy little boy is suffering.  Disappointed.

records.title: If I could post no stars I would
records.text: If I could post no stars I would - we contacted dignipets on Monday as our family lab was obviously at end of life. We had rang in advance and given our details to try and ensure the process went smoothly when the time came. After making the call on Monday, we were told they couldn’t reach their local vet but would continue to try and that we’d eventually get a call back. 2 hours later and the call never came, we had to approach another local vet to come and assess his condition and carry out the euthanasia.God awful service, still yet to receive a call. Avoid at all costs.

records.title: Left without an answer
records.text: We contacted Dignipets on Monday evening as we needed support to make an incredibly tough decision to put our beloved family dog of 14 years to sleep. My partner had previously called them for advice and they’d been reasonably helpful so we took this route again after our usual vet recommended this also as they had no emergency appointments. We called Dignipets on Monday evening and were advised that they couldn’t get through to the vet/person they needed but, someone would call us back. We never received a phone call. To this day, on Friday, we’ve still not received a call. Thankfully we found a local vet (Medivet Oakengates who were exceptional) who contacted us within 30 minutes to carry out this tough decision. Whilst I appreciate services are busy, to not receive even a courtesy call to let us know they were unable to support, when you’re discussing decisions of this nature is poor. It’s really distressed my Grandmother, whose dog was the poor dog in question as she felt that Dignipets didn’t care about her beloved friend as should be expected by an animal/veterinary service. I think it’s important for this to be raised so it can be investigated as to whether this is standard within your service and if so, whether it can be addressed to avoid upset for others in the future. I appreciate that this may have been a one off experience but, I feel compelled to share as I can’t imagine it’s something you would want a repeat of as a service.

description: Established at London Heathrow airport 1966, Airpets quickly grew to become the UK's leading pet travel agency.   Over fifty years later, Airpets remains a family run buisness ...

records.title: I recently made a cross-country move…
records.text: I recently made a cross-country move from San Francisco to Orlando, and Airpets made what felt like an overwhelming process incredibly smooth and stress-free. My dog, who has severe separation anxiety, had only ever traveled in the plane cabin during the ESA era, so the thought of putting her in the cargo hold had me very nervous. Driving cross-country wasn't an option for me since I don't have a driver's license, so I needed a reliable pet transportation service--and Airpets exceeded all my expectations.From the start, Airpets was there every step of the way, addressing all my concerns and making sure my dog's journey was as safe and comfortable as possible. Here's what stood out:+They ensured my dog was on the same flight as me, which was a huge relief.+They booked her on Alaska Airlines, a pet-friendly airline with a strong reputation for handling animals well.+They guided me through purchasing the right crate and provided detailed instructions on everything we needed ahead of travel, including vet-signed forms.+They promptly answered every one of my questions--and I had a lot! Responses were always within the hour, which gave me peace of mind throughout the process.+They handled door-to-door pick-up and drop-off, working with local pet transportation services. The person from Dogument Travel who picked up my dog immediately put me at ease, and I was thrilled when she arrived at my new house just five minutes after I did!Thanks to Airpets, a process I was dreading turned out to be seamless. I'd 100% recommend them to anyone needing to transport their pet, whether by air or road. They truly care about the pets in their care, and their professionalism and expertise made all the difference.

records.title: Brilliant
records.text: Brilliant. 5-star experience. Thank you to everyone at AirPets (especially Sophie) who put our minds at ease moving our little Jack Russell from the UK to Australia and made the move as seamless as possible. He arrived safe and sound and I couldn't recommend this company enough!

records.title: Really good
records.text: Trying to get your pets abroad yourself is very tricky! I found out the hard way.  But then I found Airpets and it took so much of the stress away. I would give them 5 stars but the only thing that was  the communication whilst setting things up wasn’t as good as I would have liked. I wanted to talk to someone but I had to keep messaging through the invoice/ticket which was tricky. I felt that for that amount of money, I would have liked more direct communication, explanation of the process and quicker responses so that I could plan my own corresponding journey. As it turned out everything did work out perfectly exactly as they had predicted so it was me worrying. However just a bit more reassurance would go a long way with our beloved pets. Overall it was asmooth experience.Be aware that there may also be fees for a customs broker and also a cargo fee at the other end (USA). This added about £400+ to the final cost

records.title: Very good and professional service from…

records.title: Our beloved GSD and Springer joining us in Costa Rica on our Adventure
records.text: The idea of Shipping our 2 dogoes from the UK to Costa Rica had filled me with anxiety. The only part of our relocation is hat did. I found Airpets service so helpful. Taking care of everything from the moment our dogs were dropped off at Heathrow to the moment they were delivered to our hotel in San José. records.title: Good company

records.title: Overall it was a good service and would definitely recommend them to anyone
