records.title: The team was very helpful and Organizer…
records.text: The team was very helpful and Organizer the process to ensure the safe arrival and delivery of our dogs

records.title: Terrible experience with the cargo company at destination
records.text: (Update)-------------------------------------------------------------Quickly after raising my concerns, Airpets contacted me. As the reply to that review, they do not have control over which cargo company handle the pets once at destination, the airline companies do. So, British Airways was the airline company my pets flew with, and they use Mercury Cargo.For information, the Mercury Cargo warehouse is also IAG Cargo so if the airline company you use work with them, your pets will be handle like freight shipments not live animals. -------------------------------------------------------------(Previous review below)I shipped my pets with Airpets from London to Los Angeles. While they are very nice and professional people (friendly when I dropped my cats, offered me to send me updates through WhatsApp), nobody mentioned how pets are handled at Mercury Cargo (company they work with at destination, LAX).  Prior to the travel, I was told by email by a Mercury representative to come get the paperwork at 1930 the day of the flight, go get a stamp from the U.S. Customs and come back to pick up my cats. So, I did come at 1930 to get my paperwork, and they told me to come back at 2100 as it was not ready. Additionally, no one explained to me that I had to sign up to "get in line". The pets are NOT kept in a climate controlled room and they are left on wooden palettes in the middle of forklift machine moving freight around, in a freight warehouse not an live animal allocated room.The great reputation Airpets has might be because they often take care of the entire trip, which means pets owners get their pets at their door and so they don't see this. My cats peed themselves (which did not happened on longer trip in the past) and were in shock to have been handled the way they were handled, plus they were waiting next to crates with barking dogs (I understand that the dogs barked, I love dogs. They were crying as they saw their owners waiting). Why would Airpets people be so amazing and do such a great job at departure to then allow such situation at destination? I do not understand.

records.title: Repatriating Guinea pigs UK to Canada
records.text: I am repatriating to Canada at the end of August and I had to get my three guinea pigs home. Trying to sort this whole process in the middle of a pandemic was an absolute nightmare as most of the airlines that usually fly guinea pigs as animal cargo weren’t taking any animal bookings, but airpets made the process quite easy and a lot less stressful. I dealt with Jake and he was an excellent agent and very helpful. I will admit I was quite demanding and definitely not the easiest customer to be dealing with due to the stress of trying to plan a move and the repatriation of my pigs during a pandemic, so I was a bit of a nightmare myself, but Jake was very understanding of the circumstances and was always as polite and helpful as possible. The process was actually very simple once we got the airline to agree to fly the pigs (that was the hardest part), and it was very straightforward. Thankfully my province didn’t require any kind of special import permits for rodents so I just had to deal with the documentation airpets sent and then the vet certification, all of which was easy to do/obtain. Make sure to check with the Canadian Food Inspection Agency about whether or not you need permits for your animals based on their final destination. There were some issues with the airline/Vancouver airport facilities which made it more stressful than necessary, but those were mostly due to COVID complications and were not the fault of Jake or airpets. However, DO take into consideration that most airlines are not flying regular schedules or taking advanced bookings at the moment because of potential schedule changes. I was only able to officially book their travel 14 days before the travel date for these reasons, but as I had been in contact with Jake since June it was very straightforward once we were allowed to book as I had already completed all the necessary documents. But do be aware that there are delays and changes with the airlines themselves. Also, there may be extra fees from the airline/airport facilities that will be added to the already hefty sum of animal cargo. Flying any animal(s), no matter how small, is very expensive. It’s the safest bet to add a bit more money to your budget in case of extra fees. I wasn’t aware of some of the fees until booking as they came from the airport facilities and were affected by the route the pigs were flying. When I arrived at their offices on the morning of their flight I was given as much time as I needed to personally set up their kennel how I wanted it and say goodbye, and was not rushed by any of the employees who all seemed genuinely interested in the pigs and wanted to know about them. I’m very thankful I wasn’t rushed because I was very anxious about them travelling, especially as they were going on a few days ahead of me and being picked up by family upon arrival. The environment was calming and I didn’t feel any pressure to speed up, even though they obviously had a schedule to keep to. They were very good about this and I appreciate it greatly. I was informed via email when their flight took off from LHR and then was sent photos the following morning (due to time difference) of them in their stayover cage at the Vancouver airport facilities (their domestic connection was the next day), which was very reassuring. The only reason I haven’t given 5/5 stars is because there was no information given to me about collection and I had to ask when and where they were supposed to be collected right before they arrived, but otherwise everything went smoothly and better than I imagined. I gave Jake an update (per request) once they were collected and he seemed very happy that they had arrived safely. The pigs arrived safely and seemed only mildly peeved about the long travel (two flights ~13h total plus a stayover) and are happy and healthy and were eating their food and exploring their temporary set up as soon as they got home. A bonus is that the Canada customs charge for my province was a lot lower than expected. They are apparently acting like their normal selves and seem to be otherwise unaffected. I couldn’t find any reviews about Guinea pigs/small animals flying with airpets so I thought this might be helpful to anyone else who may have to travel with their small animals. I was very weary about them travelling despite having read other peoples’ stories about travelling with their pigs and them being fine, but as I couldn’t find a review for airpets about guinea pigs I was very anxious. I hope this might ease someone else’s anxiety in the future. Overall I would highly recommend airpets to anyone needing to move their pets out of the UK as they tried to make the process as stress free as possible for me despite the whole situation being an absolute nightmare. Thank you so much airpets and Jake!

records.title: We chose Airpets for the relocation of our French Bulldog from the UK to the USA
records.text: We chose Airpets for the relocation of our French Bulldog.  We moved from the UK to Pennsylvania in the US.  We felt that after reading the reviews, seeing the Instagram page and after talking to ..., that they would be perfect.  Some issues were out of their hands such as the heatwave that hit all 3 airports our pup would have to go through - LDN Heathrow; Turkey and IAD Washington.  The communication from ... at Airpets was not consistent and we would have to initiate all contact.  We saw that this had been picked up on in some previous reviews.  Once dates had been set, Airpets were good enough to collect our pup from a new location as we had already moved to the US.  He was collected on time and the vet check was done quickly with emails sent to confirm this.  The A-Z Broker kept us informed.  We were disappointed with the photos we received.  Reviews all comment on the great photos and videos.    All we got were some photos of him looking unhappy and eating from a food bowl that had been left in his wee patch.  We understand that he was flying with the Turkish Air handlers, but Airpets states strongly about their good rapport with all airlines handling the transport.  This did not feel like that at all.  Almost as though once he left Heathrow Airpets were not bothered.  Choice Aviation handled the last stage and we were appalled at how we were re-united with our pup.  He was left in his crate with a view of us, he was crying and howling.  Despite being an hour early to pick him up and the flight running 58 minutes late, Choice Aviation were unhelpful and did not appear to know what they were doing.  We were made to wait and fill out paperwork that could have been done earlier, the staff dealing with us had no idea how to use the system, in the meantime our pup was getting distressed and we were not allowed in to see him.  A lovely member of staff came to our rescue and went to comfort our pup, then took over to complete the release quickly.  Thank goodness he knew what he was doing.  We were then given another issue and that was getting him out of the crate.  He had been cable tied in, understandable, but we were told that they could not cut the ties or give us anything to open it.  My husband ended up ripping them off with brute force.  To end it all we then had to rush our pup into a public toilet and wash him in the sink.  Where he had got so distressed he ended up covered in his own feces.  We expected after a 10 hour flight he would need a clean up, but not to this extend.  Overall we are disappointed with the image that Airpets paints for itself as we feel we saw none of this.  Jake stepped in at the last minute as ... was ill, his communication was better but did not make up for the whole experience.  My husband is currently putting a complaint together direct to Airpets.

records.title: Impossible to get a call back or to…
records.text: Impossible to get a call back or to have them return emails

records.title: Transiting through LHR
records.text: This was the 4th pet agent quote I got and it seemed reasonable plus good reviews online. I was travelling from Iceland and just forced to transit  through London to Ireland because of covid.If I was reviewing on just exports I would give 10stars and full credit to Lee Fisher as he did a great job prompt clear and detailed quote, fast reponse emails, last minute change to crate dimensions and he delt with it professionally without a problem for me, even taking after hour call to confirm payment etc for travel the following day. Imports email agent replies were slower and caused me a lot of unnecessary stress on the actual day of travel. Because of covid I had a logistical nightmare of balancing days and the pet agents didn't believe me when I tried to explain it so here it is. New covid rules since June 8th meant I had to be in and out of the UK again within 24hrs so dog and I were booked to fly the next morning because there wasn't enough time to clear him between same day flights . Iceland doesn't issue eu passports because they are not in the EU only health certs, you can't collect that until the dog has had the worm dose within 5days of travel needing to factor in the 24hrs extra to get to Ireland for the health cert to be valid til final destination. And only two flights per week out of Iceland plus the vet is closed except emergency and the dept of agriculture also closed over the weekend.  I had prechecked myself with the dept of agriculture in Iceland, the UK and Ireland and all said health cert was valid even for transiting through the uk. I should have checked with the animal reception center at Heathrow because officials there claimed it was an outdated annex/health cert and not suitable insisting on getting  the UK pet passport issued but this was not made clear to me until I called the animal reception center myself. The Airpets agent emailed at lunch to say dog has arrived and is a bit thirsty but all OK. 30mins later she messaged me to say they can't find all of the dogs paperwork (which icelandair cargo had taped to the crate) I didn't get a reply so 30mins passed and I sent another email and got a reply from a guy called Jake to say the authorities at larc were not happy with the paperwork(oked by the vet in Iceland and I had to go to the department of agriculture in Iceland for the final document all oked by them) and needed confirmation from the vet on iceland. -This new agent did his best with the mess he was handed. He was my only point of contact in the company on the day and unable to tell me exactly what was needed but he did give me contact phone numbers which enabled me to get it all sorted eventually. This became a time sensitive issue it was now 4pm and at 5:30pm the out of hours vet charges kicked in. The vet secretary in Iceland could not find the rabies vaccine number,I resent the copy to her I had given to Airpets already. The arc wanted a new document signed by the vet who was out on an emergency call. I spent from 3:30-8pm between phonecalls and emails to the vet in Iceland to the animal reception center and to Airpets. The pet agents clock off at 5:30 also and the manager Lee has the out of hours phone and he had a day off. He wanted to change the flight to another day later and do it all in office hours. Not listening to me when I said it could have been done within office hours today and I am supposed to go into 2week quarantine and I live 5 hours from Dublin Airport so the next day travel was not an option for me. He didn't like my tone, he had his first day off in three weeks, and nobody at the pet agents was responsible for this avoidable mess or willing to do what I had hired them to do -Get my dog from the Icelandair plane to the aerlingus plane on the date planned and as requested. Between 3pm and 8pm I had to call and call to get the information needed so my dog would travel with me as planned. Around 7pm after 4hours of asking, demanding,a little shouting and begging I just broke down crying on the phone to Lee F who had wasted his evening trying to persuade me otherwise. He went into the office on his day off and sorted the whole thing within 20mins. Again, full points for his work but the evening was unnecessary and a total waste for all involved. If I knew at 2pm exactly what was needed I could have helped the vet in Iceland. It worked out really expensive for me 720pounds for something that should have cost a lot less. I am sure they are a good company just there were delays and changes on my side plus this outdated annex nonesence and not enough active staff in airpets on the day I needed them. They need a seperate out of hours duty manager to ensure continuity and so the manager can take a day off. And in all the pet agencies they have seperate import and export agents rather than one case worker taking responsibility. In the end my dog travelled as planned and I aged considerably.

records.title: Don't recommend
records.text: I, unfortunately, and surprisingly, had a negative experience with Airpets despite all the good reviews. While they helped move my dog from London back to Bahrain, there was a great lack of communication throughout the whole process. Documents were not read correctly, several miscommunications, and it was very hard to reach Kelly by email or phone. The crate made for my dog was also not comfortable and up to standard, and all felt last minute despite starting this process more than a month in advance and me requesting to see the crate ahead of time (with no reply).  I previously moved from Bahrain to London with my dog and had a much better experience with a different company. With Airpets, my dog arrived quite shaken up and she was soaked with urine. I usually avoid writing a negative review but I wholeheartedly cannot recommend Airpets and don't feel they cared about my dog's well-being.

records.title: Sadly disappointing
records.text: We had hoped to write a glowing review of Airpets, they had impressed us in the early stages of the process, but unfortunately our dog's journey to Canada was not what we had expected and their subsequent handling of the concerns we raised did not feel appropriate.  We were not given any information or paperwork to enable us to collect our dog on arrival at Calgary.  This meant there were delays and a lot of running around once we landed before we could collect our boy.  This was incredibly stressful, after an eight hour flight, for both us and our dog, and could have been avoided.  When we raised this matter with Airpets they said they had recommended using a Canadian agent in their early paperwork, that we had received some months before.  We should also have been provided with an emergency contact number, that we didn't have and there appears to have been a little bit of slight of hand with the truth regarding the sending of customs documents (Airpets said they sent them, we didn't receive).  When we raised our concerns with Airpets they were slow to respond and only gave us a full answer after being chased.  This was disappointing as it suggested a lax approach to after-care. I have read the glowing reviews of Airpets and this is one of the reasons we are so disappointed with the service we received.  It appears they can do an exceptional job when the right people are working on your case, but when the wrong people are involved, there is a general lack of responsibility and communication.  This is the first time we have taken a pet on a plane with us, and we made this abundantly clear to our agent at Airpets, the assumption however was that we would manage a lot of the arrival matters ourselves and would somehow know how to navigate the customs process.

records.title: Dog transport to another country
records.text: When I initially phoned them to book my dog all was good but then my problem started because from then on it was all through Emails and no matter how hard I tried to get through to speak to them it was impossible as I find if I was able to speak to someone all my questions could be answered in one go rather than going back and forth One time they answered the phone I said it was urgent and could Kelly phone me back but to no surprise that never happened and again I got an Email And in one message I was told that the vet didn’t know what they were talking about and as the are the shipping agent they know more than the vetbut I did have to go to the vet and get the paperwork in Greek for the dog just as the vet said The only plus was when I actually took the dog in to be transported to the airport I met the van driver and what a nice person and very interested in me and my dog it’s just such a shame that the office workers don’t come over the same So for me it all fell down with the customer relationship as having that one to one phone call would mean so much to me personally Thanks Gerald

records.title: UK to US
records.text: I’ve transported my pet across the ocean before and had excellent service, unfortunately this was not it. This is an expensive endeavor and I had to consistently work to draw out the necessary required information.  Although responses to my Enquiries were quickly returned, the very fact that I had to consistently Enquire for details and updates was frustrating. My previous experience with other companies (similarly priced) was much more hands-on with a portfolio of information provided up-front.  I did not experience the more personal touches meant to reassure pet owners. Upon arrival in the US my pet was not let out of his kennel after the flight plus an additional 3 hour wait to receive him through customs.  I realize it might be difficult for these companies to control this aspect, but I was flexible on which airport we flew into, based on previous experience I anticipated receiving expert advice on pet handling and the reputation of those accepting the pets, this has always been part of the service I have received previously.    It is worth every penny for the peace of mind and care taken of my pet from the point I release him to having him returned to me.  I felt this was lacking and yet priced the same.

records.title: Some good aspects but overall service very poor
records.text: We booked AirPets to help fly our dog from England to Colombia a couple of months ago. They were one of the more reasonably priced options that we found and we were immediately assigned an agent to support us with the process. Communication wasn't fantastic with this agent, while they always responded promptly, I had to do a lot of chasing to find out what was happening and I felt I was only supplied information when I asked for it whereas I would have liked the agent to be more pro active. When it came to our dog actually flying Airpets were great in their communication around both collecting her and how she was doing at Heathrow airport. However, communication was non existent during her journey (she had a night over in Spain before flying on to Colombia) and when she arrived in Bogota she was left in her travel crate over night without being allowed out to go to the toilet and from what we could see when we collected her, with no food or water. It then took us 5 hours to get her out of the airport the next day due to a very inefficient Colombian process, during which time our dog remained in her travel crate and became very distressed. It was my understanding that the service we were paying for would cover the moment she was collected from me until the moment my husband collected her at the other end. Be warned that this is not the case. Once your pet leaves England, you will not hear from Airpets at all and it appears they do not maintain responsibility for them. When I looked back through all the communication we had received from airpets, in the first email they sent my husband with a quote, they recommended arranging a Colombian agent to help speed along the process at the airport here but this was never mentioned again once we had engaged their services and I would have expected our travel agent to offer to help with this, especially if it was important to guaranteeing our dogs well being during the journey. Overall we were very disappointed with the service received and would not recommend them.

records.title: Airpets….
records.text: Airpets….This is my honest review of airpets.At the end of the day they did get my 17kg dog from England to Australia but that is about the only positive really. This has been the most stressful time for myself, trying to get my dog to Australia & I thought by going with a well known company I would avoid any unnecessary stress. I thought wrong. They were pushy for my £3600 & when they received the money I struggled to get a receipt making me feel very uneasy as that’s a lot of money to part with at one time.It felt like I was always chasing them for a reply, They promised me that anytime I needed help with anything just to call, every time I called I didn’t get an answer from anyone at airpets. It was extremely stressful towards the end with the many vet visits & quite a few things went wrong at the vets where I needed guidance, it takes 5 minutes to send me a quick email the day before my vet visit (they knew my vet visit days as they told me to book them) just re-explaining what needed doing to make my life as easy as possible, But the Lee Fisher who was helping me failed to tell me he was on holiday which felt like 80% of the time. It takes 5 minutes to send an email to say your on holiday and give me someone else’s contact.Whenever I did manage to get hold of Lee Fisher, I felt like he didn’t care about my worries & that he really couldn’t be bothered.When all the vet visits were done, and pick up day arrived a man in a black van showed up at my house, I had no idea who he was & all he was wearing was a grey tracksuit. ( he turned out to be more friendly then airpets & answered all the questions he could) but I was expecting a big white van with airpets written on the side of it, cost me £155 for this service, honestly wish I took her myself now, would have saved £105. As soon as my dog was put on the plane I think I’ve had one email but that was just saying that someone else is in charge of her now, Which is obviously very reassuring for me and my family.Haven't heard from them since, they haven’t asked if she’s okay or how she’s doing in Australia.Honestly, I would like some kind of refund, they had £250 off me for doing all this & whatever else was left over from my £3600 & I felt so unwelcome & ignored the whole year of so I’ve been dealing with them.I would never use them again & would never tell anyone to use them.

records.title: Only ‘ok’ barely.
records.text: Only ‘ok’ barely.The positives:- cat arrived safely in Dubai, so technically speaking they did what they said- the price was reasonable, not the cheapest but not the most expensive either- Airpets arranged the vet checks and forms needed without any issuesThe negatives:- complete lack of communication. Our cat had to isolate for 2 weeks due to regulations from the destination country. During the 2 weeks we received zero updates voluntarily from Airpets, and after chasing from our side 2 or 3 times we received 2 or 3 poor quality photos of our cat looking terrified hiding in a box, and that’s all we got during the whole 2 weeks she was there. As pet owners can imagine, it was quite a tense time and it does not take more than 30 seconds to snap a photo of her every 2 or 3 days without having to be constantly chased, to put owners minds at ease.- also no notice to let us know she had arrived safely (she was collected by airpets driver). No notice to say she had settled. Or that she was eating or using her litter tray. Or that she was playing or getting some exercise now and again. Nothing. Total silence except for those few photos when we chased a lot.- poor communication again. I could not get through to our contact at Airpets for the majority of the day despite attempting to call multiple times and sending multiple emails. I was simply told everyone involved is busy every time I called (but I was still receiving email responses in between from the same people who were too busy to take a call). This was when we had been told suddenly there is no direct flight and I was desperate to speak to someone to work out what alternatives we have for further boarding / different airlines etc (see next point).- poor planning and organization.We were specifically informed in writing there were direct flights available to our destination. I had heard this might not be the case due to covid and asked Airpets to reconfirm, and was told again in certain terms in writing that there are direct flights. 6 days before the scheduled departure and halfway through the quarantine isolation at AirPets facility we were told ‘there are no direct flights due to the type of aircraft BA is using on this route during covid, you can pay 2100 pounds for a pallet, or wait and hope BA change their aircraft type (despite covid) or take an indirect flight’. This was extremely disappointing and upsetting. It was too late for us to take our cat back, and we cannot pay 2100 for a pallet. Based on the confirmations we had received prior to booking with Airpets we had proceeded with all our planning. Our cat is an exotic breed snub nose and every flight is risky we definitely did not want 2 flights for her. In the end we had no realistic option but to go for the indirect flights (thankfully she was ok and luckily the weather in the Middle East was unseasonably cool during those few days).So in conclusion ok price, ok delivery for the basic requirements, but definitely don’t expect any communication or regular updates at all, and if you are making any critical arrangements based on information you’re getting from Airpets, make sure to directly call the airlines or other people involved to confirm the AirPets comments are correct before you rely on them or plan around them. We got quite fortunate with the alternative flight availability and luckily our cat got through 2 flights ok but it was quite a stressful few days. On a final note, not a single apology from Airpets when their mistake was discovered (a very ‘couldn’t give a damn’ attitude throughout) and not a single follow up or comment to advise our cat had been loaded or received at the airport. By comparison several of the other relocation companies in the Uk were super communicative and friendly but we couldn’t use them due to their lack of availability for our dates (understandably, they were booked up first). I would try one of the others first before settling on Airpets.

records.title: Irresponsible

records.text: Getting the medication to me was efficient. Big objection to being asked to pay ?£4.00 for you taking my repeat order over the phone. Example when I ring my pharmacist for repeat description I do not get charged .

records.title: Read the description carefully
records.text: I read the description of the product incorrectly so I accept responsibility for making the purchase. Vetimed were good and refunded the money once I returned the goods. That's the good bit. I found their price grossly overinflated and the same product was available from others at nearly a third of the cost. So I would urge others to check, check and check again

records.title: Purchased an item which was the wrong…
records.text: Purchased an item which was the wrong size, had to pay for delivery and to return, so actually lost money. Postage was expensive, but they did issue refund quickly!

records.title: My prescription had to be amended from…
records.text: My prescription had to be amended from 100 to 90 tablets as per your email of 05 April with agreement for a refund - please confirm that this refund was made and when .Otherwise good speedy and helpful service.R.J. George

records.title: Good prices compared to the vets…
records.text: Good prices compared to the vets directly, but very slow delivery times even when I paid more for "express" delivery due to the situation being urgent.

records.title: Very quick delivery
records.text: Very quick delivery, but the packaging was all open when it arrived

records.title: Officialdom gone mad
records.text: Veterinary surgeon made an omission from prescription Vetimed insisted that they were not allowed to verify the error by telephone so forcing me to seek another amended one which led to a lengthy delay in receiving my order simparica trio and not simparica

records.title: contacts and delivery
records.text: the email informing me you did not have any in stock was not seen as it went into spam - it would be better sending a text to ensure it is received to allow customers to reply - also when it was sorted although i had already paid £6.99 for 1-3 day delivery due to the length of time i asked for it on next day delivery and paid an extra £6 only for the item to take 2 days so realistically £12 + was wasted

records.title: Price review please!
records.text: Happy you were able to supply our dogs vital chemo medication but cannot believe the price because you only had the smaller dose in stock.Over £100 more for a months supply makes it unaffordable at 50% add on.Hope you can readjust your price accordingly please.Thanks in advance Lynda Cooke

records.title: Slow order processing.
records.text: Order processing took about 2 - 3 days from placing the order. If you are in a hurry for your pet's medication my advice would be to order about 10 days before it's needed. I was not impressed.`The company responded saying I had opted for a 3-5 day service. I ordered and uploaded the prescription on  27 June 6.55 a.m., had a confirmation on 28 June and email saying it was posted 29th June at 6.27 p.m. I received my order 3 July. A little more than 3 - 5 days.

records.title: Had to pay over the phone as website…
records.text: Had to pay over the phone as website and paying system needs updating. Would not accept debt card , as security on the website and card machine was out of date, I was forced to use my credit card. Please update your security on your website and card machine.Other than that, staff were great.

records.title: The products were fine and sent on…
records.text: The products were fine and sent on time.  However, my dog got to the door as soon as the postman had delivered them and as soon as I got there he had devoured most of the packaging - luckily the tablets were all intact.  He also chewed the invoice which I need to send to my pet insurance company.I requested a duplicate invoice from the company by e-mail but i have received nothing.

records.title: Would have been happier with some…
records.text: Would have been happier with some service over the 10 day Christmas break. Would it be possible to have a skeleton staff to dispatch drugs which are needed for medical problems as opposed to routine eg flea products. Otherwise a very good service

records.title: There were technical difficulties on…
records.text: There were technical difficulties on your website which made it hard to pay for goods. I did in the end speak to the office staff who were very helpful in resolving my payment problem I have used Vetimed for 3 years and never had problems before and happy with the service. I do have another 2 cats to get prescriptions for in March so I hope I don’t get this problem again

records.title: AS I did not receive an e mail…
records.text: AS I did not receive an e mail confirmation of my order I ordered a second amount this is the first time this has happened, then it took five days to be delivered.

records.title: Good product, very expensive, rubbish packing
records.text: We have used this shampoo before and it seems effective. My only issue was the packing it was in a padded envelope and was totally bashed about I’m amazed the bottles didn’t leak. Also fourteen quid for a bottle of shampoo is disgraceful but it’s a lot from my vet! As usual pet owners being taken advantage of.

records.title: Would have been 5 but tracked delivery…
records.text: Would have been 5 but tracked delivery was notified would be delivered between 941am to 141pm sat but turned up 11am weds so waited in on sat for no reason hate wasting my time could have done my foodshop and gone bank so if you say a date and time stick to it massive peev of mine

records.title: I ordered my cat tablets online did…
records.text: I ordered my cat tablets online did everything it said sending prescription by sending photo over.i waited for few days and got no response. I called them up and spoke to a lady.she went to check and came back and told me she will get the vet check it and get the tablets send out.it arrived the following day which was great..

records.title: Delivery service by Amazon was terrible
records.text: The delivery service by Amazon was terrible, delayed numerous times, supposedly tried to deliver at a time when we were at home waiting, then no attempt to deliver the next day, finally arrived, late again.I will not be using Vetimed again, if you continue to use Amazon delivery, sorry, not worth the hassle.

records.title: This time the dog food arrived with protective box incomplete and falling apart
records.text: This time the dog food arrived with the bag unsplit  however this was only by luck. The card board box had fallen apart due to use of inadequate packing tape and provided no protection.  The first shipment of dog food I ordered was packed well with no loss of food or damage to bag - what has changed in your shipping department?

records.title: It never got delivered for 4 weeks
records.text: It never got delivered for 4 weeks. It went back to the post office after they tried to deliver it. I queried had they received it back as post office said was no longer available for redelivery as returned. The company asked me to make enquiries with the post office. But then it arrived in post from the company as doing so. Had to buy from elsewhere in the interim as had run out.

records.title: could do better
records.text: inform people when prescription does not upload correctly and charge a reasonable rate for p&p. On a positive customer service was okay when it happened.

records.title: Poor and inaccurate communication
records.text: This was my first experience of this company. Good prices and quick despatch but zero information that half my order had gone out of stock. Despatch information was misleading as it gave the impression the complete order was on its way. Had to ask where half of it had got to when it arrived incomplete. Responded quickly first time, then completely ignored a subsequent message when the missing item hadn't arrived by the date indicated. First reply was also incorrect - I was told that due to the weight of the order, it had been split into two packages but that had not been advised in the despatch notification, and subsequently, I was told the item had gone out of stock. I've ordered the same two items from various other suppliers over several years, and they've never needed to be split into two packages - total weight was only around 5kg!Needs to improve communication and be more proactive about informing customers if the order hasn't been fulfilled completely. And reply to e-mails!

records.title: Given a two only because the medication…
records.text: Given a two only because the medication came with no instruction or clarification if it was the correct med. just two clear plastic vials not very professional sorry.

records.title: Still have not received my parcel I…
records.text: Still have not received my parcel I know there is a postal strike on when I paid for fast delivery my pet is in need of her medication

records.title: You make a substantial charge for…
records.text: You make a substantial charge for making an order over the phone I just thought about people who can't order over the web? So I would say this makes you a greedy seedy little organisation.

records.title: The product was good ,but the delivery…
records.text: The product was good ,but the delivery was shocking.Parcel left in the rain at end of the drive on a wall for all to see.

records.title: My address was incomplete on the online…
records.text: My address was incomplete on the online order form, although my full address was on the prescription.This was queried the next day by email, then two days later another query about the prescrition.after 4 working days my order had still not been dispatched.So I cancelled the order. Please allow 7-10days for delivery, I have used Vetimed before without any problems.I ordered and collected the medication from Langford Hospital the next day simple and easy.
