records.title: Pet food supplies that look after your pet from head to tails and toes
records.text: I was having issues with finding a dog food that was right for both my dogs and Cost effective . I looked online as another well know company was becoming more expensive . I found Zooplus I gave it ago . They were cheaper than my previous supplier and did grain free . They deliver free the next working day though that may depend on your order I’m not sure . However they have been great iv been using them for five month and am totally happy with the service. They offer the opportunity to build points to use alone or against your purchases . I would recommend this company if you’re looking to change suppliers you might like it . I certainly do .

records.title: Amazing
records.text: Discovered Zooplus a few years ago and wouldn’t buy from anywhere else.  First off is the very reasonable prices.  Our cats are fussy eaters and will only eat a certain make and every time, after a Google search, Zooplus has always been the cheapest.  Also the delivery time - amazing.  Ordered 12.30pm on a Monday and was delivered Tuesday morning.  No idea how they do it, and wish every online retailer were as efficient.

records.title: I've been using zooplus for years
records.text: I've been using zooplus for years. Never got an order wrong. Points reward system means I get to pick free items for my pets. Competitive prices, quick delivery, good range. Will continue to be a loyal customer. Thank you zooplus. I always recommend you to friends. Keep up the great service :)

records.title: Highly recommend Zoplus.
records.text: I have been using Zooplus now for a few months and find them to be very competitive with pricing, staff are very helpful, goods are despatched quickly and well packaged. When you make a purchase you earn points to be able to get free goodies for your pet. Can recommend Zooplus 100%.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Ordered several times now from Zooplus and always great service. Items dispatched very quickly. Great variety. Brilliant prices.

records.title: Great shop
records.text: Great shop! I love it. I have one dog and two cats, and I buy every food and stuff I need in this shop. There are lots of coupons, bonuses, and promotions. But you should have some time buffer for ordering because of delivery.

records.title: Amazing delivery timescales
records.text: I have been using Zooplus for over 12 months after moving from a previous well known provider who was constantly taking up to a week to deliver our pet food. Our German Shepherd has pancreatitis meaning he can't eat shop bought food. We switched to Zooplus and also tried their Rocco gastrointestinal, which is half the price of the original brand we were buying. It's been a win win all round. Our large order has always arrived within 48 hours and the vet says Murphy is thriving on the Rocco gastrointestinal food. I stupidly put my order in late this month, just a few days before Christmas, but it turned up the following morning! I've had nothing but excellent service from Zooplus. I buy all our dog and cat food from them. Delivery time is top notch and I also like their rewards system so I can get little freebies for my parrots. Love this company!

records.title: 24 years of good service
records.text: I have been with zooplus for 24 years and their service has been amazing Good customer support available My only complaint is the delivery company their use DHL is absolutely appalling. The drivers I have had have been rude and don’t deliver to my door leaving me with back issues to seek help from neighbours with my parcelToday for example the drive said “not my job not my problem to bring item to your door “ and walked off Wish we could choose our delivery option ourselves

records.title: Excellent Zooplus repeat service
records.text: I’ve used Zooplus since March this year every four or five weeks for special dietary food for my mum’s elderly cat. It’s priced well and the repeat order service works well for us. It can be paused and amended pretty easily too. Our Evri delivery driver is lovely. She is polite and kind to my mum and despite this firm’s mixed online reviews, for us with Zooplus, they’ve always been just fine.

records.title: Efficient and Prompt
records.text: I called the customer service team today regarding watery cat food in one of the flavours I get for my cat.The lady on the other end of the phone was efficient and very helpful.I've used Zooplus for 3 years now and they have always been prompt and efficient and the issue today the same level of greate service that I always receive.Thank you Zooplus, and happy holidays.

records.title: Deliveries are Outstanding.
records.text: I don’t know about the customer service issues but I am constantly surprised at how quickly the orders are turned around and delivered. If Zooplus can achieve this then why are other companies lagging behind. However, the weight to parcel structure needs to be addressed. Sometimes the contents are too heavy for the packaging which causes bursts.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Always quick to sort out my orders and get delivered in very quick time and the prices of the dog food I order are very competitive compared to the local dog food shops. As long as they are good prices I would recommend them for very good service.

records.title: Update of previous review
records.text: I recently dropped my rating of 5 stars to1 for appalling customer service and the worst ever courier service. A lady called Melody contacted me from zooplus offering a replacement order for free as way of an apology, Melody was extremely helpful and very disappointed at the way things were handled. I did indeed receive a replacement order free of charge. I have only given 4 stars as Evri are one of the worst courier services I have ever come across, I received no delivery date or time slot from them, being disabled my parcels are always heavy because it’s easier for me to buy in bulk, to add insult to injury they delivered my parcel to my neighbour who is 70 years old so neither one of us could lift the parcel. Melody was a breath of fresh air to deal with, she listened to my concerns and understood the problems with Evri, but sadly Evri are still letting Zooplus down.

records.title: Variety of products
records.text: Lots of different products, easy to subscribe without any hassle. The only downside my last item I purchased the package was not sealed properly and they used cello tape. By the time it arrived the box was slightly open and some of loose pouches were missing.

records.title: Good Customer Service
records.text: Ordered 2 15kg bags of dry dog food and paid for via PayPal.I didn’t hear anything back so I checked my account to find my order had been cancelled although they had taken the payment.The exact product I ordered is available but the price has increased. Very poor from a large company and I’m still waiting on a refund .Update credit where credit is due Zooplus are fulfilling the order thanks

records.title: Not pet friendly
records.text: I ordered 96 cans of Encore cat food 1 week ago. After a couple of days they sent it to Evri despite saying initially delivery in 1-2, days. Tracking on site has been totally inaccurate and 7 days later parcel still not delivered. I called customer service saying I desperately needed the food for my cats and had no funds to pay for replacement while waiting. They could not say where parcel is could not get response from delivery company and while kindly offered and provided £10 refund in meantime to purchase cat food it takes 3 days to go into bank. I'm broke. So I've to humiliate myself and ask to borrow money till they sort this mess out. I thought this was an animal friendly site. This is appalling. If I pay over £80 for cat food I don't have a spare £80 to buy more just incase the delivery company chosen by zooplus are yet again incompetent.  While it's a great site, great prices, sorry but never again for me. I work of a strict budget and now I've to ask someone for money because this company continues to use an appalling delivery company.UPDATE I very much appreciate that zooplus have taken my concerns seriously, listening and are acting to ensure this does not occur again. Very good follow up service.

records.title: Quick ordering
records.text: Quick ordering, fast delivery, good price and very easy end to end process.

records.title: What's happened to Zooplus? Get rid of Evri!
records.text: I've been a loyal customer of Zooplus for almost a decade now, and am now actively seeking an alternative supplier for food and litter for my four cats due to recent poor service. My first order, placed on the 24th of November, was cancelled without any communication from Zooplus - it just suddenly appeared as Cancelled on the app when I went to check why I hadn't received it yet. The second, placed on Dec 2nd, 'arrived' today. Evri abandoned it at a random address on a different street nearby for the third time, and my partner and I have just spent the past 30 minutes driving around before finally locating it. The third, placed on Dec 5th (I was getting desperate at this point), has yet to go anywhere or do anything. What's going on, Zooplus? Given the time of year, I've been willing to overlook the slower than usual deliveries, but having to creep around my neighbours' houses trying to find parcels that have been 'delivered' by Evri is too much. My address is not difficult to find, Evri just doesn't care. STOP USING EVRI. You used to offer DPD as an alternative, and I willingly spent the extra money every time I ordered to be sure I got DPD rather than Evri. That option is no longer available. I will not order from Zooplus again if Evri is still the only delivery option. I'll willingly pay more, elsewhere, to be sure my delivery actually shows up. Edit: Zooplus contacted me directly to address this issue, and I feel they handled my complaint exceptionally. My order was compensated, they reached out to Evri to make sure no 'leave in safe place' option was acceptable at my address, and followed up on the cancelled order's refund status promptly. I'm very happy with how Zooplus has handled this, now they just need to give Evri the boot and go back to DPD!

records.title: Wrong item sent
records.text: Order processed and delivered quickly. However i ordered 2 of the exact same type of renal cat food.They sent 1 of what i ordered and a different type of cat food.**UPDATE**I was very quickly contacted by Zooplus regarding my issue. They asked what item was incorrect and have resent out the correct item now.An error to begin with followed up by some very good customer service. I will use them again now after this

records.title: Great shop, with a minor caveat
records.text: Always have a good selection of items, and I’ve had a few  Zooplus Repeat items for a long while. The rewards are nice, but it’s a real shame you can’t add them to your repeat order and have to spend £10 on something random just to get them…Other than that, good service, good repository and good delivery.

records.title: Very slow aftersale replies but price is very good
records.text: Price is good but after sale service is so slow, all you get is messages about how busy they are therefore can not respond to any complaints. With so much choice and good service from other companies I prefer a company that can respond to issues in a reasonable time.Zooplus offered me a refund which is much appreciated but I still think that the price is great and the service would have been great too if any after sales enquiries were dealt with in a more reasonable time

records.title: Do not use if you're expecting cashback
records.text: UPDATED** This has now been resolved and I've received a voucher for future use.  They called me quickly and sent the discount code within a few minutes so i think it's only fair to update my review. I purchased dog food from zooplus worth £118 purely because I could receive cashback of 20% (net of VAT) through Top Cashback.  Zooplus are now denying that I made this purchase via Top Cashback.  I had a feeling this was going to be a problem and therefore I took a screenshot of the deal. Please be aware of this before you decide to spend money with them via a cashback website.

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: A regular bulk buyer of cat food. Prices on the site fluctuate and can be hit & miss; sometimes you can save by shopping around online. However when Zooplus are the cheapest I fill my cart, add in a few cat treats to claim for free delivery and it's a win win for Zooplus and me!  They use Evri to delivery which in our area can also be hit or miss and try to delivery at strange times of the day, and leave parcels outside, sometime all weekend if we're not there, which annoys me.  I have had problems with deliveries but a quick email to Zooplus and everything is re-organised and they offer discounts on your next purchase by way of an apology. If prices stayed the same and the deliveries were stress free, Zooplus would easily get 5 stars from me.

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast delivery.  Decent prices compared to the high street.  Sometimes my cat(s) will suddenly refuse to eat certain boxes so there may be something to look at in terms of quality control and/or storage however this is branded food so would probably be at the manufacturer end rather than this seller.  My only niggle is that in offering ever changing deals the price you pay can vary a lot and you may be better off buying lots of smaller packs than a big one.

records.title: Taste of the Wild
records.text: Been ordering from Zooplus for a few years now. I like that I can buy large sacks of Taste of the Wild and the prices are quite competitive. The shipping used to be better because you could choose a time slot, but I suppose they grew as a company and cannot provide that service anymore. I particularly enjoy earning points to get extra little treats and toys as well as the occasional free gifts 🎁

records.title: Not putting actual ingredients
records.text: I've recently noticed that they've stopped putting actual ingredients under the "ingredients" tab on products and just list the nutritional content (without carbs I might add)..  I'm very cautious about what goes in my cat's food and like to vary his diet and so now when researching what to get I have to do searches on the net to find out which takes ages.  Very frustrating!   If you went by all the descriptions you'd think they are all good?  Fortunately I know what's in things like Felix and whiskers and avoid those like the plague.  I mean they could put photos of the ingredients on the packages/tins alongside the front images.

records.title: Placed already few orders
records.text: Placed already few orders. Last order was take longer then usually to arrive , evri couldn’t deliver it for few days to me even my road was accessible then ended up returned back to the warehouse . But customer service quickly arranged new package to be sent out as they told it was damaged in transit that’s why returned back to them . Customer service is very good at this point but would recommend use yodel not evri for delivery .

records.title: Good prices and good quality products
records.text: Good prices and good quality products. Most of the time dispatched very fast. Only deducted one star as previously had the option to choose the delivery company and always chose Evri as they deliver to the door and don't leave parcels wherever like Yodel which is now the only option

records.title: I love zooplus
records.text: I love zooplus. Efficient. Great customer service. However you get 4 stars because you use yodel for delivery. 3 times I’ve had issues with them. Stating they can’t find my address when in fact I’ve been ordering from zooplus for years. It’s very frustrating. So the issue isn’t zooplus directly but the people you have delivering the goods

records.title: Have been happy with Zooplus in the…
records.text: UPDATE 14/09:  Increased rating due to quick response and solution from customer services. Have been happy with Zooplus in the past.  Unable to get through on phone or online to express how disappointed I am with the latest delivery of 2 x 12kg bags of dry dog food.  The box was split (photo taken) and then upon opening, both bags are split open.  Can someone please contact me.

records.title: Quick delivery and good price
records.text: Quick delivery and good price, however this is my second order with dented tins.

records.title: No problem with the order at all but…
records.text: No problem with the order at all but courier didn't knock on the door when it was delivered and left it out of sight but exposed to the elements. I'll be leaving them a review accordingly. It would help if you could notify by text I don't check my emails as often and missed the notification. It poured with rain and I didn't realise it had been delivered for 4 hours, needless to say the outer box was totally soaked and falling apart making it difficult to pick up and get inside. This was the second time this has happened, a notification by text would be helpful, please

records.title: Confused Pricing
records.text: Confused Pricing - I regularly search for bargains as pet food is expensive .Zooplus have had Beta Purina advertised at a certain price but when you go to the check out , you are supposed to get a discount for repeat orders . Despite electing for that option , the discount has not been applied when you go to pay . The actual delivery is I have to say prompt but you pay for the service .

records.title: My first order I did not receive my…
records.text: My first order I did not receive my delivery but think this was to do with DHL who said it had been delivered but hadn't been.  Had to call Customer Service a couple of times before they sent another order but have still not received my refund for one of the items that was not in stock.  This was supposedly refunded on 18th October and as at 11th November still haven't received the refund.  I have emailed and called and am being told they are looking into it.  Ridiculous won't use them again.

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: I realise I am virtually duplicating the experience of 'Highlander'. Used Zooplus for many years but won't ever again. I placed an order on 12th October and had it confirmed. Realised I hadn't heard anything so tracked order and it was showing 'order cancelled'. Emailed 3 times and still no explanation. Just off phone and been told they don't deliver to my area 🤔. Doesn't explain why they've not bothered telling me and still have my payment from 12th October. Of course they allegedly emailed me and refunded my payment this morning but no sign of either. Very disappointing

records.title: Great company - Poor Choice of Courier
records.text: Great company, shoddy delivery options/serviceGreat company, great choice.....sadly someone decided to drop DPD and use lesser couriers (namely Evri & Yodel). Sort it out, as saving a few pence doesn't help with customer satisfaction.Next Day delivery......despatched 1st March ......delivered 4th March.Would have given 5 star review.....but sadly, all the greatness goes away when the delivery is late and you cannot chase up because the cheap couriers are not geared up for professional service or customer care.Order Number 279813846 should you wish to check what I am saying.

records.title: Poor condition of order when received
records.text: [UPDATED..customer service now been in contact to confirm they have dispatched a replacement.  Confirmation of package now with EVRi for delivery.  Fingers Crossed.] Ordering: no issues.  Dispatch: very quick.  Shipping: Zooplus being let down by appalling delivery by EVRi.  Top of parcel had totally disintegrated as package was soaking wet.  Looked like it had been used as a football in the rain.  Product inside wet, EVRi refuse to discuss telling me to raise issue with sender.  Zooplus Customer Service: so far non-existant.  Contact form filled out requesting replacement and arrangements to return damaged goods.  Automated response received promising contact within 24hrs.  Now the end of the working week and nothing.

records.title: Recent change to Evri deliveries is awful
records.text: We have used Zooplus for years and lice the choice, prices and super fast delivery. However, the recent switch to Evri for delivery is a disaster. We never know when a parcel will be delivered or where it will be left. Being a rural area vans also don't run up here every day. Your previous couriers were fabulous ' please ditch Evri

records.title: They use Evri - be warned
records.text: They’re good for the most part but let down by Evri. Be warned. My parcels from zooplus usually get abandoned outside my house when I’m not home and the most recent one has gotten lost. They offered a replacement or refund but it’s just unreliable still.

records.title: Zooplus good but Evri useless
records.text: I ordered 2 large bags of dog food which Zooplus despatched quickly but for some reason by different couriers. Yodel delivery on time but Evri showed parcel dispatched at 8.59 but by 9.00 said they could not find address although they've been here before!Three attempts to contact Evri over 3 days were ignored. Phoned Zooplus who found out that Evri had lost parcel. Good service from Zooplus but will not use them again if they use Evri as courier.

records.title: Never really had issues with deliveries…
records.text: Never really had issues with deliveries or packaging but have issues with stock availability I'm after wild freedom dry food for my cat but every single flavour is out of stock and I've been after felix salmon treats for Months not weeks and they still don't have any. Not good and may have to go elsewhere. There's no excuse for no stock availability for so long on the same products it's a pet food store sort it out.

records.title: Zooplus offer good deals
records.text: Zooplus offer good deals. I have shopped a few times with them and had great service.  This time my courier was DHL absolutely terrible service.  This is not aimed at Zooplus.  This is a massive courier company that subs out the work because they can't be bothered with the small little jobs.  Which is why the DHL tracking provided doesn't tie up with your delivery.  Mine went out on the van and got took back to the depot un heard off. When they give u a time slot it's not true . How will the person they've subbed it out too stick to that. Worst service ever and now I will think twice before ordering anywhere if DHL is the courier.  Also my box was completely open so bashed you could see what's inside. He tried to hide it when putting it on my doorstep step. The food bags were okay and had survived.  Otherwise I wouldn't have accepted.

records.title: Undelivered order
records.text: My order placed an week ago is still with Evri & has not arrived. Worried I’m going to run out of dog food! Hope it comes soon. It’s normally here within a couple of days.

records.title: Need to be very careful what part you…
records.text: Need to be very careful what part you buy from   Several times the prices are different between the site & the app also if you google the product first you can usually find a big saving link to zooplus. I usually save as much as £10 on a sack of catfood doing it that way

records.title: Easy ordering and consistent…
records.text: Easy ordering and consistent competitive prices but my last two orders of wet dog food have been delivered with over 50% of the tins badly damaged. More likely the delivery company. I have let Ervi know of the damage but have heard nothing back from them.I think you need to look at changing the delivery options available as reluctant to order again.

records.title: Issues with repeat orders
records.text: Whilst the website and app are easy to use and the prices are good. I have signed up for the repeat order and the main issue is when one item from my order isn’t in stock, they still charge me for it. Then I have to go through the process of contacting them and requesting a refund. It’s just a broken process that needs to be fixed but it’s very frustrating as the customer. It has happened several times and the product I order is often out of stock.

records.title: Just list the ingredients
records.text: Tried to send the below via their online contact form which wasn't actually functioning so sharing it here as I don't know how else to get in touch!I find it really frustrating when you don't have the ingredients in a product listed.Why should I have to contact customer service every time I want to know what ingredients are in one of your products? What a colossal waste of time and an annoyance. I tend to not bother and go shop somewhere else.Thought I'd share this feedback in case it's helpful as I'm sure I'm not the only one.

records.title: Part order missing when clearly states paid for other items
records.text: Ordered from this company several times and they’re very good but this time half of my order is missing and I don’t see how you can make a mistake when it’s written clearly and the invoice states what should be in the box and half of it is missing and it’s too late to talk to anybody and it’s really frustrating as I’ve been charged for items not recieved !!! Don’t like being ripped off !!! £3.66 for a tiny 20g bag  of you have 12 tiny 20g bags it will cost you £40 daylight robbery

records.title: Disastrous delivery
records.text: The processing of my order and speed with which it was sent to me was excellent and I have no complaints.  However, the delivery company that you used is a disaster.  The instructions are to leave the parcel in the front porch where there is a lot of room to leave anything.  However, the delivery driver dumped it in a vehicular access lane outside my back gate.  He/she made no effort to walk another few yards to put it into my porch.  I had notification to say it had been delivered to my front porch which is untrue and I spent ages looking for it .

records.title: Poor Service
records.text: Poor. Placed an order expecting a delivery in a few days but had to contact them to see what was going on. Finally received goods a week later.Wonder if they'd have arrived if I hadn't made contact??

records.title: Erratic, useless delivery schedule
records.text: Erratic deliveries and now only half our order arrived. A week later nothing rectified and out of cat litter throughout Christmas despite promises of delivery every day this week.Customer Service showed they don't give a stuff. Taking my business back to Pets at Home.

records.title: We have ordered twice with Zooplus and…
records.text: We have ordered twice with Zooplus and both times the litter has been split open. The delivery was awful, they said it was to arrive on the 9th but we had to chase it up and was told that the depot did not have it even though we had received an email to say they had the package. Eventually received the parcel on the 15th. I don’t think we will order from them again. The stress of worrying if the kittens food will arrive on time and the extra money we had to put out to compensate for it not arriving on time made us feel that we could not rely on them.

records.title: First time users and quite upset that…
records.text: First time users and quite upset that ZooPlus does not own to its mistakes. I ordered a number of items and majority arrived fine, but "Whiskas Temptations 60g - Salmon (8 x 60g)" had 2 of 8 boxes crashed, contents spreading across the box since they were not packed properly but just thrown in loosely into the box with large items in it... Who knew that flimsy plastic packaging would crack? I have sent a picture and raised it with ZooPlus service desk and for now three days there was nothing but a generic emails that they are too busy (or under-staffed) to look into my problem. I expect more from a company that is meant to become my go-to place for buying day-to-day essentials.If it helps to the community managers, order number is 368230674 and service desk ticket #23525733.

records.title: I’ve been a very happy customer for…
records.text: I’ve been a very happy customer for many years, better prices and product selection until recently. There have been a lot of technical issues and the app is basically unworkable. They have made it more or less impossible to redeem coupons. Their loyalty products are now mainly for cats.

records.title: Everything went wrong
records.text: Ordered twice - both times the cat litter was everywhere and had to try and salvage it and put it in a bag; this ended up being only 3/4 of what arrived as the rest was wasted or missing. Very poorly packaged considering the package contents are plentiful and heavy. A simple bit of bubble wrap and more care would have prevented and this on both occasions and would have potentially kept us as a customer. The second time, our package arrived 3 days later than planned as well with confusing and poor tracking available to us.It’s been a very poor first impression and first impressions are incredibly important! Therefore, we won’t be continuing to shop here. Do yourselves a favour and shop elsewhere!It seems Zooplus also decided to randomly cancel our subscription after the first time as well which we didn’t ask for which caused additional faff as our food and litter didn’t turn up when we expected it to, and had to chase up. We gave them a second chance by ordering again, but they let us down a second time!!!An easy and hassle-free experience was expected and it’s been everything but. In summary, it’s honestly been one of the worst experiences from an online retailer we’ve encountered.Only gave an extra star because refunds were prompt.

records.title: DITCH DHL
records.text: I’ve been a faithful customer for over 17 years now and spend at least £250 a month with you. Lately you have been using DHL to deliver your packages and the quality of service is dire. All the packages arrive dumped on the door step ripped open and normally covered in DHL tape. Frequently boxes and packets of dog and cat food are squashed and open.Instead of being pleased to receive our deliveries I now dread it as I don’t know what will arrive damaged. I also have to question why in a large order you pack as many products as you can into boxes that can’t take the weight! I am seriously considering finding another supplier. For our monthly order.  I suggest you ditch DHL very quickly before you loose a lot of faithful customers who order large amounts of pet food!

records.title: Choice of delivery company lets them down
records.text: Dog food is fine, same product available elsewhere but it a good price so I have a subscription.The thing that lets Zooplus down is use of Evri as its delivery company. They give out times but just don't turn up.Delivery between 11 and 1 - you wait until 1.30pm and nothing. A few hours later the tracking says that at 12.30 they couldn't get to you. Why give a time if there is no intention to deliver. And why update this to not coming after it obviously hasnt turned up?Zooplus - bin Evri - this impacts on you. Subscription cancelled.

records.title: What's happened to zooplus :(
records.text: What's happened to zooplus, no order received a week after ordering. Have used zooplus for many many years but think this maybe the last time. Cats left with no litter but now zooplus have my money so cannot buy elsewhere. Fobbed off with emails. Just poor service all round.

records.title: Still waiting for my Order ID: 367475473
records.text: I have been using Zooplus for about 5 years now as we have 5 cats. They have always been quick to deliver my order. However I am now experiencing a huge delay. Put a large order in early last week. The order was split into 2 deliveries as it always is. 1 of 2 parcels arrived quickly. I am still waiting for the 2nd parcel. Tracking says it's delayed through DHL. Spoken to two customer service agents now who were good. Order has been resent but I am still waiting again for this replacement order. It's getting ridiculous. This order is now saying order in progress since Monday. Order ID: 367475473.Zooplus come on you can do better. I am thinking now I will have to find somewhere else to buy my cat food. Original order 26/11/24.Order ID: 366485677I see another customer is having a similar issue with DHL. I am getting very fed up now.

description: From food and toys to expert advice & In-Store services. Find what you need at Pets At Home. The ultimate pet shop experience.

records.title: Excellent Customer Service
records.text: Pets At Home sent my regular dog food order as usual with no problems at all.  However, Evri lost the parcel at their processing hub.  Got in touch with Pets At Home via chat and a new replacement order was arranged in under 5 minutes.  Great service.

records.title: Brilliant Customer Service
records.text: I had an issue with a damaged order, and Amy S. from the live chat team was amazing! She quickly understood the problem and arranged a replacement without any hassle. The whole process was smooth and stress-free. It’s rare to find such efficient and friendly customer service these days. Big thanks to Amy for turning a frustrating situation into a positive one!

records.title: Kira.H to the rescue
records.text: Problem with an online order but Kira.H was amazingly helpful and sorted out the issue quickly and without fuss, she was knowledgeable and friendly, quick to reply on the online help chat, and issue resolved in less than 10 minutes. Many thanks

records.title: Emma thank you for you kind words
records.text: Emma thank you for you kind words, just now I really needed the pick me up, losing a cat or any animal when they are your babies is always heart breaking, thank you for your kind words at such a hard time. Happy New Year to everyone.

records.title: Issue with an Order
records.text: I recently placed an order via the app, part of my order arrived within 2 days but I didn’t receive the rest of the order. I couldn’t get through to an agent via the Live chat so I emailed instead.I had a quick response on Xmas eve and today, both agents ‘Leoni P and Rebecca G’ were very apologetic and gave me an option for either a replacement order or full refund of the missing items. I opted for the refund, incase the replacement order wouldn’t have some items in stock. Within minutes I received an email with the refund summary and then another email from Rebecca G to confirm the refund.I am extremely happy with the efficient response I have received and the customer service was excellent. Keep up the great work :)

records.title: I had cause to contact Pets at Home as…
records.text: I had cause to contact Pets at Home as my order from them had been lost by the courier. Despite the fact that Pets at Home were not in any way at fault, their representative  Chloe Goacher-Huggett responded straight away (despite it being New Years Day!) and despatched a replacement order immediately. Her efficiency was a breath of fresh air.

records.title: Parcel was stolen
records.text: Contacted pets at home via live chat, as my delivery was stolen after being left outside main entrance to my block of flats. Spoke to Paige who was extremely helpful and issued me a replacement 😀

records.title: Excellent service resolved issue with…
records.text: Excellent service resolved issue with courier problems with not received my order. Straight away reordered my order and sent out replacement by priority.  Would highly recommend pets at home for good quality pets food and many more items.Thank you to live chat on app always helpful and resolve any problems occur. Well done to all

records.title: Return Query
records.text: Rebecca G was my advisor and she was excellent in dealing with my query. She answered all my questions promptly and efficiently with clear answers so I know how I can return my items.

records.title: Unfortunately a box of food had been…
records.text: Unfortunately a box of food had been damaged and therefore had spoiled.  Through live chat Amy very kindly solved the problem very quickly and politely.  It is always comforting to know that issues like these are solved within minutes and you can carry on enjoying your day.

records.title: Quick to resolve issues but delivery conditions aren't great…
records.text: I've had a few orders from Pets at Home, products are great and chat service is really helpful and quick to sort issues but boxes are often delivered partially (or today fully) opened with products damaged or missing.

records.title: I made an order from pets at home
records.text: I made an order from pets at home, everything arrive in good time. I bought a jacket as a Christmas present which unfortunately was too small! I first spoke to a lady called Aimee Y and have never received such poor, rude customer service who actually ended the chat when I asked to exchange and speak to the manager. However I then spoke to a lovely lady called Jane S who couldn’t have been more helpful! She has organised a refund for me and to have the item collected from my home as I don’t live local to a store. Thank you Jane

records.title: I made an online delivery for cat…
records.text: I made an online delivery for cat litter which never came so contacted live chat and Phoebe T was great, she told me it had been damaged in transport and could get new ones to me on next day delivery! chat was easy and resolved in minutes, thank you so much!!<3

records.title: Used the online chat today as received…
records.text: Used the online chat today as received a broken item Chris B resolved the problem super quick and sent a replacement out next day delivery

records.title: Great service team
records.text: Great service team. Quick to contact, quick to resolve issues and always fix the problems that the delivery company creates. Only reason they don't get 5 stars, is that it happens on EVERY delivery, and ultimately, it's Pets at home that pack the boxes so badly.

records.title: Discount codes not applying at checkout…
records.text: Discount codes not applying at checkout is a reoccurring problem. Contacted customer service via chat, got disconnected the first time so had to start over which was a bit of a pain. Once got to agent Jake S sorted out a refund quickly. 5 * for Jake S. 4* for p@h for ongoing website problem making customer missing out on discounts unless you can be bothered to chase it up.

records.title: Quick resolution to wrong delivery
records.text: There were some problems with the delivery originally (which was probably rather the fault of the delivery service than with Pets At Home. Due to that, the wrong food had been delivered, and two days later than originally stated. However, as soon as I had complained, I got prompt help (Thanks to Emily Monja and Maheen), and the correct food was delivered two days later. A pick up of the incorrect food was also organised. One minor negative point was that even though I wanted to use the "live chat", this was actually not active, but although I had expected long delays with responses to my emails, these were promptly answered.

records.title: Decent service but could listen more
records.text: Excellent service in terms of resolving my issue, but the colleague on the live chat was not really listening to what I was saying. It was to my benefit (I got some food for free), hence the score of 4 stars, but I told them 3 times that I had received my order, but had also got someone else’s, and they still re-ordered my dog food (which I had received).

records.title: Got a somewhat weird delivery
records.text: Got a somewhat weird delivery - 3 of the 4 requested food boxes, no dental chews - but a bonus of a box of napkin rings!!!  Good customer service through chat - replacement ordered - thanks!  Only 4 stars as the chat times out within 2 mins, after making you wait for 10mins or so - not an issue unless you have other things to do.  Overall great!

records.title: All good in the end
records.text: Ordered click and collect but no progress over following week. Live chat greyed out on the page, couldn't access.Rang local store who tried to help but I needed to speak to the main office.Found the number on internet  0800 328 4204Spoke to pleasant fellow named Benn who apologised. Computer glitch seemingly, meaning it had not progressed.He offered to refund immediately or restart the order. I opted for restart order. It came promptly to store within 2 days. Result. Thank you.

records.title: The delivery was a little messed up…
records.text: The delivery was a little messed up cause they sent me two parcels on one order, but Aimee Y was nice enough to help me sort things out. The one before her wasn’t patient enough to listen to my request and he cut off my conversation. Try getting more nice workers into the business that are willing to solve our problems.

records.title: Delivered my order too early and spoke…
records.text: Delivered my order too early and spoke to Victoria A who was ever so helpful and arranged a replacement for the original date. Fantastic service from her

records.title: Missing delivery
records.text: Saima K in customer services was super helpful tracking down my parcel from Pets at home. After the delivery failed to show on the designated day, and no information was given to me by DPD. Saima replaced the order to be delivered next working day.

records.title: Thanks Chloe S for sorting everything out…
records.text: Thanks Chloe S for sorting out my return and helping me so quickly! Good service there. My only note would be that the actual return service and not being able to drop it off at a PDD is a little silly. Something that Pets At Home could definitely do with sorting out, I would say.

records.title: Customer service decent, problem bad
records.text: Monja was attentive in the chat, but the problem is that the website doesn’t work: I can’t make payments! Have been trying for several days now. It was a big order £800ish. Frustrating as heck! Will have to go to a different company now. Very bad news for petsathome! Fix this ASAP! Losing money…

records.title: Five stars to Zainab at customer…
records.text: Five stars to Zainab at customer services but one star to whoever packed my delivery so badly! Very disappointed that one of the ceramic cat bowls I ordered was smashed as not protected at all in transit in a large box with cat food items.  Zainab efficiently and pleasantly dealt with the problem, checked the item was unfortunately now out of stock and organised a refund on Live Chat.

records.title: Cat litter arrived and all the cat toys…
records.text: Cat litter arrived and all the cat toys were missing as there had been a hole cut in the box it was delivered in. Fortunately I went on chat and notified them and they are sending out the toy replacements tomorrow.

records.title: Missing items in an order
records.text: Missing items in an order Contacted the online help saima did say sorry and weather I like a refund or a replacement I asked for a replacement on the chat there was a new tracking number provided instantly and an email next day ( monday ) so we will see

records.title: Sailma was helpful regarding missing…
records.text: Sailma was helpful regarding missing item and I will be emailed with a new delivery date

records.title: Room for improvement
records.text: I placed an order online, however I immediately noticed that I had purchased the wrong type of food for my dog. I tried to cancel the order right away and place a new one instead, however it is not possible to cancel an online order. Customer support staff was very efficient and helpful with scheduling pickup for my return, however it took way more time to do rather than cancelling the order. I hope this could be improved in the near future.

records.title: I contacted pets at home for a delivery…
records.text: I contacted pets at home for a delivery issue. The agent was very friendly and helpful and supported my request.However, the chat system is terrible, I couldn't see what I was typing as the entry box was under my key board. It was very frustrating please change the system!

records.title: Tropical fish average to poor quality
records.text: I went to buy fish because not so bad prices but was let down by quality of the fish I bought today a number of fish from which i choosed some which are great but some were chosen for me by staff 3 so poorly that they didn't even make trip back home 15min I would advise to stay as close as you can and choose the healthiest fish

records.title: Click and collect limbo . . .
records.text: Ordered toys for my dogs and cat as xmas presents, due to be collected from local store on 22nd December, however no email to even let me know it was running late. However Ethan B on the live chat helped by rearranging it for the 27th. Just as well the animals have no clue what's going abd they'll be made up with their presents a dew days late.

records.title: The policy on buying fish
records.text: The policy on buying fish ! I was very shocked and upset having walked a long way to buy 4 goldfish from the colne branch but was refused purchase as I didn't know how many litres of water my tank held ! Having recently been widowed and have had to change my lifestyle ! Not knowing the amount of water my fishtank holds l explained that my tank was much bigger than the tanks they were holding dozens of fish in ! The manager was most unhelpful and I explained at 70 years old l had kept goldfish for years  ! I was really disappointed with her attitude and although l always buy  food for my dog at the branch  l will not be doing again !

records.title: Will not be ordering again
records.text: My products were separated to make two deliveries, the first box was delivered to a completely different street. Having only a photo of the house I had to go trawling different streets to locate it. Also to cancel my second half of the order and ask for a refund. No offer, no compensation for the anxiety it's triggered having to go to two strangers house

records.title: Our order was damaged beyond repair in…
records.text: Our order was damaged beyond repair in transit. I was told to contact Pets at Home live chat by Pets at Home when I phoned them re order. I tried for 3 days to message someone on live chat but it kept saying that agent was off-line. I decided to email, however when you opt for this it tells you that order queries are best dealt with via live chat and to use this!!I gave up and emailed and thankfully got a quick response.

records.title: Once again repeat order ‘lost’ with…
records.text: Once again repeat order ‘lost’ with Evri !! Why oh why do you keep giving them business ? They used to be Hermes and they were rubbish then! You have now lost another customer as I just can’t rely on repeat delivery arriving - you need to sort this or you’ll go under …

records.title: Leoni P sorted my problem but not to my…
records.text: Leoni P sorted my problem but not to my satisfaction although this was not her fault.   She was prompt and helpful.  Yet again Evri had 'lost' my order!  Evri loses orders regularly  - why do you use them?  Everyone complains about their delivery service being poor and unreliable and it must cost a lot of money to replace goods. Sadly my order was out of stock and so a refund has been sent 5 days time. . .

records.title: Slow and incorrect.....
records.text: Waited ages to get through on live chat to request a refund for an order that did not arrive. Refund was promised but when the email arrived confirming it, it was for the wrong amount. Less than I had paid. I then had to go through the whole process again to ask for the correct amount to be refunded. The advisors were both helpful and friendly but I shouldn't have to contact them twice to get a simple refund. And why can they take my money instantly when I buy from them, but slow coach for 3-5 working days when they owe me money?

records.title: Issue with delivery
records.text: Issue with delivery. Should have arrived 1st December but still haven’t got it over a week later - no updates provided. Would have given 1 star but Chris B on live chat has sent a replacement order with priority delivery so he/she gets 5 stars, giving an average of 3.

records.title: Customer service is Meh
records.text: I like using pets at home instore and online only downfall they need more approachable staff not people who are just there for a job.Little bit concerning when you walk up to someone asking for help and it seems they can't be bothered and flip their hand up and go over there somewhere 🤦‍♀️

records.title: Worse delivery company ever
records.text: Worse delivery company ever. Free delivery if you order over 50£ but you will not receive all your items. I am happy that I got my money back and that why I gave 3 stars.

records.title: Evri let Petsathome down again
records.text: As with other customers my problem is with Evri - they keep failing to deliver my orders. The online support from Petsathome is excellent but sadly the staff are left apologising for a delivery service they can do little to change! Again the Petsathome staff are great.

records.title: Contact about a missing dog bed from…
records.text: Contact about a missing dog bed from order . Was told they would send a replacement , which has not been recived , have been told again that another replacement is to be sent out ...... will it arrive !!!!!Call handle was help full Phoebe Taylor-Hulston,

records.title: Your helper Kylie was great.
records.text: Your helper Kylie was great.Your company has let me down recently and I have had to waste my time dealing with getting my subscription delivered as requested.   Perhaps it is your computer system.   I will try again as my cat needs the product and I am not near your shop.It is amazing that your system never has a problem with getting my payment, isn’t it

records.title: Wrong product received
records.text: I recently signed up to a repeat food order subscription. My first repeat order arrived promptly however I did not receive the right product. I used Live Chat to resolve the problem which was very efficient and I should have wrong product collected and replacement arrive tomorrow.....fingers crossed!!

records.title: mixed - great service but dead fish
records.text: they are very good in telling me what the fish I've bought need etc, however I have had 2 experiences with them dying now, customer service great but not sure about quality of the fish

records.title: Evri went wrong but Domenica B sorted…
records.text: Evri went wrong but Domenica B sorted it out so they get ****Evri are useless and incompetent- why are pets at home using them?

records.title: Good customer service
records.text: I have ordered online before with no issues. This time the courier failed to deliver my next day delivery. They notified me that it was out for delivery then 4 minutes later 'we were unable to deliver your parcel today'.Still no sign of delivery the following day so contacted PAH. Jonathon C was able to tell me straight away that my order had been damaged in transit and offered replacement or refund.My items are now on their way and I have been refunded the delivery charge. Happy with how PAH have handled the situation - Evri - not so much.

records.title: Let down by Evri delivery
records.text: Ordered on 11th November, for Evri to cancel my delivery on 14th due to damaging the parcel beyond repair.I then had to go to Pets at Home customer services to resolve (why there isn't an automated process for this), who arranged priority next day delivery. Bear in mind this was at 11.55am on 14th, re-order confirmation. Evri didn't acknowledge the parcel until the following day at 10.30am saying they just received it. So it didn't arrive on 15th (next day). And no sign of my delivery on 16th either.Evri tracking just says "we've got it". I'm losing hope of it arriving.

records.title: Evri for delivery
records.text: Evri for delivery! Ordered food for the dog online 2 or 3 weeks ago and still waiting for it.  No help from Pets at home customer service. And of course no service at all from Evri. Hopefully my dog makes it ..70 mile trip to the shop it is then I guess. Pretty terrible service online. Usually okay in the shop

records.title: Useless customer service
records.text: Went in to cancel a repeat order.  2 days later, order was placed anyway.  Contacted customer service to cancel the order, was told that they cannot do that until it has shipped.

records.title: The subscription service is normally…
records.text: The subscription service is normally good but not this time, I have been issued a refund which is good but Saima K got my name wrong which referred me as a female really annoyed me!!!

records.title: i bought  2 bags of dried dog biscuits…
records.text: i bought  2 bags of dried dog biscuits 50.00 pounds  only 1 came i rang the store who couldnt help me there no phone number to call try chat that was a waste of time no good enough pets at home  i think i go somewhere next time i do have 4 dogs

records.title: Order
records.text: Sadly, I needed to change my order from, 'Click and  Collect', but that was not possible due to the circumstances. Leoni P was not as helpful or efficient, as I wanted him to be.

records.title: Change your delivery firm before you loose more customers
records.text: Second time using the subscription plan to order my dog food. First time delivery was late. Second time it’s not arrived and no idea where it is. It’s been out for delivery for two days. Both times sent by Evri. Evri are useless to try and contact. Leon at Pets at Home was brilliant and gave me a refund but this review is on the business not her. I’ve now decided after being a loyal customer in store and online for nearly 9 years of my dogs life that this experience isn’t worth the hassle. I’ve found a local store with a cheaper product but with all the same ingredients and I’ll be going there from now on. I’d suggest that you move away fromEvri delivering your parcels before you loose more customers as is evident in the reviews on here that explicitly name the company.

records.title: 13 days for a refund
records.text: Took over 12 days to receive a refund on an online order that was allegedly ready to collect however one item wasn’t there. The lady said she would give me a refund went on the chat next day to check and they confirmed. Day 11 no refund went back on chat and they asked what it was for? And how much? Useless day 13 received my refund so the two imbeciles before this didn’t do their job. I’ll still shop in store but never online again, I’ve deleted my account and no more donation card all because of their negligence. Old fashioned way now pay by cash, yes to a receipt and no I don’t have a pets at home card. No I don’t want one.Disappointed in pets at home

records.title: Store 2 star, Yasin on live chat 5 stars
records.text: Customer service in store wasn’t the best, they forgot to send me my repeat subscription of flea treatment for my cat, never received my November dose, went into store early December, spoke to a lady who rang the distributor people, they said they would resend that day and I would receive it the next day, never received it again… however spoke to a wonderful lady called Yasin on live chat customer service today and she dealt with my problem in less than 10 mins, my order is being resent,and she severely apologised. I didn’t want to go back into store to ask again so Yasin saved me a journey and a worry. So 2 stars for the store (Keighley) but 5 stars for Yasin.

records.title: Not delivered
records.text: Bought a couple of items from here for my dog, first item arrived and it’s ok I’m. Couple of days and the second item 342135958 has not arrived and cannot find anywhere on website to state this problem, should really have known when it said that evri was delivering.  Have to stay with Amazon for next day delivery in future !!

records.title: I had an issue with my subscription…
records.text: I had an issue with my subscription order that I paid for in November , was due beginning of December , so I spoke to somone on live chat, Dominica B and they weren’t helpful at all, and just decided to transfer me to somone else , and then the next person wouldn’t help me and just ended the chat. So I went back on their and somone called Jane S who was very helpful and managed to resolve the issue for me .

records.title: Definitely recommend!
records.text: Such a great and personal service from a fab company. Easy to chat with customer services via WhatsApp. Were so helpful when we adopted our pup and helped tailor make his food subscription. One of our orders got lost through the courier and they sorted out a replacement straight away with a little freebie as an apology

records.title: Super dog food with smooth & easy interactions.
records.text: Simple, guided introduction taking into account Teddy’s individual needs. He adores all the flavours of his “meaty chibks” suppers  as well as enjoying the kibble. Customer Services have been nothing short of “brilliant” especially when I’ve asked daft 🫣 technical questions about managing my online account. (Thank you for your patience & support).

records.title: Top Customer Service
records.text: Hayley checked a late delivery and also reimbursed the delivery fee and added two free boxes on to my next order. My dog has hypoallergenic food so it’s important he has what’s right for him. The good customer service ensures this happens.

records.title: My dog loves the food
records.text: My dog loves the food, he eats a lot more now (generally finishes his meal!) and comes monthly which minimal issues. At one point, he wasn't enjoying his food too much so I spoke to Tails and they changed the flavours around and we're now back to normal :) The only thing would be delivery, however I'm just going to put it down to the festive period and see how it is next month.

records.title: Wish we’d changed to Tails sooner - couldn’t be happier !
records.text: Tails communication is incredible - loads of individual contact and support as we transitioned into the new food regime- it was easy and clear but most importantly to note is the drastic positive change in our pooch’s gut. We’ve tried lots of other food. His toilet has improved so much (it actually looks like sausages - no more messy cow pats! ) and way less flatulence! He is on a mild weight loss journey and hasn’t even noticed ! Couldn’t be happier and would definitely recommend. Delivery has always been on time.

records.title: Worth every penny
records.text: Our Labrador pup was on a generic breeder recommended food when we first got him but he always had a bad tummy and not very nice poos. We changed to Tails 3 months ago and this has transformed things. Not only does he love it but all of his tummy troubles have completely gone and we now have a very happy pup. Highly recommended

records.title: Change your dogs life for the better!
records.text: I love the way Tails.com blends your dog good especially for your dog. Giving you, the owner a choice of what's important for the well being of your fur buddy.You have the freedom to update your pets information and their special blend of food is tailor made to meet these changes.You have the flexibility to change your delivery date or even pause it if necessary. Excellent value for money too.

records.title: Keeps our dog Happy

records.title: Great product
records.text: Great product, my dog loves the kibble and it's helped with his digestion issues and stiff joints due to getting older but now he seems happier and healthier even his coat looks better,

records.title: Food delivery
records.text: It's so helpful to get delivery dates and be able to go in and edit your dogs account. Be it to change delivery dates or update your dogs profile. Communication is the key.

records.title: I really do love tails.com as I start…
records.text: I really do love tails.com as I start this review. It has been a brilliant company for food for my dogs and the food has digested well by them. Furthermore, the CS is fantastic, and I have used them ongoing no fuss with three years of loyalty.The reason I am now leaving 3 stars and this can be subject to change depending on feedback. But given the rising costs over the past year or so, it's getting quite pricey to afford the food. My dogs don't settle as well with their kibble so I usually order only the wet food - my biggest complaint is that in the past tails.com have responded to me stating that they don't just do wet food offers as that is not their specialism. However I do disagree that due to the growing market of dog food, I have seen their wet food being promptly sold on the shelves. It would be incredibly benefical if tails.com could take into account their consumers who wish to purchase only their wet food but at a more affordable cost.This could be treated as a running subscription equally with fair discount. Or otherwise, something auto set-up so we don't have to always check to order. I just don't think it's very fair that myself should miss out on a fair price given that my dogs don't settle well with their kibble. Likewise, there should be a loyalty system now. There are many other companies employing this type of structure to makes things more affordable and stick to brand loyalty.Side note: Again feels incredibly unfair to constantly pay postage for the wet food amount I order. You really should be offering the chance over a certain amount to have free delivery. Little things do add up.

records.title: Evri issues & no customer service
records.text: Our monthly dog food delivery has been lost, but no one is interested in helping. Evri is borderline useless, Tails simply brush off our issue with “it’ll turn up. Your automated customer service process is dreadful. I will be stopping our subscription we’ve had for 5 years, as we need a reliable process.Update: to be fair to tails, they eventually got in contact (thanks trustpilot) and sent another box via yodel which arrived the next day. The fault is with evri who just refuse to deliver our box, which is just bizarre.

records.text: First time trying Tails and to date there is nothing to review. Well over a week I have been waiting for the delivery and to date nothing. The courier just says wait another day. Contacted Tails yesterday and today about the delivery and apart from an automated reply nothing. Not even a sorry to hear that your experience has been awful. Rethinking my subscription if this is how your treated.Small update: After a good bit of time tails finally answered and made steps to resolve the issue. My Thanks to Becca made sure that my dog got the order. So far he is loving it.

records.title: Disappointed with Tails
records.text: Disappointed with Tails. When the first order arrived I discovered that both my dogs weight had been incorrectly recorded - therefore the portion sizes were completely wrong. I emailed (alas there's no phone/person) and a little while later this was responded to - not fully resolved. I adjusted all the details online and re-jigged the portion sizes. Today I went on the site to consider re-ordering and checked again that although the weight was recorded correctly  the calories per day for both dogs was way too high! It's frustrating Tails say they take the guesswork out of this, but I've found this hasn't been the case for me! My toy dog likes the food - but she's a foodie anyway, my senior dog is ambivalent. With so many glowing reviews I'm a bit confused that my experience hasn't gone as well. I like the process and delivery, and the idea that the food is tailor made - but given the issues to date I need to think carefully if I continue with Tails.

records.title: Trying to starve the dog!
records.text: A week ago I’d have written a glowing review but despite 4 emails I have have no delivery. Whoever decided to remove the telephone line needs a new career! Alas, if you reply to this review as you have the other about no delivery, then why can’t you respond to an email? Update….infonally heard from Tails and they have sent a new box via DPD and 2 packets of treats for Bailey. Thank you. I have changed the star rating from 1 to 3 to reflect this. description:
From modest beginnings in Enfield as a single store in 1971, Jollyes has now grown into one of the leading pet food superstores with over 100 locations across the UK alongside a market-leading position in Northern Ireland.

From Perth to Plymouth, Newry to Norwich, at Jollyes customers can find anything for their pet, from pet food, pet toys and an array of pet accessories.
Customers are actively encouraged to bring their pets into store, while customers shop because Jollyes people are passionate about pets.

Potty about puppies and crazy for cats, no matter what the animal, store colleagues are always on hand to help with anything from product advice, to picking the perfect pet and accessories.

Many stores also run community clinics offering vaccinations and other advice from trained vets. And if one of Jollyes stores isn’t close by, there’s helpful advice on Jollyes website where you can ask the expert. 

Jollyes was named 2023 Pet Retail Chain of the Year at the Pet Industry Federation Awards and was named best retailer under £250m turnover in the 2024 Retail Week awards.  Earlier this month it was also named for the first time as one of the best big companies to work for in the Sunday Times annual survey.

A full list of stores and advice for customers on owning a pet can be found at www.jollyes.co.uk. 

Don’t worry if you don’t have a store nearby, you can shop and find helpful advice on our website.

records.text: I’ve only given this review a 3 star as had another pretty miserable experience with Jollyes in Eccles again. I can honestly say that I have seen more personality in a Chapel of Rest than I have witnessed from staff (not all mainly the store management) I would have scored a 1 but some of the team are great it’s just a shame they aren’t always working. When there is so much choice of retailers and the domination of online this store really doesn’t understand the concept of loyalty of customers. Would I shop here again? ABSOLUTELY NOTWould I recommend? ABSOLUTELY NOTAdvise to the staff (non management) LOOK FOR ANOTHER JOB/EMPLOYER

records.title: Staff were lovely and helpful
records.text: Staff were lovely and helpful. However, the reason for our visit was to purchase a cat harness and collar as we have just moved into the area and there were no collars in stock and the only cat harness available looked unsuitable for our cat.

records.title: Great Store, But Cats Deserve More Love!
records.text: I love shopping at this pet store because everything is so easy to find, and the staff is always approachable and ready to help. They’re knowledgeable about the products and genuinely care about their customers’ pets, which makes every visit a pleasant experience. However, I gave three stars because I feel there’s room for improvement, especially when it comes to options for cats.It’s great that you’ve added refrigerators for fresh meat, but why are there only options for dogs? Cats deserve the same level of variety and quality, but right now, their choices are quite limited compared to dogs. I hope to see more cat-friendly products in the future because otherwise, this store is fantastic!

records.title: Not had vouchers for a while
records.text: Not had vouchers for a while, we went for a big spend on doggo treats.  About a third of the natural dog treats we looked at were not price labelled so we didn't buy them all that we were looking at. We did pick up a couple of none priced items and found they were more expensive than other places we go.  Please clearly label your stock. Also, no dog jumpers in during winter. We have got a few from elsewhere now.

records.title: Not brilliant
records.text: The first time we went they were very helpful, this last time the assistant wanted us to buy an opened bag of food saying it would be fine, how did we know if mice or rats had been in it, she wasn't very helpful at all, at the York store,,,

records.title: Your staff need to make sure that the…
records.text: Your staff need to make sure that the items that are in the baskets near the till display the correct prices , I brought 2 items that said £2.50 each when I got to till and paid for all the items I had brought and checked my receipt later I was charged £3.50 for the said items , this is not the first time this has happened,  it is one of the reasons I don't shop here often

records.title: Standard visit, nothing special.
records.text: I recently visited the Chester Greyhound store and have since received multiple emails from Jollyes asking me to leave a review. One request would have been sufficient, but I was sent several.The store itself was fine, but nothing particularly noteworthy. I found the prices to be a bit higher than expected, and the staff didn’t come across as especially friendly or helpful.Additionally, I’d like to mention that the review link provided in the emails appears to be trackable. I’d much prefer non-tracking links when businesses ask for feedback via email.

records.title: Staff aren’t as pleasant or as helpful…
records.text: Staff aren’t as pleasant or as helpful as the staff you had previously. I was always helped out to my car with the big sack of dog food even if I said that I was ok. It would be nice to be asked if people would like help to their cars with awkward items. It does make a difference as I will be shopping at a different store that always asks if I need help, sometimes I do and sometimes it’s ok.

records.title: Varied experiences
records.text: Visit to the local Jollyes store is usually a good experience. The staff are pleasant although a little over zealous when trying to sell promotional products at the till. Sometimes the offers are not available in store, just an empty shelf etc, is this due to only a limited quantity of stock being on offer and once it’s sold then there is no more available? However not impressed with the online service, items are available on the website and also in store but I have an email to say that you are unable to source the item I have ordered online?!

records.title: Staff could have been a bit more…
records.text: Staff could have been a bit more helpful when asked for help trying to find products. Cheapest price on an offer of any 3 for 2, should be the cheapest is free, when you purchase 3 the same price on the offer you pay for all 3 items with the tax, leaving you feeling cheated

records.title: Always lovely to shop there
records.text: Always lovely to shop there, but stock levels are horendous, so I have to go online direct to supplier, therefore instead of visiting store ones a week , I go there ones for 3 months ...very sad

records.title: Visited this store earlier today
records.text: Visited this store earlier today. Was not impressed with staff treatment from what i believe is the manager . Shouted at a girl saying she didn’t have time for her to not be working . Was extremely unprofessional to witness . My wife also previously said she saw the same manager do it to another young girl and a man when she was in buying dog food . Not impressed .

records.title: Store location is good
records.text: Store location is good. As a cat parent I was disappointed how little cat products there were compared to dogs. Food choices, litter trays, cat bowls and so on.Store was Kingsgate in East Kilbride Glasgow which doesn't seem to appear on your location list. This mau be as it has just opened.

records.title: Not great for cats
records.text: You used to have a really good selection of cat food, now it's much smaller and less varied plus shelves are often empty with a lack of stock. Your treat and toys selection for cats is not great also. Staff are nice though.

records.title: Easier to buy instore
records.text: First time buying online and not a great experience as half the delivery they had run out of stock by the time they went to send it and the courier wasn't totally reliable, but maybe I'm expecting too much this busy time of year.  On a positive note I have never had a problem instore and I can't fault the staff for their help and friendliness.

records.title: Not open
records.text: When you state your opening time as 8.00 on Christmas eve I would expect you to actually open at 8.00.

records.title: Was great once
records.text: Always liked jollyes but gone downhill recently. Was seen as the cheaper competition to pets at home but now I'd say prices are the same - p@h winning in some cases now. Real shame.

records.title: The store is great but the website is…
records.text: The store is great but the website is shocking and unreliable

records.title: Generally good .. but
records.text: Generally good as ever, but (1) limited stock of James Wellbeloved dog food - the only remaining 15kg sack of duck had been torn and stuck together with tape and there was no fish in that brand; I also wanted an l.e.d. flashing dog collar, but again nothing suitable in stock.

records.title: Jollyes The Pet People in Thetford…
records.text: Jollyes The Pet People in Thetford offers a range of pet products at good prices, especially for dog food and treats. The staff is friendly and helpful, often going out of their way to assist customers, like offering alternatives when a dog needs a lead. They seem knowledgeable about pet care products, providing advice when needed. However, the experience, while positive, might not stand out significantly among other options, but the customer care is appreciated.

records.title: Staff smoking at the front door.
records.text: Drove past this afternoon at around 6pm, I was going to pop in as needed dog food. Until I seen a member of staff with long black hair standing down near the front entrance smoking, not very professional looking to be smoking right at your front door. So I carried on driving and went to pets at home instead.

records.title: Jollyes pet club member!
records.text: Having joined jollyes pet club 6 months ago I have never been welcomed by email or sent any offers I still buy things from them and tell them every time that no contact has been made and still no one in store does anything to help

records.title: Was unable to get my my 10% membership…
records.text: Was unable to get my my 10% membership discount using your app for click and collect.I think your website must be one of the worst out there.

records.title: Harrogate store a disappointment
records.text: Last time I visited, I had 3 things on my shopping list from the website, Harrogate had none in stock and the staff were all huddled together near the checkout, even though there were only 3 customers in store. This time, wasn’t great either as no stock of 1 item (out of 2) and the offer price not on the shelf only full price until I asked. Parking isn’t clear either

records.title: The store caters primarily for dog and…
records.text: The store caters primarily for dog and cat owners. There was a poor choice of products for other pet owners and I found the goods expensive. After purchasing some heavy/bulky items I, as a 77 year old man, was neither offered nor even asked if I needed any assistance to carry them from the store. The whole experience was impersonal and unsuited to my needs.

records.title: Ordered two heavy bags of cat litter…delivery stock letdown
records.text: Ordered two heavy bags of cat litter and a 14kg bag of chudleys dog food, waited a week then sent an email that Jollyes could not source the dog food and only the cat litter will be delivered. Was in stock on web site.

records.title: Unhelpful staff member
records.text: Visited the East Kilbride store on Friday evening , my 1st ever visit to a Jollyes store and while the store itself was lovely I can’t help but feeling my visit was different than that of the customer beside me at the checkout .  She was greeted by  a very friendly member of staff who asked her if she got everything she was looking for , asked if she wanted to sign up for the reward scheme and talked to her in detail about it .  My member of staff refused to take the items from me ,  did not speak a word and when I asked for a receipt ignored me and called to next in queue .   I will be back but will avoid that staff member on future visits.

records.title: Really poor!

records.title: Very limited on kitten wet food had to…

records.title: The 3 for 2 offer wasn’t clear all…

This has really annoyed me. The item prices were not shown when I was by the till to rectify this. Also I was asked about buying a tin of dog food for a shelter and agreed thinking I’d made a good saving, however as I hadn’t I found I was paying a lot more money than I’d expected; again there was no display of this amount at the till.

description: Protect your pet with a custom-made aluminium smart tag with QR technology, giving them the best chance of being found.

records.title: Security
records.text: Hugo's tag fell off found it a later but had already requested replacement, very fast as was Xmas very impressed. I told my friend about crumb & she joined also before  Xmas , like me she thinks it's a marvelous idea knowing your dog who is my whole world is safe.It's frightening to think people are stealing pets, they don't stop to think there our canine babies & are deeply loved & cherished

records.title: I think it’s awesome
records.text: I think it’s awesome. I just wish Crumb was around when my short haired chihuahua got lost one day and was gone for 13 hours with us searching everywhere and she was only 4 lbs. she was 6 miles from home. I was devastated over my baby and so thankful when we found her with the help of our mail carrier

records.title: Replacement tag
records.text: I joined the Crumb family when I adopted my dog as I wanted every possible way of being able to locate her if the worst should happen and we get parted. We were away from home at Christmas and took many walks in unfamiliar territory. Just 3 days ago I noticed that her Crumb tag was no longer on her collar. I immediately contacted Crumb and was pleasantly surprised to get a response within minutes. I’ve just received the replacement tag by 48hr post. I am very impressed by the help and speed of this service. I hope to never use the search feature they provide but I’ve taken steps to eliminate one less worry. Highly recommend 🐾

records.title: Another quick delivery of the Crumb tag…

They would of cost a lot to keep replacing them. But I'd rather my boy came me home without his safety release collar, than get stuck somewhere and not come home at all 😿

records.title: So easy…
