records.title: Are discounts really discounts?
records.text: I joined this Crumb and opted for annual subscription at the discount price. I was charged the subscription but I was also charged £4.95 extra to upgrade to the annual subscription which was discounted. So the £10 saving for 2 months is really only £5.00.

records.title: Does work, but have to pay
records.text: I came across an advert for this product and saw it was free, just pay postage. I was sold because it claimed that I didnt need a subscription for the tag to work. I paid £3 postage and waited for it to arrive. Much to my delight, the tag arrived 2 days later and I scanned the QR code to set it up. I went through the information and was then redirected to the pay window- at £4.95 per month! I exited the pay screen and scanned my dog's QR code, to have a pop up show that said I couldn't access my information via Crumb as it wasn't the paid edition. Given that it is only £5 a month, I decided to give it a try and signed up. Payment went immediately and I then scanned his QR code again, for it to display my details (has a ring button but not my phone number ('for security', but DOES show my address when scanned- I'm not sure this is secure- I'd rather it showed my number than my address, but preferably neither!). Overall, I do think it offers a service that could prove invaluable if ever needed, but I don't appreciate being told that you don't need a subscription, only to have to pay to be alerted to my pup's location, should the worst happen. Very disappointing and something to bare in mind for those of you wanting a free service.

records.title: I ordered 2 tags as they were…
records.text: I ordered 2 tags as they were advertised as free on FB they arrived quickly and I set them up but went to activate them and they put me through to PayPal at £6,95 a month and yet they were advertised as free ! Can’t speak to anyone so I don’t know if they’re activated if I don’t pay

records.title: Very confusing for old people
records.text: Very  confusing as I am 75 and normally work on my desktop  computer and I don't understand the mobile.

records.title: Nice tag, bad surprise subscription
records.text: The free tag is nicely designed, but springing a $60 annual subscription on me after collecting all that personal info was not well received.  Better to have the price before making us enter all that.  If it's worth the price, we'll pay it.  If not, you've just irritated a potential customer.

records.title: it was very easy to apply for the…
records.text: it was very easy to apply for the 'free' (pay only p&p - at this stage), the tags arrived within 2 days.  It was also very easy to set up my dog's details, med conditions, allergies etc.  However right at the end of this process the monthly cost was mentioned - I was then annoyed that this tag is advertised as free - it really isn't.  I have trawled through the online info and found no mention of costs, this is misleading.

records.title: I'm beyond disappointed with my Crumb…
records.text: I'm beyond disappointed with my Crumb pet ID tag. I've reached out to their customer support countless times, even trying to contact them through Facebook, but I've been completely ignored.To make matters worse, the print on the tag is already wearing off after only two weeks!  And the biggest issue? I can't even update my dog's information on their website – it keeps saying she's male, even though I've tried to correct it multiple times. This was my main reason for contacting them in the first place!It's such a shame because the idea behind the tag is fantastic, but the execution is terrible. Honestly, why don't they use a more durable material or seal the print with something like rubber to prevent this? It feels like a basic design flaw.

records.title: No transparency about subscription costs
records.text: I had a number of messages from a number of people at crumb. They all gave conflicting information, specifically about the monthly cost. I was even offered a discount which still cost more than the amount on the website. The free trial is irrelevant as the tag arrived at the end of the two weeks, I reguested cancellation of the auto renew but this clearly hasn’t been done as they have scheduled two payments to come out of my account totalling nearly £50, 3 days after receiving the tag. However I am sure this is an admin error and they will do the right thing and honour my wishes. Great idea but executed very badly. UPDATE: Crumb have refunded my subscription costs and I am happy with the resolution.

records.title: This would have warranted 5 stars
records.text: This would have warranted 5 stars. Sienna's tag arrived swiftly and works well. I liked being able to include her photo at startup and the whole process is easy, quick and hassle free. Unfortunately. (This might be me getting it wrong, I might have missed the notification) before you can activate, you have to choose your payment option! £4.99pm just to register the tag. Then, it offers a vet on call for a further c£4.99. These are recurring monthly payments and you can't register without a monthly fee. ( or an annual fee for small discount.) I prefer to have the information about cost ahead of ordering. You need transparency from the off. Otherwise, an excellent idea.

records.title: It’s asking to sign up for a plan but…
records.text: It’s asking to sign up for a plan but advertisement states it’s free so it’s misleading

If it is significant, think about the waste! Also, your site notes ‘upgrade to premium’, when activating: There is no other choice apart from not activating the tag.

Surely an upgrade means that there is also a basic level? Also when putting in pet details, colour options were very basic and even included green! Will continue just using my basic metal tags.

records.text: You are enticed to pay £3 postage for a tag.  I was under the impression it was free.  £4.95 per month to then ‘activate’ it… no mention of this prior to ordering his ‘free offer’.  It is very misleading… Have to say I have received a response from Crumb and a postage refund, so that is very good customer service and that deserves 5 stars.  Need to let customers know in advance about monthly charge then they won’t feel like they have been misled.

records.title: Initially signed up for "free" tags
records.text: Initially signed up for "free" tags,  only to find out there was a fee charged,  managed to find a customer number and reduced the fee. However 2 months in, I have now received txt and email to say tags are no longer active, and they have failed to collect recent recurring fee. Given this has previously gone from my account on 4th of month, I fail to see how, as it isn't yet that.  I followed the link sent to reactivate account and the cost has returned to previous high cost.  So be aware, if the company fail to collect payment, through no fault of your own, nothing has changed, money in account, they cancel your tags immediately.  No such thing as Free.  As originally advertised.  Very very poor.  Spend the money on conventional engraved tags

records.title: Avoid crumb
records.text: Massive spamming of emails avoid. Dodgy upgrade sales approach.

records.title: Tag is Free....but Subscription Based
records.text: This is a great idea except that in order for the information to be viewable to anyone, the owner must pay for a monthly subscription. This is not clear upfront. It's why the tags have been free, the money is in the subscription. This is the same principal as a microchip, but in the end is more expensive and the tags can be lost. Get your pet microchiped instead

records.title: Misleading wording for free account
records.text: The sign up process suggests that you can pay for postage to get the tag and free profile. However, when you receive the tag and start creating the profile you are unable to "Activate" the tag unless you agree to pay a monthly subscription. There are no other options on the activation page to just continue with a free profile. If you go back to your dashboard, it will appear that the profile is not usable until you activate it. This is indicated by the washed out colours on the icons, along with the same colours for the paid-for features, implying they are not active. If you scan the physical tag (not the QR code on the piece of paper included), it will show the limited pet profile with basic contact info (so it doesn't actually require activation to use). The "activate" wording in this instance is misleading. After 30 minutes or more of refusing to click activate, I received an email making out that the Co-founder had personally given me an offer code and forwarded this to another co-founder to contact me. Most likely automatically generated and no direct communication from co-founders. All wording encouraged a sale by using phrases such as "I don't know how long this discount code will be active for...". Horrible tactics.

records.title: Pet tag
records.text: Bought the pet tag, not realising there was a monthly fee that applied. You can't set it up without paying the fee. Thinking I had missed this info somewhere, I went back and re read everything. Absolutely no mention of a monthly fee anywhere very misleading!!

records.title: Probably should have known that you…
records.text: Probably should have known that you don’t get anything for free. First time I saw anything about a monthly subscription was when I got to the point where you activate the tag. Seems pointless paying monthly for another tag as we already have the traditional type with name and phone number as well as having a chip. Judging by the number of people posting they got a free replacement when they lost one they can’t be that robust.

records.title: Unhelpful at point of cancellation.
records.text: After trialling crumb for two months I didn't find that I was getting value for money and wanted to cancel. My first three requests went undetected, or maybe ignored, by Crumb. Bow I finally have contact with them I've had two emails trying to persuade me to stay anf they've not yet complied with my request to cancel. I don't mind having wasted £20 as I wanted to trial the service, however I do take issue with them being difficult when I've concluded that Crumb is not for me.

records.title: DISGRACEFUL ACTION BY THIS COMPANY
records.text: These people are doing underhanded advertising regarding this free tag.it's not free at all and not clearly explained. BE AWARE NOT AS GREAT AS YOU FIRST THINK

records.title: The company have gone a long way to rectify things
records.text: I have decided to edit my feedback due to this company contacting me and their attempt to make things right.  This doesn't mean that my experience wasn't bad, but it means they have gone a long way to rectify it.  I am hoping that perhaps they will look to trying to stop this kind of thing happening in the future to other unsuspecting people as it a horrid feeling to panic and worry about money when the country is in this economic mess.  No matter what age we are.

records.title: First impression was good but I was very wrong!
records.text: First impression was good and the £3 for the tag seemed great value. Little did I know I had signed up to a monthly subscription of £9.99! Which I cannot afford and did not want/agree to. Is have been on the website trying to cancel this subscription but this is impossible and frustrating, despite following the guidance.Awaiting a reply from crumb. I feel mislead and unhappy.

description:
HI, WE'RE FUNNYFUZZY.
We believe having them in our life is the most wonderful journey.

We want to enjoy every moment with them.

That's how we started, to make this journey delightful and memorable.


MAKE IT SIMPLE
Aren’t we all want to spend more time with them, use the products that make them feel comfortable, we wish that we could give everything to them.

So we make it simple, we put all the things into one: multi-functional leashes, all-purpose harnesses...all basic on simple and practical principles with our years of experience in the pet product industry.


DESIGN AESTHETIC
Not only do we value practicality, but we also hold on to our aesthetic value.

The beautiful design could evoke your inner emotions, which your pet could be connected with. That makes our product more than an object.


EXCELLENT QUALITY
Quality is important for us. It shows our responsibility and reliability to our pets.

Therefore, we set our manufacturing standard to a high level, that’s how we do as an owner, a parent, a good friend.


LOVE MORE
Are you wondering what goes through their little minds?
Although we don’t speak dog language, we could show affection through our actions.There are many ways to show them, and there is more than one way to love them.

records.title: two seater sofa cover set…
records.text: We ordered a two seater sofa cover set which is great. It is made of a lovely quality material and waterproof and scratch proof which has really helped to protect our velvet sofa! The items arrived a little slower than expected but it was over the festive period so I don't really think that's a negative.

records.title: Decent quality travel bed
records.text: Arrived in good time with detailed tracking. I think it actually gets despatched direct from China?Not used product yet which is a car travel bed but looks good. It has a water/stain resistant surface which feels almost like fabric so should be comfortable on journeys.

records.title: Multiple products purchased with total satisfaction
records.text: Multiple products have been purchased over the past 6 months for my big boy (55 kg Greek Shepherd/Anatolian Shepherd mix).  All have lived up to the online product description and have been delivered in a timely and safe manner. These products range from couch protection and blankets to giant dog bed. Will continue to use them as a source when new items needed or wanted!

records.title: The second Funny Fuzzy was exactly as…
records.text: The second Funny Fuzzy was exactly as it appeared in your inscription of it. My Dogue cross now understands that this is his one to curl up on because it is more his size, The one on my chair is too small but is waiting for his new GSD forever friend to arrive in 2025 sometime. When I must add, I will be purchasing more Funny Fuzzy goods.

records.title: Positive Experience - Waterproof Throws
records.text: The throws were as described/photographed, the correct size, and considering how far they had to travel, and that the order/delivery was over the Xmas period, they arrived promptly. They are good quality and we're yet to try out how waterproof they are but  they do appear to be the correct material for it. Only improvement I'd like to see is that they include care instructions e.g. machine washable or not, can they be put in the tumble dryer etc.

records.title: Decent sofa covers
records.text: Decent sofa covers, but it didn’t come with instructions lol it did come with the little foam rods to install it but because I didn’t know what they were I threw them away!! :( oh well, still happy with the purchase.

records.title: Your product is as you say it is
records.text: Your product is as you say it is. We wanted your Funny Fuzzy chair covers for our existing dog and the pup we are hoping to get in 2025. Our existing dog a Dogue de Bordeaux x Rotti, already loves both of them, although the smaller one is a little small for him, but we bought it for the new pup, so we could place it on the floor for him until he's big enough to climb the chairs on his own.

records.title: Well made comfortable car seat
records.text: Although it took a little longer to receive the items I have ordered ahead of Christmas they are good quality and my puppy loves his car seat. It is very easy to install in the car and he is happy and comfortable in it. Also very easy to get him out with the seat and carry him indoors.

records.title: Good Delivery
records.text: After a poor start , with no tracking information and very long delivery times , my last order was dispatched quickly , the tracking info was correct and the product arrived in very quick time .Quality of the dog beds (2) is very good and our dogs love them

records.title: Terrific covers. Would buy again.
records.text: I'm normally nervous buying things from sites I'm not familiar with and also read some unpleasant reviews however my experience has been great. The order went through promptly, I could track the item thought and it arrived I think within a week or so which wasn't too bad considering the Christmas period. The items arrived nicely packaged and the quality I found to be great, colour as described. I've only had them for a couple days so can't speak about longevity but surely just like anything else, it lasts depending on how it's cared for. I washed the blankets I got and even gently tumble dried and they've been fine.

records.title: Quite nice
records.text: Overall very nice but not as thick or stiff as they appear in the advert. I like it well enough. I ordered the wrong colour and immediately contacted customer services to change it. I emailed three times but nobody answered me. I would recommend this as long as you don’t have any issues as nobody will reply to your query.

records.title: The product is really good
records.text: The product is really good, nice fabric and size, but the bed filling could be thicker and firmer, because when our dogs lie down, there is a hole and it is not comfortable for them to sleep. We had to buy a pillow and put it inside.

records.title: Great product, just be aware of delivery times.
records.text: Ordered two covers for Christmas to give the sofas some chance with the impending four legged visitors.The covers are nicely made and well finished, unfortunately I didn’t realise shipping was from China so they didn’t arrive until after the event. A quick trip to Dunelm provided an alternative solution which was disappointing but the covers are now here and will be well used going forward.Only time will tell how long they will last, but first impressions is good.

records.title: Doggy Sofa Bed
records.text: Read that the bed was orthopeadic, unsure I can detect anything that feels firm about the bed?Great design & material seems likely to be no problem for washing. Colour true to photo.

records.title: Orthopaedic bed lounger:
records.text: Orthopaedic bed lounger:The tracker gave some false information regarding the delivery, as it said the item had been delivered when it hadn’t. After sending an online message and an email, a response was sent and I shortly received the item with a lovely free soft toy, which my pug loves. Overall not a too bad quality product at the sale price, but wouldn’t pay any more for it.

records.title: 2x Travel Beds, good quality, arrived fast
records.text: Ordered two luxury car travel beds. After reading reviews, I thought I’d made a terrible mistake. Beds were packaged individually & I got two tracking numbers. Following it was easy & it updated daily. They are shipped from China which isn’t clear. One bed arrived on 23/12The second got caught in the Xmas break & I started to worry, however it arrived on 27/12The beds are great. Comfortable & our pups love them. So my experience was good but I felt uneasy until I physically had them, so it wasn’t a relaxing purchase. It seems if you are lucky enough to get a plain sailing transaction it works. However, if you hit a glitch either in shipping or product quality, it becomes problematic to sort. Not sure I’d buy again, only from a concern it could go wrong.

records.title: I gave 4 stars shipping was fast even…
records.text: I gave 4 stars shipping was fast even though it came from China!  Product is well made and matches the photos, only issue is the padding bolsters provided were odd shaped (stiff) and do not fully fill the pockets as expected..maybe when my dogs have jumped all over them for a few days they may fill out!

records.title: I bought my 3 seater sofa cover on the…
records.text: I bought my 3 seater sofa cover on the 9th December and when it didn’t arrive 5 days later I thought I’ll never get it ! Then Christmas eve 24th December it arrived and the product is great . Feels lovely and soft and my dog loves it too. It fits perfect and grips my leather sofa perfect. On reflection I suppose up to Christmas shipping is manic but very happy now . If it had arrived after 5 days it would get 5 stars . I’ll be ordering more but mentally ill give it 4 weeks to arrive so will plan ahead 👍🤩

records.title: Fabulous carry bed
records.text: Fabulous carry bed Don’t know what’s in the bonus toy but it sent her obsesive crazy!It’s a shame delivery takes so long 3wks

records.title: Doggy Bed  Christmas Present
records.text: Very pleased with my dog bed. Didn’t realise I was ordering from china so delivery was longer than expected. The dog bed was as expected but the inside pad was very thin so I put a pillow in the cover. My dog is very comfortable in it now!

records.title: Extremely pleased with the quality of…
records.text: Extremely pleased with the quality of the goods that l received. I must admit l didn’t read reviews first, only after I’d had a few email regarding how to tracking the delivery, which wasn’t useful as they didn’t have and info.Thought this was a uk web page but so found out it was China.Once they arrived in the uk tracking was better, although in total must have been 2/3 weeks before they arrived. All extremely well packed in airtight bags.

records.title: Good product. Check measurements and buy big enough to tuck in
records.text: Good products. Bit expensive. Look good on setteee. I like the long one that covers the seat. The set with separate seat back and arm covers Haven’t really worked as I thought. They don’t stay in place.

records.title: Happy sofa surfer!
records.text: I am happy with the two sofa covers I bought. I have only tried one - a blue one which complements my rugs / cushions. Initially it was a big 'stiff' to sit on but it is softening up. The other cream one  I will keep for the summer. Delivery was a bit delayed and difficult to track but given it was closer to Christmas time - it was understandable.

records.title: Great item

records.title: Waterproof overall for my dog
records.text: Bought a waterproof overall for my dog, good price and seems a decent quality item, only minus point is ridiculously long delivery time but not a major issue.

records.title: Very happy with my new sofa cover
records.text: Very happy with my new sofa cover. Good value. Arrived in a couple of weeks there was accurate tracking but adding notifications on delivery would have improved the overall experience.

records.title: Disappointed that item was not as thick…
records.text: Disappointed that item was not as thick as shown in picture

records.title: Dog bed very good and comfortable…
records.text: Dog bed very good and comfortable unfortunately it took a while to deliver

records.title: Coat is gorgeous and well made going by…
records.text: Coat is gorgeous and well made going by the measurements I ordered an extra large is just a bit big once it's done up neck fits well just a bit big underneath

records.title: Good suppler …
records.text: The dog bed was great but the duck toy was a bit disappointing but the dog liked it !! Would recommend this supplier.

records.title: Not the best but ok
records.text: The car seat for the dogs is ok quality, for the money I spent I would have expected it to be a bit more robust, the ties to go round the head rests to secure the car seat are very long even when shortened  and don’t fit my car (Peugeot 208) . The dogs love the car seat however which is good just need to make some amends so it’s actually secure for them. Not sure if I would purchase from here again but you live and learn.

records.title: I liked the quality for the price
records.text: I liked the quality for the price. However, I received two different sizes when I only ordered two in the same size. Also, it wasn’t made clear how long delivery would take. I thought this was a UK company and didn’t realise my order was coming from China. So I didn’t arrange replacement of the item that was the wrong size as it could be too complicated. records.title: Delivery took 2 weeks

records.title: Two different bed styles but both the same kind of quality
records.text: Nice beds two different styles purchased both varying in quality. Both beds very soft and furry, stuffing quality ok but could do with more stability in the sides and back of the sofa style one and better stuffing in the base of the round one. records.title: The description was misleading

The cover seems strong and part of it wipes clean. Delivery is slow coming from China. I got a discount so that made the price reasonable compared with other companies offering similar beds in UK. records.title: I am very disappointed
records.text: I am very disappointed with the luxury bed I bought my dog. The most important part the ‘foam mattress’ she should sleep on contained lumpy bits of giant fluff … absolutely useless worse than sleeping on the floor! Lot of money for poor quality item

records.title: Very flimsy, not worth the price tag.
records.text: Ordered a plush dog bed. It looked amazing in the pictures.it is a nice colour but smaller and much flimsier than expected. Definitely not worth the £93.70 I paid and this was with a black Friday sale. It is normally £120. I do not recommend, your local pet shop will give you better value for money.

records.title: Why does it say funny fuzzy uk and then…

records.title: Product excellent

records.title: Very disappointing.
records.text: The bed wasn’t as big or a thick as expected. The pictures make you expect something a lot better. V disappointed. Really not worth the money.

records.title: A qualified good review
records.text: I tried to contact prior to delivery as “tracking” failed but got me response. I even thought the whole setup was a scam! Howe er finally arrived and delighted with product. I would just say customer service was non existent I simply needed expected delivery.

records.title: Ok but not great value

records.title: the mattress is not comfortable for big dogs

records.title: The stuffing could be a bit Fuller and…
records.text: The stuffing could be a bit Fuller and a pole in the roof. I've purchased one from a different company and they had these added comforts.

records.title: Slow service & poor tracking whilst in transit
records.text: Slow service taking well in excess of a week to get our order ( indeed still awaiting latest order)Tracking is poor & only covers transit from China to UK with final courier apparently not able to be trackedBeds of mixed quality

records.title: Disappointed overall
records.text: Package took a long time to arrive. I wrongly assumed it was coming from the UK. Disappointed to find it had been shipped from China. Quality of bed is poor for the cost. The sides are stuck to the main bed with velcro which comes apart as my dog is getting comfortable and stretching out. I cannot see this lasting very long at all. I would not recommend this bed and don't think my dog would either.

records.title: Ordered on 28 Nov and it arrived today…
records.text: Ordered on 28 Nov and it arrived today 23/12. Didn't realise I was ordering from china and it took forever to be dispatched (10 days) and the website tracking isn’t great but I used china post tracking websites and was able to follow it better. The dog bed itself is actually lovely and the dog loves it and it came with a cute free gift if a fluffy christmas dog squeeky toy. communication from the site is AWFUL. I emailed twice to see where it was and I still haven’t heard from them but alls well that ends well - the bed arrived before Christmas and the dog likes it!

records.title: Very disappointing
records.text: Very little info on shipment timescale and no updates. Took c 2 weeks.Material looks good quality, but very hard and plasticky. What doesn’t work is that the main piece is too small so doesn’t tuck in and stay in place. All was measured so is in theory correct size. As looks a mess and it moves I won’t be using much and will return to cheaper throws.

records.title: Not as expected
records.text: Delivery took ages over 2 weeks ,did not realise this was a Chinese company , the sofa was expensive ,didn’t come with a free gift and the sizing was not clear, should say sleeping area as dimensions included the arms which are big , so even though we ordered a large for a small dog, it’s still quite small for him . I am not returning as it’s international, lesson learned !

records.title: Wouldn't bother
records.text: I ordered a "large" dog bed, after waiting 2 weeks for my delivery (website states UK based but it is chinese) I was disappointed when I received a bed not much bigger than a hamster. At £62 I feel completely ripped off.

records.title: I didn’t receive any of the products I ordered

records.title: No return even is their mistake
records.text: Sent a smaller dog's bed seater instead of the large one. Email them 4 times, still no answer from them, even not reply any emails, The return policy is a Joke, no other choice for communication or return item, except one email address to talk to them.

records.title: Your customer service is shocking
records.text: Your customer service is shocking. Your tracking is shocking stuck in customes for weeks. You advertise as UK based but products come from  China but tracking details from customs onwards is in Chinese writing when you try to contact courier. Regardless the product Dogs Bed I'm really happy with great quality and size as recommended. Just allow at least 5-6 weeks for delivery. I would not risk ordering again. Due to delay.

records.title: To say I'm disappointed is a massive…
records.text: To say I'm disappointed is a massive understatement. I have seven dogs so purchase many beds and this was the worse quality bed I can remember. records.title: Poor quality
