description: Trusty Pet Supplies is a family run business based in Derby since 1999. Consisting of 3 generations of family, we have over 50 years experience in the pet trade. We offer pet food, pet toys and pet supplies both on our website and from our Derby Shop.

records.title: A Company you can trust
records.text: I have been a customer for a good 18 months. The staff are efficient and friendly. I ring up with my order on a morning, by the following afternoon, my order has been delivered. I can honestly say, I have never had an issue with this company. Trusty Pet Supplies is a Company you CAN TRUST!

records.title: Easy and timely purchase
records.text: Easy website to navigate. Had the product I wanted in stock. Item arrived earlier than anticipated (which was between Christmas and New Year). Many sites were not delivering until after the New Year.

records.title: GOOD SERVICE
records.text: Website easy to use.Delivery was ahead of schedule, even the week before Christmas.Just one problem. 1 out of 3 of my containers was broken.  Packaging not perfect fit.Otherwise a very satisfied customer.

records.title: It was delivered quickly but the Kong…
records.text: It was delivered quickly but the Kong knots teddy did not last more thanb2 days which was a bit of a let down especially for the price we paid definitely not husky proof

records.title: Impressed!
records.text: First time I've used your company.  I was happy with the competitive price of the parrot seed and very reasonable delivery charge.  Order arrived quickly.  I will use you again!

records.title: Great service
records.text: I ordered 3 items online. 1 item was out of stock so they called me to let me know and I ordered an alternative item instead. Great customer service 👏. Quick delivery too. Very happy

records.title: Great company
records.text: Delivery times are great, website easy to use, and fast response times to any emails

records.title: Cow ears with hair
records.text: Quick excellent condition my dog really enjoys all products from trusty pet supplies

records.title: Great experience
records.text: Great selection of dry dog food, really good prices and speedy delivery - free over £40. Really good service, thanks.

records.title: Specified & delivered
records.text: Easy, pleasant online transaction. Correct item delivered quickly, packaged appropriately.Was one of the few places I could find the exact item I was after (most other sites sent a random colour) whereas Trusty Pet specified and delivered! Thank you

records.title: My 2 monthly standing order arrived…
records.text: My 2 monthly standing order arrived within 2 days of dispatch.However an additional order that i made 4 days earlier appeared to be forgotten.I had to chase this; did eventually arrive 8 days after order.

records.title: Product was competitively priced but delivery issues!
records.text: Product was competitively priced however the communication by the delivery company was awful and my requests for an update on when the delivery would be from Trusty Pet Supplies went unanswered. Yes, the goods did arrive, but were left in the open despite me requesting they be delivered to a neighbour --- big sign by the front door which was completely ignored and instructions on the app ignored! Someone needs to get to grips with the delivery side.

records.title: Trusty Pets 5* overall experience 4*
records.text: Trusty pets have been brilliant again, goods delivered on time, I’ve had delivered 2 x 20kg bags of bird seed but again 1 of the boxes was damaged, I guess not  the fault of Trusty Pets, having said that I have suggested that Trusty Pets supply this type of order in smaller boxes which would be better.

records.title: Delivered within a few days and left…
records.text: Delivered within a few days and left just inside our garage as requested - good service.We order quite large supplies of peanuts etc which are heavy for us to move around and the packaging tends to break. We can order multiple bags of course but there is no point if these are all loaded into one cardboard box. Perhaps the ordering service could provide for a maximum parcel weight?

records.title: Good website makes for easy ordering
records.text: Good website makes for easy ordering.  Would like more options for boneless minces as current ones are quite restrictive and boneless chunks are expensive.My main issue was with delivery - it was ordered for Friday and actually arrived on Thursday, and the DPD driver doesn't follow instructions on where to leave it. He doesn't even ring the doorbell, but just dumps it on the pavement outside the front door, from where it could easily be stolen.

records.title: Competitive prices for dry cat food
records.text: Competitive price for dry cat food. What should have been a 5% discount was incorrectly given as £5, but this was politely and promptly corrected when I emailed the company.Have just unsubscribed from their marketing emails as they were much too frequent.

records.title: Selected as a Family Business
records.text: Easy to order/set up account, immediate discount for large spend (not here's a voucher for your NEXT order).  Kept in the loop with confirmation/processing/delivery (DPD bang on time!!!!)Ordered early evening Wed  Delivered Fri morning 17/2/23.  In my book that's next day & free delivery.Only hitch was 1 of 2 boxed suet pellets - either needed to be bagged@boxed OR tape sealed all the way round the bottom of box not just outside flaps = slight/messy spillage.However, small blip only so would have judged 4.5☆ had that been available.  Have today recommended TRUSTY PET SUPPLIES to my best friend.

records.title: All arrived on time and mostly frozen
records.text: All arrived on time and mostly frozen, some defrosted at the edges which is not a problem. They sell all the makes we like to purchase and use DPD for delivery who is our preferred courier. Only negative comment is that there was not enough packaging to fill spaces at top of box which was therefore quite damaged. Fortunately contents were ok.

records.title: Almost a 5
records.text: It would have been a five, I payed for next day delivery and it was bang on, but the plastic bag with the nuts in had burst in transit. When the van driver pulled it out a good two handfuls went on to the road, I swept them on to our pathway but some had been crushed by the passing cars,the birds still ate them but the worry was, loads of squashed birds.

records.title: Good prices and fast delivery
records.text: Once again good prices and fast delivery. The only downside was that 12kg of calciworms were packed into the same box as 13kg of suet balls. This was clearly too heavy for the box which had split. The delivery company also left the box in my porch (as instructed) but it was so big that I couldn’t actually get into my porch and when I tried to climb over it the box split further. May be better to package separately in future.

records.title: Competitive price
records.text: Competitive price, fast delivery.The ear cleaner i ordered was out of stock, the shop shipped another one with higher price which i appreciate

records.title: Regular and reliable dog food…
records.text: Regular and reliable dog food deliveries. Really happy and would recommend. Had good customer service in the past although on the last delivery I called because the dog food wasn't sealed airtight and I also wanted to adjust the delivery frequency (to make it more often) but nobody has responded to my message. Not a big deal on this occasion but that's why I didn't give a 5 star rating.

records.title: Usually an excellent
records.text: Usually an excellent, fast delivery but this time my Yak chews came in a bag not the usual box. As they are brittle, they were damaged with bits chipped off them 😔. The dogs still love them but would recommend sticking to boxing them in future please! At £70 a box I would like them to be perfect 😀

records.title: Great selection of raw DIY food and…
records.text: Great selection of raw DIY food and really fast delivery from order. But a couple of times I have ordered Turkey neck chunks and have received full turkey necks. I only have small dogs so cutting them into pieces is not easy! Not sure if this is Premium raws issue as it says CHUNKS on the label but isn’t.

records.title: I recently put my dog on a raw food…
records.text: I recently put my dog on a raw food diet and ordered almost 20kg of meat chunks. Although it's probably my fault for not realising, the meat arrived already frozen, which meant I had to spend the next few hours cutting through frozen meat before I could place everything in the freezer. Was a nightmare! Might be best to make it very clear that raw food will arrive in frozen state.

records.title: Only issue was as a new customer I…
records.text: Only issue was as a new customer I attempted to create an account online. I filled out every available box with my details, but it wouldn't accept until I provided a new password for the account. There was nowhere on the form to provide this password therefore I was unable to create an account.Upon collecting my purchase from the store, I informed the staff of my problem creating an account. Unfortunately they were totally unhelpfully and disinterested, stating that side of things is nothing to do with them and it would be the warehouse that controlled the website.

records.title: This pet store is fantastic
records.text: This pet store is fantastic! They have a wide variety of supplies and products for all types of pets, and their staff is knowledgeable and friendly. Plus, the pets they have for adoption are absolutely adorable!

records.title: Food arrived late
records.text: Food arrived late. Paid for. Next day delivery but was 48hrs before it was delivered.Otherwise correct order received

records.title: As usual the service was excellent but…
records.text: As usual the service was excellent but I think the monkey nuts and the peanuts are not to your usual standard. The shelled peanuts are quite dry and the shelled peanuts are very small. This is the first time I have been disappointed with my order.

records.title: Living in expectation
records.text: Had to text your firm as not receivedmy order,waited for delivery for one week,good job l had small supply of dog food,not impressed

records.title: Needs to improve customer service for out of stock items
records.text: I've been using trusty for a number of years for my parrot food. This year on 2 occasions my order has been incomplete and on both occasions I had to contact to get a resolution. I'm still waiting currently for a refund for food ordered at the beginning of July and have had to keep chasing. Also my last order had a couple of boxes of cat food that were over £13 each for a box of 12 pouches but they are Best Before early October!

records.title: Slow delivery & poor communication
records.text: Delivery has slowed down & communication is non existent.I have sent an email and no response.

records.title: Fantastic delivery time…
records.text: Fantastic delivery time but this is the third successive order where the box has not been securely taped and was gaping open in delivery. Also, VAT shown on receipt for delivery to Channel Islands address so not applicable. Advised of this but no response to date!

records.title: Long delivery time
records.text: Took eleven days from order to delivery. Even though the delivery address is in the Channel Islands, this seems excessive. The tape around the box did not cover the seam across the top and the package was split open as a consequence. Fortunately nothing was damaged or missing. The products were all present and at least it has now arrived so that is an improvement on my previous supplier!

records.title: Arden Grange wet dog food
records.text: Super efficient service. The product arrived within 36 hours of ordering. However, on opening the parcel we found around two thirds of the tins of dog food severely dented, one of which we had to throw away as the seal had been broken and was unsure how safe the food was for our dog's consumption. Is it the seller or the delivery company? We don't know. It's a shame because the tins were value for money, especially with free delivery. But if you cannot use every tin does it remain value for money?

records.title: Carrier issues
records.text: Brilliant product quality as always but your carrier lets you down. Last two deliveries have not been delivered on time including 1 where I paid extra for a next day delivery. DPD’s failure to deliver when stated is going to start damaging your business unless they improve.

records.title: Rabbits ears
records.text: Very prompt delivery which was great.  Had to order 5kg of rabbits ears as 3kg not available now.  Arrived loose in box not bagged which has created a storage problem.  Won’t order again unless can reduce to 3kg.  Good product and deliver, but volume and packaging not right for me.

records.title: Problems when things go wrong.
records.text: I have always been impressed by the speedy delivery service.  However, recently something went wrong with the payment system for a subscription order and typically I was running out of dog food.I needed to resolve the issue uregently but having to use the email system put long delays on getting answers and sorting the problrem.  I was eventually phoned but by then it was too late.  I subsequently cancelled the subscription and then renewed it and all was then well.  I just wish I could have had a speedier response in the first instance.

records.title: Felt a bit let down and no apology when…
records.text: Felt a bit let down and no apology when I highlighted the issue.I cancelled part of my order 2 months ago and suspended my remainder at the same time till February.TPS took the money of nearly £100 and delivered the whole order last week!I emailed them AGAIN and 🤞it’s been cancelled and suspended.Would help if they had a telephone contact.

records.title: Product is great, delivery rubbish
records.text: Product is great.  Dispatch time was great.  Delivery by Evri was rubbish - I ended up sitting at home 3 afternoons in a row.  Finally turned up on the third day.  There is no way of contacting the courier to find out what is going on.  Very frustrating when it’s sunny outside and I have better things to do than sitting waiting for a delivery!

records.title: Ordering easy
records.text: Ordering easy. Delivery excellent  with good communication. Some of the Mince I ordered were watery and sloppy and my dogs wouldn't eat it especially the oily fish Mince but the stripes are good so will stick to those. Overall happy so far

records.title: Delivery was quick as usual for raw dog…
records.text: Delivery was quick as usual for raw dog food but there was not enough ice packs or packing to 1)stop the defrosting 2)stop the loose boxes being thrown around inside. As a result there was blood over everything and a few tears from wet boxes. I passed this onto customer service, they asked for photos which I had none as I was keen to put things in the freezer and clean blood off all the boxes, my kitchen and myself. They've ignored me ever since. I only suggested to provide 1 more ice pack perhaps during the heatwave and a simple “thanks for your feedback” would have sufficed. The service itself is great but it seems from what I've seen on Google reviews and my own experience, the good service stalls once customer service is involved ironically.

records.title: Damaged Delivery
records.text: In the past I've always had a very good service with Trusty Pet Supplies. In this order I left a note at the checkout to politely ask if they could make sure that the box my items was packed in was in a strong box, and that the bird seed inside was packaged in strong bags, as a few times these have arrived damaged and broken. As the items I ordered were very heavy, I thought this made sense.When the delivery arrived, not only had one of the parcels had to be taped up by DPD because it had broken so badly, but one of the big bags inside had split, causing everything to spill out into the box inside.

records.title: Disappointed with this order -flimsy packaging.
records.text: Normally I give Trusty Pets a FIVE STAR review for the packaging and delivery of my Order of Dried Mealworms, HOWEVER this time my order was damaged. Although I cannot fault the Delivery Service...my order arrived VERY speedily and for that I am very grateful...Trusty Pets are so reliable on this issue... BUT I think some attention must be given to the strength of the plastic bag in which the dried mealworms arrived. The bag had split wide open inside the box and the mealworms were no longer in the plastic bag, but loose in the box and they manged to get into every small cranny and fold in the cardboard packaging . It took me AGES to extricate them all and a lot broke up, as they are so fragile if handled. Normally I just pour the contents of the plastic bag straight into the large container in which I keep the mealworms. Not possible this time so rather frustrated. Please can you put them in a stronger bag in the box? Thank you.

records.title: Inadequate packing material
records.text: The delivery was quick - but there was inadequate packing material. There were 12 tins loose in the box with NO packing around them . Consequently 4 of the tins arrived dented.  I also think they had been exposed to high temperatures as the contents were very soft and mushy

records.title: I asked the delivery man if he could…
records.text: I asked the delivery man if he could please bring my box to my flat on the first floor. It's hard for a woman to carry a 20k box anytime but even more so at the moment, as I've just had a foot operation and I'm on crutches. Instead he just left it downstairs and I had no one to help me. The previous delivery man from DHL carried my delivery up on his shoulder in 30 seconds flat, every three weeks for two years without me even asking. I really don't think it would have been too much trouble for your man.

records.title: Excellent product & supplier but…
records.text: Excellent product & supplier but delivery driver surly & refused to put  24kilo box where requested even though it was closer to his van. A 72 year old on my own it was v difficult for me to move subsequently.

records.title: Now sorted after £50 Item missing from Recent big order of £140.9712kg of…
records.text: Update 18 July 2023I have now received the missing item from my Order, so I have amended my review from 1 to 3 stars to reflect this. The issue was handled reasonably well.Recent big order of £140.97 of 12kg of dog food, 10kg of cat food. One box of one delivered claiming to be 22kg and include both items along with invoice for full price.Where is my 2nd item ? No cat food included !!I will revise my opinion of Trusty Pet Supplies if they efficiently resolve this problem. I have emailed and will phone when their office is next open.My first experience of this company and so far not good.

records.title: I am still awaiting 2 of my 3 items of…
records.text: I am still awaiting 2 of my 3 items of my order and although i presume this is down to DPD it does mean i am left without knowing a delivery date if it is delivered at all. I would suggest another courier

records.title: I placed an order half the items were…
records.text: I placed an order half the items were not in stock so I was refunded. Another item was ordered and the wrong size was shipped.

records.title: Damaged parcel via DPD from Kingsway
records.text: Used them lot of times always had good service and given 5 Star but this time can only give 2 due to DPD delivering parcel soaking wet and falling apart with 2 small items missing. Rang number on invoice was told could not help due to warehouse next door only available via help email so emailed them and asked if someone could come and see what problem was as I only live 2min up road from them and i can not send photos on line that was 9 days ago still awaiting reply.

records.title: The item {25kg of peanuts
records.text: The item {25kg of peanuts, comprising two 10kg bags and a 5kg bag in a strong cardboard box} arrived extremely promptly, as usual, but one of the 10kg bags had a clean 9" gash in its celophane wrappings, as if inflicted by a sharp knife, causing half the contents to disgorge themselves into the box.  As the box itself was well sealed and totally undamaged, I can but presume that the celophane bag was knowingly packed into it in this condition.

records.title: Damaged and Defrosted.
records.text: The packaging is poorly padded with inadequate insulation. As a result of this we had many items that were semi or fully defrosted, and nearly everything in hard plastic packaging was cracked. Not a good combo as raw food can be juicy! 🤢 I emailed them to inform then of the issue, but had no response. This happened in January, I dread to think how much worse it would be in the summer months! I'm disappointed because they have a good range of raw food at reasonable prices, but I can't risk losing ~£100 dog food in future.

records.title: Late delivery
records.text: I placed my order for 3 x200g of a product and paid for next working day delivery. As I ordered on a Sunday I thought it would arrive by Tuesday,  this was not so, I contacted the company who told be DPD had made a mistake and I would receive my order on Thursday,  at this point I asked for a refund on my delivery charge which the agreed to do. Thursday arrive still no delivery, it eventually arrive on the Friday morning,  5 days after I ordered it, also I received 12 x 50g not 3 x 200g so alot of extra repackaging for recycling.

records.title: Items sent were incorrect
records.text: Some items sent were incorrect. Returning these items was straightforward via Royal Mail link provided by Trusty Pet Supplies. However, on the morning of the booked collection times, Royal Mail did not come; I had to drop the parcel off at the post office. No telephone number for customer service is a minus.

records.title: Feeder missing from delivery
records.text: Delivery of the bird food was good as always but I also ordered a bird feeder which was missing from the delivery.  Emailed to report this say they would look into it sent them copy of receipt haven't heard any more from them now 5 days sent another email. If you phone them message to say email.

records.title: Poor customer communication
records.text: Ordered 2 x James Wellbeloved packs of 40x150g wet food and had exactly that confirmed by email. What was delivered was 12 of 12x90g packs. So total food weight slightly more but I cannot make up the 300g of meal for my dog. Would have been simple for Trusty Pet Supplies to make a call to me to advise of the replacement and check I still want it, but no, they chose to just send anyway and tough on the customer.

records.title: Laughable compensation
records.text: My raw food order arrived with half of the tubs badly damaged. Poorly packaged in the first place so not surprising. Requested a replacement or refund and they offered a partial refund.... i thought that was fair enough as I could repackage the food into freezer bags which was a bit of pain but do-able.  I got £3.04 from a £60 order! Communication was slow and in the end I gave up. Will not order from this company again.

records.title: Recent prices have sky-rocketed
records.text: I can't believe no one here is mentioning the recent 30% plus price increase on raw food? And a minimum of £100 now for free delivery? You used to be competitive but unfortunately, now you are not. A reasonable increase in prices is fine, but this is far too much.

description:
Get FRESH for 20% off
Learn about Fresh
Why does your cat food smell?
About KatKin
KatKin goes hardcore for cat health. For far too long the fat cats of the industry have been pushing false information and fluffy claims about what cats need to eat.
Born To Eat Meat
KatKin is a nutrition, education, and community focused cat-care brand that works with world leading veterinarians and nutritionists to develop fresh food that gives cats the nutrients they actually need. KatKin is cutting the fluff from the cat food industry and exposing the truth behind mass-produced cat food.

Mission
KatKin’s mission is to show cat ownership for what it actually is, and defy the stereotypes of cat’s being “easy to care for.” Cats need “hardcore love” no matter if they’re a finicky feline or have a tricky tummy. The time for change is now, and KatKin won’t stop until their cat-first, no-bs attitude becomes the new standard everywhere.
 Try now to give your cat the best

records.title: Katkin is great food for fussy cats
records.text: When I adopted Molly age 10 from a neighbour she was refusing to eat most of her wet food including Sheba and Whiskas. She was losing weight and there was a lot of wasted food. I started her on Katkin and after more than six months she is enjoying her food and cleaning her dish. She still has her finicky moments,and does like her special kibble, but she always  goes back to Katkin. She is healthier and more content.

records.title: My cat loves Katkin.
records.text: My cat loves Katkin and he eats every last crumb. Prior to Katkin he would lick the juice and leave the rest of the rubbish in the bowl. I wasted so much money trying to find something nourishing that he would enjoy. Then came Katkin! Their customer service is excellent and they reply very quickly if I have a question. My vet says my 18 year old boy is in surprisingly good condition for an old guy, so I will continue to feed him Katkin. Thank you Katkin x

records.title: Great food and good service
records.text: It's such a relief to have good quality cat food delivered straight to my door. I don't have to lug heavy tins from the supermarket any more. And I don't have to read all the labels to find which ones have the best meat content. My cat now gets 100% fresh meat, frozen in handy packs. Also, I can alter my deliveries easily to fit in with my own plans.

records.title: Happy Cat
records.text: After some issues with change of packaging and recipes my cat is delighted that all is back to KatKin’s best. Changing over to KatKin was tricky initially ( fussy cat ) but now he loves it and I’m sure his health has benefited as a result. There are a couple of flavours he’s not keen on but there is plenty of choice to keep him happy. He enjoyed his complimentary “ Xmas leftovers “ meal 😂 talk about spoilt or what 😂😂😂

records.title: Never trusted reviews on anything but…
records.text: Never trusted reviews on anything but Katkins literally improved my cat’s health. Her litter tray deposits smelt awful on tinned cat food and I tried every brand, she left more than she ate. On Katkins … the smell is gone and she eats EVERY scrap. Yes … it’s more expensive but there is no waste so I’m not throwing money away and my cats eating habits are no longer a worry

records.title: Scoop Health
records.text: Cat litter that they are selling Scoop Health is fantastic.  No odour at all and no mess around the sand box. Also it gives you possibility to monitor your cat's urine.  Product is perfect for cats owners,  it should be only more affordable

records.title: Best food for cats!
records.text: I do recommend KatKin for all cat parents. My cat’s health visibly improved since we switched to KatKin. She is able to maintain her ideal weight, her fur is so soft and shiny, her poop does not smell anymore. Her vet is so impressed! Compared to alternatives, very reasonably priced. Great customer service always, lovely staff. Thank you KatKin

records.title: We've  a really great experience with…
records.text: We've  a really great experience with Katkins ... our 3 all from the same litter and the day we started them on this they loved it. The packaging could be better but once you get used to it ... it's fine. We narrowed what seemed to be their favourite foods to just the chicken (cluck)and turkey (gobble)  packs, as they seemed less interested in the other options.

records.title: I absolutely love katkin for my cat
records.text: I absolutely love katkin for my cat. Felix eats the whole lot and even licks his bowl clean every meal which he doesn’t always do. He seems happier in himself after switching and usually sits at his bowl waiting to be fed ever meal time and eats it in one sitting

records.title: Kat Kin Improved My Cat’s Health
records.text: Before Kat Kin my little boy was having terrible poopnamis he took to Kat Kin right away and his poops solidified overnight. He is buzzing with energy and excited for the next half for dinner! I no longer have to carry heavy boxes up the road as I did with a mainstream brand from a supermarket. He also absolutely loves the chicken nibbles, he will come out of hiding once I lift the lid. He would eat the whole lot in one go if I left it with him.

records.title: My Ragdoll cat usually loves KatKin however..
records.text: My Ragdoll cat usually loves Katkin and has been served KatKin since she was a kitten since May last year, however recently she seems to be off it, I’m not sure if the recipes have changed? She use to love cluck but now whenever I serve it she would sniff it and walk away (and she is hungry, she runs to the kitchen as soon as I wake up in the morning) so it’s surprise. The packaging is the only thing that is off putting with the food it’s messy and ends up leaking out in the fridge.

records.title: Because your Cat deserves the Best
records.text: Absolutely the best food you can give your Feline Companion. Pure meat. Nothing else. Mine were always hungry two hours after eating canned supermarket food. Now they’re completely satisfied.

records.title: Persevere!
records.text: It took Twiglet a while to get used to the new 109% meat diet but she now enjoys her meals and has put on weight. Some flavours go down better than others, but that is to be expected.  Customer service is excellent: it is never too much trouble to change the order or the date and there is plenty of kitty expertise at the end of a phone

records.title: It's pricey but if you can afford it
records.text: It's pricey but if you can afford it, it's well worth it. My cats eat it all up so no wastage. Firmer, less stinky poos as well (a key consideration with indoor cats!).

records.title: Yes im happy with the breeders discount…
records.text: Yes im happy with the breeders discount price as i was finding the food a little too expensive! as im a pensioner But i can now afford it , 😊

records.title: Great product, bad packaging
records.text: I'm going to start off this review by saying that my fussy cat absolutely LOVES KatKin food, and by that measure I'll continue buying her it ad infinitum. However, I need to knock a whole star off for the packaging. When I first started buying KatKin the trays were much more sturdy, but in the interests of cost and (if I remember correctly) sustainability this was changed. I'd have no problem with this if the packets now didn't constantly burst, crack, or arrive already damaged. The last box I received had too many damaged packs to count, and it really makes me worry about the hygiene of the food given that it's not always totally frozen when it arrives either. I have already contacted customer service regarding the issue but have no hopes the packaging will be improved. It's worth tolerating for me but I really, really, really wish I didn't have to.

records.title: One cats loves this, the other one doesn't....…
records.text: I bought this for one of my cats who loves wet food. Unfortunately she is not interested & prefers her "junk" cat food. However, my other cat, who only ate crunchies & no wet food (although enjoys chicken & other human food if she can get her paws on it!) is enjoyed Katkin, which surprised me as I didn't think anything would tempt her away from her crunchies!

records.title: As a breeder we know the importance of…
records.text: As a breeder we know the importance of a good food that our cats enjoy. There’s a flavour to suit every cat. The price is fair especially with the breeders discount. Delivery is always on time. I would love the trays to be a little better as they tear easily when seperating but other than that it’s great. Emails are always answered politely, swiftly and with great knowledge

records.title: H is a fan although it took time.
records.text: H loves it!There is no waste and his coat is superb. Far better than when I was mainly feeding him on chicken breast.The only negatives are having room to store the product in the freezer and having the occasional packet that leaks (I'm assured they are working on this).I would have no hesitation in recommending KatKin but you do have to persist with it as H wouldn't eat it at first (this was also the case with my partners cat, her cat now loves it as much as H).

records.title: The food is of a high quality
records.text: The food is of a high quality. One of my cats really likes it. The other is less keen but we're still in the process of switching. Overall I'm happy we've changed to Katkin as I feel we're giving the cats more nutrious food.

records.title: I'm impressed ....
records.text: I'm impressed by the wide variety of options on Katkin's website enabling me to be quite precise about the content of each of my orders. I can change this each time I order.Eg. Choice of several types of meat or fish, Choice of numbers of each pouch (must add up to 28), Choice of several sizes of pouch, Choice of delivery date ....I've given this company 4 stars instead of 5 because it's impossible to return food pouches if your cat doesn't like the content. I know no-one else I can pass them on to other than a cat charity, so that can be a waste of money .. although overall the cost is reasonable given the 100%meat content....

records.title: Great fresh food but very expensive
records.text: It took my 14 year old cat roughly two weeks to get used to this food but now she runs to the bowl every time I serve dinner. I’ve noticed that she’s put on some weight and as I’ve stopped feeding her shop bought biscuits she no longer vomits after eating. Her coat looks shinier. The only downfall is that katkins is quite expensive. I would like to see more offers and discounts available for regular customers such as myself as you seem to only focus on bringing new customers in with deals and discounts.

records.title: Although my cat absolutely loves this…
records.text: Although my cat absolutely loves this fresh food, he still has his original meals. Kitkin is too expensive for me to be purchasing every month. Therefore I will buy kitkin every so often, almost like a treat. My main disappointment is the packaging. The sachets, which contains the food, needs to be improved to make it easier to open. There are thousands of people out there, like myself, with health issues. Which can make it a bit of a struggle to open. Using a pair of scissors, let alone a sharp knife to pierce and slice the packet to open, definitely needs to be addressed. Other then that, I will say this food is a 10-10 👍🏽. When having Kitkin food, my cat will always lick his platter CLEAN 😁.

records.title: Great choice of flavours
records.text: Great choice of flavours, ease of changing flavours via website. Good communication with company to change delivery dates and frequency.

records.title: One cat yes, other cat no
records.text: One cat, completely uninterested as she prefers biscuits/kibble. Other cat took several weeks to start to eat. Mostly a clean dish every time. Still adjusting to get the correct quantities. Other days, she turns her nose up as she gets bored easily. Quality of contents seem good. Can store in the freezer then defrost in the fridge or room. I'm not doing so well with the delivery set-up as they use DPD. (The last box was left on the 'front porch', which is actually the main entrance, on a main road, to my block of flats - despite instructions given on the app).

records.title: Good selection of flavours
records.text: Very straight forward website to order and customise the food required, and to swap out any flavours that my cat isn't keen on. Could be more transparent about prices as I got a 2 week trial box for £22 but first full order was £63. I didn't know full price until receipt of order conformation which only had postage and price per day so I had to work out the price myself. More than I would spend per month on food but hoping the health benefits out weigh the cost.

records.title: Roobie and Sapphie
records.text: My two elderly cats are now on Katkin and they love it. I no longer get leftovers and days when the fussy one turns up her nose are gone. It is worth spending the extra money for healthier food and clean plates.

records.title: Great food
records.text: Really great quality meat that my cat loves.  It is more expensive than your supermarket brands but when you break the cost down to what it is daily and for my cat's health it's worth it.My one suggestion for improvement would be to lessen the amount of plastic packaging used but not sure how this could be done without impacting the quality of the product.

records.title: 20 year old cat.…
records.text: I thought my 20 year old cat might be too old to change as previous owner fed him brands off supermarket shelf but, no, its that good he is happy and eager at meal times. Both his coat and the litter tray  contents are better.Would not change and any new cat will start on the same food.Recommend 100%

records.title: Happy cat
records.text: I have a senior puss with health issues . She did not get on with any store bought food but moving her to a Katkin diet has changed that and she is now a healthier weight My little furball is now a happy girl!

records.title: Pouches split
records.text: Our kitty seems to like the food, but unfortunately several of the pouches arrived split and when defrosting they leak in the fridge. Maybe re- think packaging design and durability?

records.title: I have herd a lot about this food
records.text: I have herd a lot about this food , so didn’t want to sign up for a subscription untill I researched it more , my neighbour gave me a few pouches as her kitty loves it but mine just didn’t  like it at all just kept licking but not eating he normally eats whiskers so been feeding him on this and no problems. Can kat kin explain the reason behind this .

records.title: Change of review
records.text: Despite excellent start Popeye now refusing to eat it although nothing medically wrong with him! So first impressions left below may be misleading although service remains excellent.Previous comments Excellent product and service. Popeye is a fussy eater that took only 2 days to make the change to Katkin. Same quantity of food given and now no wastage. Popeye seems to be more energetic and playful

records.title: My cats hated it …
records.text: Unfortunately my cats just downright refused to eat this. In fact, they appeared almost frightened of the food! Even with the sprinkles. It appeared very dry to me - added a little water, but no. They hated it. Tried for 2.5 weeks. They ate some but only when very very hungry. Then there’s the constant upselling, upselling, email upon email - gah. They’re back on Felix and are happy cats once more …

records.title: 5-year old cat liked it, but had digestive issues with it
records.text: I signed up for a trial as our 5-year old cat has always been very finicky and too addicted to dry food.  She actually converted to KatKin quite quickly, especially the chicken and turkey.  We had some concerns early on about poop issues, but that sorted itself out. However she's since had some vomiting issues with a couple of recipes. As she's never vomited or had diarrhea before, I'm thinking that it may be related to the food just not suiting her.  With regret, as I love the idea of feeding her more natural food products, I had to cancel the subscription.

records.title: At the moment she seems to be on hunger…
records.text: At the moment she seems to be on hunger strike will try everything to get her to eat it bet she’s very stubborn

records.title: Great food, awful packaging
records.text: Great cat food, obviously appreciated by the cats and really better their health and digestion. But the packaging has become unmanageable, the pouches are now impossible to open without a sharp knife, while cat food juice will invariably spill all over you, twice a day. There ought to be a better way to contain the food.

records.title: Nostalgia for the early days
records.text: I'm generally supportive of brands that promote the feeding of a mostly protein diet for cats. Indeed, I tried it out a while ago and though I found the packaging a bit of a mess to deal with, the cats got on okay with it and I was happy.I can't remember when the product went from real chunks of meat to a smooth pate but thats when my cats said 'no way' and they won't touch it now.Why did you have to go and change a really good thing?Bring back your original format and I'll support your brand again.

records.title: Change of packing - tricky to open
records.text: Initially no problems with packaging, easy to peel open. New shrink wrapped packaging in last 2 deliveries I am REALLY struggling to open. Invariably end up with liquid shooting out onto my clothes/work surfaces. Even cutting round the edges with scissors causes leakage.

records.title: Too expensive for me
records.text: I have nothing against this company, I actually think it’s pretty good. My cats absolutely loved the food, even my fussy little kitten, and the delivery was good and they even give you tips and advice on switching over to this food. Unfortunately in my circumstances it’s just too expensive, especially since I have two cats I need to feed. If you don’t mind spending around £50 a month per cat, then I highly recommend.

records.title: I so wanted my cats to love KatKin
records.text: I so wanted my cats to love KatKin. They certainly loved the 14 day trial, and I ordered the next months supply straightaway. It arrived on time, and I stashed it all away in my freezer, but each day I defrost a sachet from this batch and my cats either look at the food then look at me in disgust, or they turn and make like they are burying the food with cat litter. On the occasion that they do eat from the batch, they eat a mouthful or two and then straight for water as if it tastes bad. I've done all the advice from KatKin (chicken sprinkles - they lick the sprinkles and leave the food, getting them active before food etc etc), but my cats are not budging on this. I sent a message through the KatKin website to say I was thinking of cancelling and highlighted that it was only the second delivery that they refuse to eat and that the first trial box was fine (to me it seems like a dodgy batch?) but I received a standard email and my account was closed. You'd think they'd want to investigate this a little further? Anyway, I've cancelled my account and ordered from their competitor with tinned food now to try.

records.title: Why change what worked so well?
records.text: We are so disappointed!   We discovered Katkin a few months ago and our 1 year old cat immediately loved it, and so did we for the efficient service,  pleasant looking food and easy to use packs. However, what a shock it has been these last few weeks to find everything has changed!  The packs are difficult to open, causing mess and spillages, most of the recipes come as a hard lump which needs chopping up, and flakes of fat and liquid make it very unpleasant to deal with.  The cat does still eat them usually, but  we re now researching alternatives.  It's such a shame you changed your cooking method!

records.title: Cat loved it, humans hated it
records.text: Our cat absolutely loved this food, but we ended up cancelling after about a year because the packaging is so poorly designed. When we first started, the container had a peel-off lid, which worked really well and meant you could recycle it properly. Then they made a change and even though it looked the same, the peeling didn't work (just ripped off around the edge or you had to use such force it sprayed you with meat juice). Apparently you were now meant to cut the end off, but this is clearly not the original design intention since there's still a peel off flap. Anyway, it's now become 100x harder to clean for recycling and the packaging regularly broke during transit, while in the freezer, or in the fridge, and I just can't stand constantly finding surprise meat juice everywhere. You also need to plan to have one third of your freezer space used up when you get a delivery. We ended up moving to a brand that uses tins that can be infinitely recycled and are way less messy.

records.title: Initially we loved Katkin
records.text: Initially we loved Katkin, more importantly our furry overseer did too. However after they changed recipe to the individual trays things changed. I hated the extra plastic, it just seemed excessive. I didn't begrudge them smaller portions as costs had clearly increased. Our furry owner started one by one going off of each flavour, first it was splash, then baa, then finally when she stopped eating moo we had to give up. It was a shame but hey ho.

records.title: Someone needs to get a grip
records.text: Mmmm? Repeated issues would suggest that there are serious problems with product production, packaging and quality control….We have experienced problems with incorrect packing, wrong product and RAW FOOD being delivered in our last order. While these issues were meant to have been dealt with, Kat Kin appears to have forgotten their offers to compensate and are now advising us of further packaging issues…..Someone needs to get a grip!!!

records.title: Poorly designed packaging …
records.text: The product itself is clearly high quality but I couldn’t get over how quickly the packaging became an absolute nightmare, especially  in a multi cat household.. the trays themselves are super messy and often split making me question freshness. I would also like larger tubs for all 4 cats combines both to minimise plastic and to simply split the food each morning between them .. sadly my cats also just didn’t like the food after a few days and my older ( almost toothless cat ) struggled to eat it .. on the whole I see why cats love it but my crew much prefer Bella and duke , and I prefer less hassle and mess with the packaging and serving of food. It’s also way more expensive compared to alternatives in the market.

records.title: Once great, now disappointing
records.text: A quick disclaimer: our cats like the food and I used to rave about the food.However, changes in recent packaging and food texture have made me cancel.The packaging is now impossible to open,  having to resort to scissors, causing meaty water dripping everywhere. Also the change in texture, especially the pork, is difficult to mash compared to before. I also feel the quality of the food has gone downhill.Used to be great, but I’m unsure about recent changes. I also need my freezer space back again (not KatKins fault!)

records.title: Great…but, the new packaging is awful
records.text: We’ve been using Katkin for a while & our cat loves it. She’s not very food motivated, so that’s a big deal. But…the new packaging is awful, horrible to open & when you do, meat juices go everywhere. I know scissors are recommended, but they really shouldn’t be necessary, the last design was fine. It seems like a small thing, but being irritated twice a day is enough to make me want to stop our subscription.

records.title: Had a good run, cancelled over new packaging
records.text: We had a good run with Katkin but have cancelled our subscription because the new packaging is simply less user-friendly than the previous plastic trays. The new packaging is harder to open (although you can avoid using scissors if you carefully peel it at one corner). It’s messier and can’t be cleaned out easily for recycling - which has to be in soft plastic recycling e.g. at Co-op shops. The old packaging was mostly kerbside recyclable. It’s sufficiently annoying to use that we are going to switch to another supplier. The food itself is pretty good and improved our cat’s health and coat. Price point was good. Update: Katkin reached out by phone to discuss the issues above and offered a refund on the last box purchased.

records.title: Loved Katkin but now not so sure
records.text: Our cats have loved Katkin for a long time now. Licking their bowls clean every single time without fail, and with glossy coats & lots of energy to show for it. The new packaging and formula is really disappointing though. I appreciate why they’ve done it but I’ve actually found myself guiltily throwing the odd one in the bin because I’ve made such a mess of cutting it open and can’t wash the oily meat residue off even with hot water and soap. What’s worse is they don’t seem to be enjoying the food as much as they did and one of the cats has developed diarrhoea since making the switch. Such a pain because they were so happy before!

records.title: My cat hated it
records.text: My gullible wife wasted £30 after falling for the hype. We starved our cat for 2 days and he still wouldn't touch it. He thought we were punishing him.Some cats might love the stuff, but don't assume yours will.

records.title: Food was rotten, mouldy and rank.
records.text: Out of approximately 50 packets of food that we have received so far, two were completely rotten and covered in green/ black mould - when opened, they stunk the whole house out for hours, it was completely rank. The other packets did not smell great, which makes me concerned that we might have been feeding our cat rotten meat without realising it. The cat eats some of the flavours but won't touch the others. The cat litter was a waste of money, definitely did not last the amount of time advertised and did not work as intended. We are still using the service for now, but I will likely look for an alternative in the new year.I also found the website clunky and not user-friendly at all. As a web designer myself, I believe their website has been specifically designed to make it difficult to cancel an order (the "cancel order" tab on the site sends users on an infinite loop, around in circles).  Overall, the product and website could be improved.

records.title: Check your trays for plastic in the food.
records.text: Finding a small piece of plastic in one of my KatKin meals was the absolute last straw and the worst offense, but they have terrible packaging issues which has meant i've nearly thrown away as many meals as I have had re-delivered. They're atleast fixing the packaging now but finding the plastic in my cats food meant I have lost any and all trust in this brand moving forward. It's a true shame because my cat adored the Beef meals and I thought we were onto a winner, but the rest were a struggle to get my cat to eat!

records.title: No delivery
records.text: No delivery, no further communication from Katkin, so I have cancelled my subscription and put in for a refund via my bank. Very disappointing.30/11/2024: Edited after responding via email. I want a refund back to my credit card.09/12/2024: Edited. KatKin Support were very good at reaching out to me regarding the refund. This has now been received into my bank account. Thank you Katkin.11/12/2024: Edited. I have been asked to rethink the star rating. So I have changed it to 2. I am not criticising the after event support at all, that was 5 star. However the non delivery was very tedious for many reasons. Having to stay at home for two days, waiting. I ran out of cat food on the 3rd day so had to go out and buy a new brand of tinned food and adjust my cat to that. And no notifications from the courier. None. The courier is the issue. And previous deliveries sometimes the box was thrown at my front door. No ringing of the door bell, no knocking at the door. I have a door knocker as well as a door bell.

records.title: Review for the katkin litter
records.text: Review for the katkin litter. It smells ok but the way it clumps compared to standard clumping litter is awful and sticks to the scooper. Rather than cat pee go through the depth of the litter box and clump, it spreads across the top and goes all mushy meaning high chance of kitty stepping on it which he has. Reverted back to standard clumping litters that don’t also stick to the scooper.

records.title: Not the best
records.text: very strange that i received damaged produce proved with pictures. The offer was that I would be credited if i were to reactivate my subscription. I wouldn't be using or recommending this. Also arrived 4 days late. With all this in mind there is no way i could commit to a expensive subscription service My experience wasn't the best with this company.UPDATE 4th Oct Took the time for a call back from company all now resolved.All parties happy genuinely will look into the issues raised.This is excellent customer service from this company top marks.

records.title: 2nd Subscription doubled in price
records.text: My cat likes the food,  Packaging messy, doesn't open as it should.  Customer service poor.  My second subscription has doubled in price so be aware you may be paying twice what you originally thought.  This is a subscription service.

records.title: Not for older cats in my opinion. Made ours sick.
records.text: We have an older cat and this food made him throw up violently first 2 pouches. So started mixing it with one of his old foods (whiskas pouches) to no avail, more vomit. 3 cans of carpet cleaner later, I gave up and cancelled. Funny thing is, despite his Senior years, our cat will literally eat anything and has never had an upset tummy. Thought I'd try katkin as it's supposed to be healthier. Hmm. Reading the other reviews, bit worried they'll send me more and charge me too now. Better not!

records.title: It made my both cats very ill
records.text: It made my both cats very ill! Now there’s an expensive vet bill to pay! The reason I am giving 2* is purely because I like the initiative of trying to feed fresh but there’s definitely a problem with how they store/refrigerate the food. My cats aren’t fussy and they didn’t like the food one bit, they’re seriously ill afterwards. They started refusing food (even the previous one they’re on - Felix) got dehydrated and had to be hospitalised getting IV fluids. It was unfortunately a mistake trying KatKin and now I am just hoping the cats will be okay. Painful experience.

records.title: Honest review
records.text: I brought this for my kitten Ivy, she loved it the first time and isn’t so keen on it anymore (the second box). She does however enjoy the chicken treats that come with it. However, her poos absolutely stink since eating this food, so that is one lie they tell, and from what I have worked out, you do not save money. If your getting this for your puddy cat then keep in mind they will take the money straight out of your bank without giving you a warning before the trail box has finished. My second box was also massively delayed, about 2 weeks late and as a ‘sorry’ they sent me a free bag!? Customer service is also shocking.  Anyway I didnt come to slam the company, just to give an honest review.

description: The UK's No1 Veterinary Joint Supplement Brand. On a mission to help all dogs, cats and horses live an active life, for life.

records.title: EXCELLENT SERVICE, RECOMMEND HIGHLY
records.text: We had to cancel our order for Max Strength You-Move tablets for the only reason that my lovely wee Staffie, Levi, has only days/weeks or if very lucky months left to live. He has a tumour on his liver and as he us 12yrs old there is no point risking any type of surgery.I was due to have a subscription delivered but the team at You Move have cancelled this and my membership,

records.title: Recommend for elderly dogs or dogs that…
records.text: Recommend for elderly dogs or dogs that are struggling with their mobility, this helped Harry tremendously. He behaved like a puppy again.Our vet was pleased with the results too. Thanks yumove

records.title: Loved the double pack offers…
records.text: Loved the double pack offers coupled with the 50% off first two months subscription in the boxing day sale! Abigail in the customer services was a star helping me set up my two subscriptions successfully. Thank you Abigail and fingers crossed for my dog Caesar's joints and teeth in the new year 🐶✨😁

records.title: Shameera's Customer Service
records.text: Had to call yumove customer service today, about non delivery of my 2 dogs yumove joint care plus. I explained the problem to Shameera, who was so helpful, friendly and efficient. She quickly sorted everything out and reordered for me as i was worried about running out of tablets for my dogs. Can't speak highly enough of Shameera. Definitely worth far more than 5 stars. If only all customer services were as good as this.

records.title: Caught out with incorrect supplier of yumove
records.text: Was buying from Amazon for a few years until recently received notice from Amazon that site was illegal and selling yumove that could harm my dog. I have now subscribed to Yumove for supplies for my dog.

records.title: When I lost one of my dogs they sent…
records.text: When I lost one of my dogs they sent forget me not seeds and card . No problem reactivating when we took on another dog to our pack . They go over and above to ensure you need every months tablets , that they are the right strength for breed and size , weight of dog . We have used Yu Move for over 15 years and have always been more than happy with there excellent product and service

records.title: Fast & sufficient Ordering & Delivery
records.text: Ordering online was so smooth & easy.  Information given to make sure your Dogs needs are catered for are excellent.  Easy process at checkout. Delivery arrived  on time & it's goid you can start & stop your subscription at any time. Highly recommend 👌

records.title: I love the products and have kept on…
records.text: I love the products and have kept on ordering them throughout the year. They also get approval from our vets. I don’t like the subscription method though - would much rather be rewarded for my loyalty when I ordered again.

records.title: My Furbaby Alfie is 13 Years old and I…
records.text: My Furbaby Alfie is 13 Years old and I have noticed that when winter arrives he's limping on his front leg. I read the recommendations for Yumove Max Strength senior tablets, only been giving Alfie them a week at 2 tablets a day and I cannot believe the change he digs in the sand and walks a lot better now gets up and down off the sofa and goes up the stairs freely.I just want to say that I highly recommend YUMOVE the whole experience is amazing and now I have my Furbaby and his joints back almost in full working condition. Thank you.

records.title: Thank you for a great service and product.
records.text: Thank you for an amazing product and service.  Our beautiful golden retriever Olly had Yumove for many years (5+) we feel that it made a big difference to his arthritis and spondylitis, he took it until he died when he was 15 years old.  Bless him x

records.title: Product is good but...
records.text: Product is good; sales methods are REALLY annoying.  You can't buy what you want without paying silly money for it, not without having to mess about with dates and other computer-generated stuff.  AND all the incessant adverts for other products I don't want, and my dog is not likely to need for many years yet, is both annoying and shows a lack of self-confidence in the company's products if they have to attempt to sell them that heavily!  And why do I have to wait for 3 months because YOUR comanpany's counting system says so?  When I needed to use more, I had to change the date, not just re-order, (in case I got two lots next quarter!), and if I used less, you'd still try to sell me what YOU consider my requirements are, denying me the choice.  VERY frustrating and frankly, disrespectful...

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service but I have stopped the subscription as I seem to be stockpiling. Product has certainly helped our little girl who was starting to show signs of stiff joints.

records.title: Anything that keeps my lovely dog Lucy…
records.text: Anything that keeps my lovely dog Lucy agile and seemingly out of pain I will always rate it highly.Yu Move does just that and I thank them for producing something that works.

records.title: Disappointed by shipping
records.text: Item arrived ok but i was disappointed to see it was not packaged in its own box! The pills just came on their own in the shipping box!

records.title: My issue is that I am getting the wrong sort of advice
records.text: My issue is that - despite my order being for calming tablets rather than any joint problems  - I keep receiving targeted messages about my pet's mobility. Now I look at the customer reviews, this is the thrust of all these too. But very friendly staff have responded cheerily to my comments and will hopefully amend their records so I get more relevant messages from them!

records.title: Our very old westie seems to benifit…
records.text: Our very old westie seems to benifit from these tablets, combined with very expensive injections at the vet.He obviously gets benifit and is more than happy to eat them as a treat.Friends use this product  and all of them are happy with the results, so really speaks for itself. Well done, thank you from Charlie the westie!

records.title: YuMove products are great.... shame about the delivery.
records.text: YuMove products are great. The reason I will not give 5star is due to the incompetence of Yodel as a delivery contract. Have ordered directly before and delivered by Royal Mail I believe... no issues..  Yodel saw the same number of my house on a nearby street and delivered there... luckily the house owner saw the correct address on the package and brought it around!

records.title: Too eager to deliver
records.text: Too eager to deliver.  my stock rose to 3 months supply and I had to pause delivery.  otherwise first class.

records.title: Had good service until recently.Unable…
records.text: Had good service until recently.Unable to contact  by phone. Nobody manning the phone. Had to complain about the damage to the tablets all broken at the bottom and crushed.Noticed delivered by Yodel and wondered if that was the problem!!So frustrating. Eventually sorted out.Hope to get the service we used to get. First time i have ever had to complain.

records.title: They seem to work very well.
records.text: They seem to work very well.However the next months supply seems to come earlier each month,so yo eventually find you are a month ahead!

records.title: Service was great and my dog really…
records.text: Service was great and my dog really benefitted from the tablets. Only problem was how the amount  tablets built up. I tried to suspend for a few months but had to cancel  subscription in the end until my excess tablets are used up.

records.title: Good product
records.text: The Yumove senior daily tablet has improved the movement of our 8 year old dog, however we have decided to move to the Yumove daily bites as they are much cheaper via Amazon and our dog prefers them. We dropped one star as we feel the price for the tablets is high compared to the price of other Yumove products.

records.title: Normally the supplements turn up on…
records.text: Normally the supplements turn up on time but I'm presuming the Christmas post was a bit slower so they were a couple of days late.

records.title: Picky
records.text: Sadly my dog refuses to eat it. She fishes it out of her food and leaves it! Past experience with other dogs has been good though!

records.title: Some concerns when taken with Loxicome.
records.text: Lottie who is a Working cocker aged 13 is not surprisingly having issues with her back legs. She is on Loxicome from the vet but a friend suggested YuMove as well. We tried her on YuMove and she became very agitated and hyper and started prowling around the house all day. After four days, we stopped the dose and she went back to normal, active but not hyper.The two treatments seemed not to go well together. YuMove were very understanding and refunded my costs. They and us will discuss this issue with our respective vets and see if it is just Lottie or more general. I have no hesitation in recommending this company. They have never met this problem before. They have bent over backwards to help.

records.title: Good service from this company but I…
records.text: Good service from this company but I was surprised to receive two orders of the same tablets. The order will not be wasted and price was very good. I will need to keep an eye on the transactions to ensure I have not managed to order repeat orders.

records.title: My 12yo lab seems to have improved…
records.text: My 12yo lab seems more mobile than before taking Yumove. It is still early days but he now has slow short runs again when he didn’t before and has jumped into the back of my suv again when he couldn’t before

records.title: Milo’s chewies arrive regularly without…
records.text: Milo’s chewies arrive regularly without having to chase YuMove for them. Service is great so definitely recommended

records.title: Since start of October -phones down no…
records.text: Since start of October -phones down no response other than automated emails -put one mistake right then  --another mistake got dealt with The products are good but something must be going wrong on the admin side.

records.title: On Time.
records.text: goods as ordered arrived on time. no worries. despatch date has been altered to take into account the far north of Scotland., with delayed delivery times.

records.title: Dog & Cat supplement subscription
records.text: Nicely and securely packaged.To be honest I've not seen a great improvement but I don't expect miracles to happen, it takes time. I've subscribed to both cat and dog supplements, taking advantage of the free month for cats. What I don't like is there's no reminder of the dispatch or bank debit, which would be appreciated.

records.title: Sorry to report that my dog Dottie has…
records.text: Sorry to report that my dog Dottie has died aged nearly 16. She was helped in her later years with Yumove tablets. I did however receive more than she needed and had to suspend deliveries a couple of times and am still left with a few packs of unused tablets.

records.title: I have been giving my dog Golden retriever Chelsea…
records.text: I have been giving my dog Chelsea yumove tablets for several months and thinking of canceling my subscription. I understand these tablets have helped many dogs according to the reviews which is fantastic, however for my 12 year golden retriever she is still struggling walking much.

records.title: Yumove goods are the best
records.text: Yumove goods are the best.  The reason for my low review is the delivery company Yodel that you use does not like delivering to rural Melbourne.  They say it is out for delivery, it never appears.  They say they are delivering the next day, they do, but they leave it out in the rain and do not have the intelligence to put it under a bench to keep it dry.  My last two deliveries from Yodel have been wet and the boxes disintegrate.  Appalling delivery company.

records.title: Sainsburys is cheaper than direct subscription
records.text: The product itself is great used it for over a year when it was £15 per month for subscription then it went up to £17.64 which i understand everything has increased in price but to now realise i could have been buying it from Sainsburys for £16 is shocking, as a direct cusyomer of your product i would have thought you would have made sure you have the premium price but clearly not i am paying extra £1.64 because im ordering directly from you, had to cancel my subscription.

records.title: Strange customer service but hopefully a good outcome
records.text: I get their yumega oil on subscription. Just had a bottle where pump was faulty (2nd time this has happened). Unfortunately l didn’t keep old bottle so couldn’t swap pumps (which l did previously), so sent an email requesting a new empty bottle with working pump, reply wanted images of bottle, what for I’ve no idea as this doesn’t show it not working! All l wanted was a new bottle, eventually they are sending my order again which was unnecessary but happy something has been done.

records.title: Tablets seem to work but delivery terrible
records.text: Tablets seem to work for v old cat but the powder HAS to be mixed in with lots of food otherwise she's very sick. Disappointed that you use useless Yodel, that and delayed shipping meant I am back to square 1 as I had no tablets for several days. Going to cancel my subscription because of this and order from elsewhere.

records.title: I buy the joint supplement tablets…
records.text: I buy the joint supplement tablets which do help my border collie the tablets need to taken daily to maintain the benefits. Very disappointing and unkind on our fur legged friends when orders do not arrive! I ordered two weeks ago and have still not received my much needed order! Be great to hear from you my order of 300 tablets has still not arrived! I have continuously purchased these tablets and always order in good time so that my border collie never misses taking them.

records.title: I have not seen any improvement as yet…
records.text: I have not seen any improvement as yet with my cat

records.title: Our dog has been on tablets for about 4…
records.text: Our dog has been on tablets for about 4 months now and we do not feel it is helping.

records.title: Yodel.....
records.text: I ordered a supply of You move tablets. The promised delivery time was between 1-3days.The tablets arrived 7 days later. The product is no doubt excellent but if you are going to use Yodel as you delivery merchant I believe you should alter your delivery promise dates....

records.title: Good product bad delivery service
records.text: Product is good but the delivery service you use are terrible. We have signed up for a monthly subscription but if we have another delivery problem this month we will be cancelling. Despite being home Yodel ‘delivered’ package to another house - they left package on a windowsill which was only found because we went looking for it!

records.title: The product is without doubt very good…
records.text: The product is without doubt very good , but having submitted the order I found the delivery time very poor , lets face it order from Amazon it gets delivered the next day ,but from YouMove it took 5 days and I had run out of my previous stock.First class service from Customer services following my  review concerning the delivery time, can not be faulted at all , was given a refund which was not expected so very pleased with there attention to the review. A first class organisation.

records.title: Good product but......
records.text: Good product, delivery times were abysmal but have improved, but could still be better.  If you state a delivery period then ensure you make that happen. i'm ordering from amazon and most of the time it comes by courier, but its on time, sometimes earlier.I'm sure im not the only one experiencing this and from a glance at some of the reviews id say that is your major problem ruining a good customer service and sending people elsewhere. Yes it will be your product that still sells but customer service is better and goes further than shoddy cheapskate delivery efforts and poor excuses which tarnishes your company.Since writing this review you have been asking for specific delivery times.  The complaint/problem is delivery, so what makes you think this is just an occasional thing? ITS EVERY DELIVERY!! Trying to come up with an excuse for each and every is pathetic! Service is service. If you see a lot of customers complaining about that side of your business, look to that side of your company and improve it across the board! My last order was Nov 2024 you already have my details. Why threaten me to provide these details with removing this review?

records.title: Your product is very good have used for…
records.text: Poor delivery serviceYour product is very good have used for a very long time and would recommend it. The delivery is another matter took 8 days and umpteen messages to yodel who kept saying they had attempted to deliver it but cctv said otherwise. After giving a safe place to leave, an alternative address and 3 little words it finally turned up! Battered but luckily the oil was intact. description:
In 2008 our founder Henrietta started making food from scratch at her kitchen table in London for her Border Terrier Lily. All because she really, really loved her. That love for our pets started Lily’s Kitchen and still keeps us going today. 
Pets are family and they deserve proper food
But what is proper food?  Proper food means nutritionally complete recipes made by experts, labelled honestly, using ethically sourced natural ingredients. No meat meal, no additives and no cheap fillers. Just fresh meat, delicious veg, and herbs and botanicals that support your dogs’ and cats’ health so they can concentrate on sitting on laps, shoulders and heads, demanding walkies, 6am breakfasts and knocking things over with their tails ‘by accident’ – or so they claim.
For people, pets and the planet
We’re a certified BCorp. That means we believe in using business as a force for good. Here are a few of our guiding values:
Supporting charities
In the last 6 months we’ve donated over 28,000 meals to dog and cat shelters and we’re not stopping there. We’re always working on ways we can partner with charities of all sizes to help in any way we can, be it fundraising, donations or rolling up our sleeves and volunteering our own time.
Minimising our pawprint on the planet
From the way we work to improve our packaging (which is nearly all compostable or recyclable) to the cleaning products we choose for our office. Every decision has the planet at it’s core.
Being a BCorp and staying a BCorp
We are the founding UK BCorporation and every three years we re-certify by evidencing meeting the highest standards of verified social and environmental performance, public transparency and legal accountability to balance profit and purpose.

records.title: Great food but disapprove of Vegan option

Dogs are omnivorous, but nonetheless they won’t get all the nutrients they need from plants alone. I advocate for humans choosing a vegan diet for themselves, but we shouldn’t be inflicting this on our animals. It’s dangerous to encourage this purchasing behaviour from shoppers and not in the interest of the health of dogs.

records.title: Love Lilly’s kitchen and will keep on…

records.title: Very affordable and sustainable option

My cat is a fussy eater who prefers the cuts (I guess she's not a fan of the pate's structure, but that's a purrsonal thing I guess). Have been feeding her cuts for two months now and she seems happy, healthy, and has a shiny fur.The only thing I'd appreciate improving is being more transparent about the ingredients - it would be great to include details about what cuts of meat were used (muscles, cartilage, innards etc) as 'meat' is quite a vague description. Other than that, I have only positive things to say.

records.title: Top product but every time we order in…

records.title: Recipe has cheapened and changed for the worst. My 10yr old pointer had been on Lily’s…
records.text: My 10yr old pointer had been on Lily’s kitchen since a puppy. Lilys kitchen was bought out by Nestle Purina in 2021. I stuck with it, but started to notice a change in the smell and appearance of the food around 2022/2023 and then noticed a decline in my dogs condition and coat. She got patchy fur and a dull coat and just seemed off. At first I put it down to a number age related factors before switching her food to Natures Menu this year 2024 and she’s improved so much. Lilys kitchen has definitely changed & cheapened and was actually making my dogs sick. Both my 10yr old and 2yr old dogs are shiny and back to best since I changed. I’ll never buy it again.

records.title: Mouldy food
records.text: Once again the delivery upon opening has crushed lids on the small foil tins.The outer packaging is undamaged so this must be happening in the factory.The issue is that this deformation causes the seal to break and the food inside is bad and has mould.Unfortunately this is not always immediately noticeable resulting in food poisoning.I have brought this up with them twice now submitting photos and they have been apologetic but it has just happened again - not happy

records.title: Very disappointed.

records.title: Lily's Kitchen offers quality food, however, too expensive.

This has been a more cost-effective option, especially considering Max's dietary needs.Lily's Kitchen is great for dogs without sensitive stomachs, but be prepared for high prices if you don’t have a discount.

records.title: I wanted a Christmas present for my…

Then took a photo of what I had ordered to show my beloved on Christmas DayNeedn’t have bothered it was all delivered Christmas Eve!Wow!!We live on an Island, so deliverys take longer sometimes. records.title: Speedy delivery…

records.title: Fast and affordabble…
records.text: My order was fulfilled and delivered within 2-3 days. As always GardenBird offer  reliable service and affordable prices. My box of bird food was left in a convenient place without any hassle by the delivery driver.

records.title: The Birds Love the Stuff
records.text: A good range of products to choose from, competitive prices and quick delivery. The driver kindly put the 25kg package straight into the garage.

records.text: ordering was easy,there was good swift communication from the delivery company and my order arrived exactly as advised and within the time slot. The parcel was well packed and the plastic article inside was extremely well packaged.  A very good service !

records.title: Packaging issues
records.text: The quality of your bird food is very good - however the packaging of your suet pellets could be better!I suggest that stronger plastic bags could be used to prevent spillages when transferring the pellets from the cardboard boxes to the storage bins. On 2 occasions the bags have split when lifted from the boxes resulted in a cascade of suet hitting the deck!

records.title: All goods were received in good condition

The only problem I had was that the courier separated the order of two packages and created two separate deliveries. One was late morning, and the second was very late afternoon/early evening.
