records.title: Double delivery..
records.text: Promp delivery but over two days. the supposed second delivery at 1700hrs. on the first day did not happen but was delivered the next day...

records.title: Happy with product but not delivery !!
records.text: Very happy with the product & prices & the speed in which order delivered. Not happy with delivery drivers who continually ignore my ‘safe place’ & leave the boxes outside which means that if it rains the boxes etc get wet. On my last delivery I saw the driver & showed him exactly where the ‘safe place ‘ was. Basically they are too lazy or in too much of a hurry to just take a couple more minutes to put the parcels under cover.I have reported this before & nothing changes.Is there any point in  doing these reviews if no action is taken !!!!!

records.title: I have used garden birds 🐦 before and…
records.text: I have used garden birds 🐦 before and they were very helpful with my order last time so I thought why not use them again, good delivery time we'll packed when my parcel's arrived nothing was too much trouble 😀

records.title: BAD DELIVERY SERVICEi would have given 5 were it not for…
records.text: i would have given 5 were it not for the bad DVD delivery , again they did not bring it to my house, but dropped it t the mailroom of the caravan park. My house like so many houses here have a proper legal address, i heard others complain about deliveries not brought to their door. Please birdfood find another transporter or  do tel them this is not on! i'll think twice before  ordering from birdfood again unless i'm assured of the home delivery! for which we pay £7 extra cause of  living in morayshire!!!

records.title: Seeds arrived promptly BUT
records.text: Seeds arrived promptly, but the delivery man did not ring my bell while I was waiting in for the delivery.I only learned it had been delivered when checking emails. A picture of the boxes by my front door, with the caption "left with a neighbour"

records.title: Happy birds
records.text: I've ordered from Gardenbird many times.  The birds seem very happy with my choice of food for them and everything gets eaten from the square suet blocks to the different seed mixes.Sometimes the packing isn't as could as it could be,  with heavy items being put on top of breakable and sometimes things might get squashed.  I had one delivery go missing but it arrived a while later,  not sure what happened.  Maybe the driver took the scenic route.The items are of a good quality and the birds are very happy so I will continue to order

records.title: Easy ordering and prompt delivery
records.text: I've been a GBS customer for many years now and have always found their online ordering process easy to use.  It's also very helpful that standard unit prices are shown, as this makes comparison of products straightforward.Delivery is usually within the estimated date and as I buy bird food in bulk (heavy!) it's convenient to have this delivered to my door.Unfortunately, on my last purchase, the nut feeder was omitted from the delivery.  However, this was quickly remedied by an email exchange and I received the feeder within a couple of days.

records.title: Received very quickly...but the box was split open
records.text: Received very quickly - Excellent....however, the box was split open but I think the delivery company were careful and no seed was  lost. Moving the parcel for me was however, quite tricky!

records.title: Always a fast delivery in a big box
records.text: Always a fast delivery in a big box. I do have some difficulty lifting the seed sacks but younger people would not. Box is sometimes broken, due to the handling.Products are excellent and the birds love the sunflower seed hearts and the peanuts.

records.title: As usual order arrived promptly and of…
records.text: As usual order arrived promptly and of good quality.The reward points scheme could be made more streamlined: having just put in an order, I’ve had an email to say my points will expire soon. Perhaps they could be automatically refunded when an order is made, as I didn’t think to check when making the purchase

records.title: The food appears nicely fresh and the…
records.text: The food appears nicely fresh and the birds certainly gobble it up.Being able to buy in bulk at great prices. With the added benefit of multiple inbox containers makes for easier handling.

records.title: The range of bird food is excellent
records.text: The range of bird food is excellent, the service and delivery is very good, as are the prices. What prevents a 5 Star rating is the complicated ‘special’ offers, including free delivery. I highly recommend the service and bird foods. However, read the ‘small print’ carefully.

records.title: Very good and efficient service and…
records.text: Very good and efficient service and deliveryBut could improve the packaging by replacing the plastic sticky tape (which goes to landfill) with degradable brown tape.

records.title: Quick service and good bird seed, however the DPD delivery was poor.
records.text: Speedy response, the birds love the sunflower hearts. I knocked off one star for delivery. DPD failed to deliver to the correct house, despite stating that the delivery was left with myself, alongside a photo of the parcel at the wrong house. The previous GB delivery DPD abandoned the box on the pavement outside my house, despite there being 2 different alternative directions available to them, within a few feet of the address.

records.title: The only reason why I haven't given 5…
records.text: The only reason why I haven't given 5 stars is because the coconut string isn't always long enough to hang and sometimes it just comes out. However our garden birds love them ❤️

records.title: Good quality bird food
records.text: Good quality bird food. Delivery fast by DPD, would recommend without hesitation. One drawback is packaging; please get rid of plastic and fabric sacks, more paper packaging neededwould've given 5 star. contact your suppliers please to get rid of plastic products.

records.title: When free delivery offers come up
records.text: When free delivery offers come up, Our Scottish post code is never offered reductions available elsewhere. Up to 25 kilos one price, when you add 12.5 kilo delivery  doubles to same as 50 kilos, This is disappointing.

records.title: Suet balls arrived quickly
records.text: Suet balls arrived quickly, I ordered 300 of these 264 were whole the rest were broken, but the birds didn't care, so as long as they are happy, no problem.

records.title: Outer box was damaged
records.text: Outer box was damaged, but contents ok. Left on doorstep without ringing doorbell and no note. Otherwise good service.

records.title: Squirrel Snack box
records.text: I bought the Squirrel Snack Box made by Tom Chalmers. As others have said the squirrel just pulled the plastic front out and dispensed with it. I shall have to make sure this is fixed in future. Also the base is only pinned with very small pins so the weight of the squirrel has bent this down and all peanuts have fallen out. Again repairs are necessary, it needs 4 screws not thin pins, otherwise it seems well made

records.title: Product from Garden Bird Supplies, Delivery problems
records.text: The product and service from Garden Bird Supplies was good, but was let down by the terrible service from EVRI.  The parcel was not delivered on the agreed date, and EVRI did not contact me again for several days. Their website showed delivery the following day due to issues in the area, but it was not delivered then, either. The next day they informed me of delivery, we had already gone out, so the next day delivery took a week!  The box had been damaged in transit, taped up, and damaged again.  Fortunately the contents were ok.

records.title: Damaged bird feeder.
records.text: The bird feeder arrived very quickly but unfortunately damaged. It was very well packed but was dented and bent so the damaged must have occurred before packing. We have been able to straighten enough to be able to use it to avoid the hassle of returning it. This is a shame as it was not cheap. So far the birds are ignoring it but it's early days.

records.title: Service great. Containers not so
records.text: Service, price and delivery excellent but the containers really weren't as I had hoped. I had hoped that they would remain safely closed when filling the feeders. So I have made my own scoops from narrow drink bottles and that fixed the problem.

records.title: I buy from Garden Bird on a regular…
records.text: I buy from Garden Bird on a regular basis and always choose leave safe delivery because I’m disabled with spinal issues and we both work full time hours. On this occasion the two extremely heavy boxes were just dumped at my front door instead of where they usually leave them stored safely. So when I got home from work I had to shuffle the boxes inside the house and I hurt my back. So the 3 rating is purely based on the actual delivery from DPD. Garden bird as a company are amazing and I will continue to use them every month or so to keep my local blackbirds fed with suet ☺️

records.title: Too much transit to suet products
records.text: The prices are comparable with competitors. Delivery service fast and professional. There is too much damage to products caused by packing/transit. It's always been a problem, but it's been made worse by the 'environment friendly' packing. Plastic bags are better than paper for me! When I order suet fat balls and sprinkles, I don't want be dumping a large proportions that have been turned into granules/powder. The nuts and seeds are fine.

records.title: Goods excellent as usual
records.text: Goods as always very good. However ONCE AGAIN parcel left in porch not in my registered safe place. Parcel far too heavy for me to carry through the house. Garden bird excellent. Delivery company do not follow instructions.

records.title: Would have been five stars
records.text: Would have been five stars, but the price manipulation should not be legal. They offer constant discounts, but put the price up so you are still paying the standard price. Other than that, good quality product and quick delivery.

records.title: Good products
records.text: I buy most of my bird food from this Company and the quality is excellent. But the website can be clunky this time the discount code did not work though GB did refund me the amount without quibble I also had qualified for next day delivery but it was several days before it came

records.title: Minimax problem but reliable company
records.text: Service is very good. I would give five stars. However... I am disappointed with the MiniMax pellets which I ordered.  I substituted them for the normal mealworm pellets I normally get from Garden Bird, but my regular garden bird visitors, as well as the three resident squirrels, absolutely refused them. One of the squirrels dumped them out of the feeder. All were left  behind. Clearly unappetising and not considered as edible by our wildlife.

records.title: Generally a happy customer
records.text: I have bought from Garden Bird and its sibling companies for a number of years. The birdfood is the cheapest I have found and the top of their rage food is as good as anywhere else (although I have known birds sneer at the cheaper fat products).The latest order was delivered in two huge, heavy boxes - but one small feeder was forgotten.

records.title: Products and prices good but don’t…
records.text: Products and prices good but don’t think we should be charged for delivery as we live in mainland UK.We live in an IV area which is near Inverness but there is a direct route via the A9.Many other companies deliver to us with no additional charge.

records.title: Usual great delivery but the 'No Grow…
records.text: Usual great delivery but the 'No Grow No Wheat Seed Mix' leaves a great deal of mess now as not all of it is eaten, especially corn. This wasn't the case previously. I don't want to attract woodpigeon and rats so I'll need to find another supplier that provides a real 'no mess' mix.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: Good price for black sunflower seed, but arrived with both sacks split and seed leaking from the box. Prompt response to my complaint email, and two sacks received to transfer seed for storage. No compensation for lost seed (small amount) or inconvenience.

records.title: Paid extra for plastic tub of suet…
records.text: Paid extra for plastic tub of suet balls (as we'd had issues with rats) and it arrived broken. Emailed to request a replacement. Received no reply, just a £2 credit. Disappointing customer service. Don't care about the £2, will just order from RSPB next time.

records.title: Don’t believe their adverts
records.text: Attracted by an advert in Gardeners World May edition I decided to buy two 12.55 kg bags of sunflower hearts. The offered price was £26.99 each with a code as a first time customer offering a 20% discount with code GWGB20 (expiry 30/5/2023).  When contacting gardenbird the price was £29.49 (which they did offering to manually adjust to meet the £26.99) but could only offer 10% discount. They could not match the price they promised in the magazine - wasted my time.

records.title: The bird food is excellent but the…
records.text: The bird food is excellent but the courier just drops itover the gate and the packaging splits open. I need the product to be placed on the doorstep out of the rain.

records.title: Sadly P&P is now being added to our…
records.text: Sadly P&P is now being added to our orders it's was not when we started using this Co.  The Sunflower seeds are smaller than other Co's so we use a lot more which consequently means we order/pay for more.

records.title: First time using Garden Bird and was…
records.text: First time using Garden Bird and was disappointed in the quality of the seed mix, there was lots of husk and dust in it. For the price I was expecting better as in the past I've bought seed from various retailers alot cheaper but better quality.

records.title: Too many emails
records.text: I do not need to see daily emails with offers. I find daily email offers are too much. I'm thinking of using other suppliers who do not bombard me with daily offers

records.title: Inadequate Packaging of 25kilo birdseed
records.text: Packaging of 25kilo birdseed was inapprpriate. Using a cardboard box with no handholds or straps made it very difficult to handle. When it arrived, it had already been dropped a few times and was burst open. The 2x12.5k bags are good and successfuly prevented any wastage, but the outer packaging is inadequate - it needs better "handholds" for the van drivers.

records.title: Delivery error
records.text: Evri did not contact me to confirm the delivery. After several days the gardener from an empty house called “Waterfront”, locally, brought the parcel to me as the proper address was on the label. During the interim period there was lots of rain so of course the packing was wet. The contents were OK though.Garden bird did their job OK but Evri let them down.

records.title: Don’t buy the ‘No Grow No Mess Seed Mix’
records.text: Disappointingly the birds have absolutely zero interest in eating the ‘No Grow No Mess Seed Mix’. Not sure why! Also, one day after ordering a 2kg bag ‘Croston Premium Wild Bird Mix’ there was an offer for a free 2kg bag of the mix, which was significantly better value that the 10% offer I received. It made me feel like I was being penalised despite my loyalty. Seriously considering shopping elsewhere for my bird supplies

records.title: 25 Kg package delivered to wrong address 100yds away. address in…
records.text: 25 Kg package delivered to address in street 100 yds away necessitating myself, 70 yrs old, with osteoarthritis in both hands to cut open the package and take two halves the 100 yds to my home, my hands were agony afterwards. How they delivered the previous time no bother but not this time amazes me. They have lost a potential long term customer, however I doubt they will read this. ,

records.title: Overall disappointed
records.text: Overall disappointed. The delivery was quick. Unfortunately the bag of sunflower hearts was split and some of the contents were spread over the box. I don’t think too much was lost. Most disappointing though was the fact that I immediately contacted customer service, included photos, and have had absolutely no response at all. For this reason I shall probably not use this company again.

records.title: Delivery was promised but never…
records.text: Delivery was promised but never arrived. Had to chase the delivery company only to find they couldn't find the house even though they deliver almost every month. The redelivery then had to be delayed to avoid delivery while we were away. The delivery is scheduled for next week so hopefully it will arrive this time.

records.title: Whilst there was nothing wrong with the…
records.text: Whilst there was nothing wrong with the product - they need to get a new delivery company! My order was left up the road in somebody's garage!  I got an email saying  my order had been delivered (and I hadn't got it) so I had to go walkabout to see if I could find it - maybe the delivery driver should try looking at the numbers on doors!

records.title: Poor quality
records.text: The peanuts received in my last order are very small rubbish & fall through usual feeders. I no longer order fat balls from you since for some time they have also been poor. They dissolve in the rain ... perhaps an excess of bulking contents & little fat?

records.title: The new bird feeder
records.text: I ordered the new bird feeder, filled it and put it out.Within a very short time the total amount of seed was scattered on the ground.  I was extremely disappointed with this as although the feeder really looks great, the design lets it down.I will have to revert to an old feeder for now.

description:
Welcome to Pet Prestige, your one-stop shop for the best luxury dog beds for medium to large dogs! We know that your furry friends deserves the best, and that's why we offer a wide selection of high-quality luxury dog beds that are both stylish and comfortable.

Our beds are made from the finest materials, including plush fabrics, memory foam, and orthopaedic support, so your dog can relax and unwind after a long day of playing. Plus, our beds come in a variety of sizes and styles to fit any dog's personality. So whether you're looking for a cozy bed for your sleeping beauty or a durable bed for your active pup, we have the perfect bed for you.

records.title: Brilliant Quality
records.text: I’ve scoured the internet trying to find a good quality hideaway for our wee Boston Terrier to replace a travel crate she made her den and was outgrowing.    She has taken to her new den right away and happily hides away in there with whatever item she has managed to steal without us seeing her!    The quality is superb and a great investment in my opinion.   Thank you.

records.title: Pet Prestige has great products and superb customer service
records.text: Pet Prestige has great products. Particularly, the tweed cave beds. They absolutely have the best customer service. It is personal and not a chatbot. I want to particularly call out Nathan as being super helpful.

records.title: Thick, bouncy and durable bed
records.text: I ordered the Gorpet Outdoor Sleeper for my mum's rescue greyhound, Dandy. Nathan confirmed my order with a kind email which had a personal touch. The bed was despatched and delivered promptly and my mum described the bed as thick, bouncy and durable. Dandy is delighted!

records.title: Purchased the luxury cave bed
records.text: Purchased the luxury cave bed. Communication from company was good athough tracking the delivery was a problem, however bed arrived within 3 days. The bed is excellent quality, bigger than expected but just right for my boxer staffie cross. She loves it. Would definatly recommend this item.

records.title: Fantastic beds our dogs love these
records.text: Fantastic beds our dogs love these , excellent quality and super cozy.Its my pets best shop. love to have it.

records.title: Lovely bed , happy dog .
records.text: Made to order , very good quality material , easy to attach hood, prompt delivery and packaged very well . Very pleased with the bed , Bert went in it straight away and enjoys sleeping in it , just wish id ordered slightly larger size , apart from that very happy with purchase ..Thankyou .

records.title: Recommended by our Dog trainer we have…
records.text: Recommended by our Dog trainer we have now ordered and tried all products including treats, dog food & cat food. Can highly also recommend all and have done so to our clients (we have a small business) and friends. Great consistent quality

records.title: Wonderful service and brilliant products
records.text: Wonderful service and quite simply brilliant products. Yes, they may be more expensive but the quality is exceptional and our little sausage loves her new bed.

records.title: Perfect dog bed.
records.text: My dog loves her Gor Pets Ultimate bed and it’s stopped her sleeping on my bed so definitely a win! I had previously purchased a bed from Omlet but she wouldn’t sleep in it. I now have a hard time getting her out of the Ultima.Delivery was quick from pet prestige, my only complaint was I didn’t receive any notification of dispatch.Other than that very pleased

records.title: Excellent Service and Quality Product
records.text: Easy to order. Arrived in a few days. Well packed. Quality XL Fleece jacket for my dog. Would definitely use this company again.

records.title: The bed took exactly a week to arrive…
records.text: The bed took exactly a week to arrive and communication was poor. The contact phone number on the website doesn’t work.  However, we are very pleased with the bed and our dog seems to love it.

records.title: I would buy from Pet Prestige again.
records.text: I found Pet Prestige whilst looking for a particular dog bed, these guys sold them at the same price as other retailers but gave us £10 off 1st purchase which made them the cheapest. The delivery was initially very slow but after contacting Nathan (the owner) he checked with the supplier & found it was an issue their end. He assured me it would be delivered in a couple of days and it was. Customer service from the outset & throughout was very good as they did seem to care. I would purchase from Pet Prestige again & would recommend.

records.title: Overall good
records.text: Due to apparently missing the last date for Christmas orders it took 2 1/2 weeks for the company to let me know that even though the product ordered was ‘in stock’ at the point of payment it was actually ‘out of stock’ with no foreseeable date for new stock!So ended up ordering a more expensive product. However service once this was established was very good.Product bought was good quality and true to size and colour. Shame it’s made in China as you are led to believe that the products are very ‘British’!Happy with my purchase overall despite poor initial service.

records.title: Ordered two pet beds
records.text: Ordered two pet beds . Items arrived around 5 or 6  days after ordering and were well packed. Items as described and competitively  priced. Did not contact seller.

records.title: Green tweed cosy cave XL
records.text: Nice bed good quality.Struggled badly with the felt insert , which seems way to big and even though i eventually managed to get it in , it doesn’t seem to sit right.My dogs love it though so all 👍🏻

records.title: A lovely bed, but communication could be better.
records.text: I loved the bed when it arrived so glad I bought it however it took a long time to come with very little information provided. I was expecting delivery within 3-5 days when I ordered on 13 Aug. I got a message a few days later saying it would arrive by 21 Aug as there were delays with the supplier. Then nothing. When I chased on 23 Aug I was told beds would be shipped that Friday. I finally received it the following week, on 29 Aug.

records.title: Grey Cocoon Luxury dog bed & curtains
records.text: I ordered the ‘Grey Cocoon Luxury dog bed with Matching curtains in Brand New material’.Item arrived in good time and quality of this product is excellent. Really sturdy and very soundproofed when the wadding is inserted into the hood section. Only downside is that the fabric of the bed is a different shade/colour to that of the curtains.

records.title: I should have found something more economical and easy to assemble.
records.text: Pretty good customer service. The product is nice, and well made, but it was extremely difficult to fit the felt into the hood as it's just too big. The instructions could be clearer. My dogs just jump on it and crush it, so perhaps I should have found something more economical and easy to assemble.

records.title: Purchased for two mature whippets
records.text: Purchased for two mature whippets. Service is first class...response to email  swift, thank you. The quality of design, fabric and stitching for the beds is very good. My 4 star rating purely reflects the filling for the bed inner. Recommendation to remove unwanted excess filling appreciated as the filling is very generous. However, the fluffy type of stuffing provided takes too much time to 'bed in' for a dog. If too little is left in, the bed serves no purpose, but too much and the bed entrance becomes limited, unstable and uninviting for the dogs to enter. Dogs do not like unstable conditions. They prefer a soft, but stable environment to settle into. The beds would benefit from a more compact stuffing; this would create a better, more stable base which in turn would be more inviting for dogs to  bed down on. I have removed the filling provided and replaced it with feather cushions which is far better. Result...two happy whippets! On the down side is the expense for two beds!

records.title: Prompt delivery and high quality goods
records.text: Prompt delivery and high quality goods

records.title: Green Tweed Cacoon Dog Cave
records.text: The product is great and I mean great, its exactly what I ordered and the roof of the dog cave stays up and is pretty stable.The only criticism I have is when I ordered it I got no confirmation email or estimated date of delivery only a text to say they were processing the order, I tried to contact the company but with no reply.Sure enough though it arrived in about 5-7 days and once told a day it would be delivered it was and even on the morning of the day I was given a two hour slot which was helpful and a call off the driver about 15 minutes before he was dropping it off.All in all I'm very happy just a little uninformed in the middle of the experience but would still highly recommend using this company as the product is second to non 👍Slight side note, I read a review from Hogan Smith a few posts before my post and most people don't have chunky radiators we have thin or reasonably thin efficient ones, maybe it would be a good dea (or in English idea) you measure it and made sure the product your buying fits instead of just expecting it to, just an idea spelt correctly hogan smith lol 👍

records.title: The cave bed was very well made
records.text: The cave bed was very well made, but too deep for my small whippet.  Also, as all whippets like really soft bedding, it was far too firm.

records.title: 'Brilliant customer service
records.text: 'Brilliant customer service.  Quick communication and very helpful with delivery issues - not the fault of Pet Prestige.  Will be a returning customer.

records.title: Great product
records.text: Great product. Sadly the bed I wanted was out of stock but I had messages from Pet Prestige and was able to pick another pet bed.

records.title: I was very pleased with the Experience
records.text: I was very pleased with the communication received particularly the personal text to ensure I was still waiting to go ahead with the purchase.

records.title: Good customer service
records.text: Good customer service but waiting for delivery of my dog cave

records.title: Great Bed
records.text: This is a great bed and Chester loves it, the base is really firm but soft and cave part solid.Well made and would buy again.

records.title: Great quality item
records.text: Great quality item. Very large and comfortable

records.title: A really well made bed.We love it and…
records.text: A really well made bed.We love it and hopefully our new rescue will too.

records.title: Good quality bed
records.text: Good quality bed. Could improve on better communication about postage/delivery.

records.title: Delivery/tracking number
records.text: Never received tracking number, when I did receive it. Item had been delivered to wrong address. When it was found pet prestige had placed the wrong shipping address on the package

records.title: Pet bed really nice when it arrives…
records.text: Pet bed really nice when it arrives however the foam insert for the hood was way too big and after trying to fit it into the hood for over 40 mins we gave up and had to measure it and cut it down to size  so it fitted. Not ideal for something that was expensive and brand new. Real shame as it’s a lovely bed  probably should have sent it back but really couldn’t be bothered with the hassle of returning.

records.title: The felt roof for the cave ceiling was…
records.text: The felt roof for the cave ceiling was not cut anywhere near to size. The metal flexi stick was not the correct size either. It’s a shame as the bed is a lovely quality.

records.title: Excellent customer service and quick…
records.text: Excellent customer service and quick delivery.. the only issue I have is the thin metal rods that hold the front up has come through the material and the top material is sagging. The actual base of the bed is great. Think it’s still worth the money.

records.title: No mention about no hair if you want to return it
records.text: The bed was nice however it did not feel luxurious. Feels like any other dog bed. After 2 days it was still very wrinkled and the pillow part was not soft at all, no special inside to feel luxurious(feathers, memory foam?). The most disapointing part is that they say Satisfaction guaranteed, however they do not mention anything on their website about not having hair on the product if you want to return it. My dog tried to use it but she would just sit next to it so decided to return it as it is was still in a new condition however there was some hair on it from the floor so rather than have it sent and risk having it refused after paying postage because of some hair that might have got in the package by mistake I rather just sell it to someone else locally... overall stressful situation

records.title: Initial problems resolved
records.text: Initially I gave only 1 star as my order was several days late being delivered however this appears to have been down to dx a very unreliable carrier. Unfortunately poor delivery will inevitably reflect badly on the seller and give the buyer unnecessary hassle. However I offered Nathan of pet prestige 1 last opportunity to put things right which thankfully he did by using the very reliable carrier dpd who delivered my cave bed today. My staffie cross has already given it the paws up!

records.title: Ok experience
records.text: Communication was appreciated as it was a lot of money.I didn’t measure up properly and had to return. Delivery isn’t Included in the refund, therefore you pay twice to return items.

records.title: The deluxe cave bed Stopped being a cave
records.text: The deluxe cave bed arrived and was loved immediately by my dog. But the plastic tube that keeps the cave up tore threw the fabric and the cave collapsed. This happened on the second day of use. The ends of the plastic are sharp. My dog is small and not violent. The plastic is badly designed and for £69 very expensive for a bed thats main feature does not work after one day. I sent an email to the company but got no reply.Update: The update is that Pet Prestige responded to my complaint, and processed the return of the Cave Bed and my refund very quickly.I am very satisfied with their costumer service. So 5 stars for customer service.However it’s still 2 stars for the design of the bed.

records.title: Similar item received
records.text: Similar item received - not one I ordered. It was the communication before the order was received which means that I would stay clear.I would not deal with them again.Bad experience.

records.title: Poor quality
records.text: I purchased a £90 dog bed and it started falling apart after less than 6 months of barely being used by my dog who prefers to sleep on the floor. I contacted customer service who were rude and fairly unhelpful. After explaining how disappointed I was I was offered £20 to have it repaired myself which I accepted. That was weeks ago and I never received the money they promised and now they aren’t responding to my messages. What a waste of money. So disappointed. Edit to add: I have received the £20 since writing my original review, so that’s something at least so I added a star.

records.title: I'm afraid I'm very disappointed with…
records.text: I'm afraid I'm very disappointed with my dog bed. The hood part was folded and kind of squashed in the packaging and does not stand up when attached to the cushion. It's been quite floppy from the start and I've been unable to get it to stand up enough to allow my dog easily inside. As a result, he lies on top of it - which of course makes matters worse. So basically the hood design, which I thought would be brilliant doesn't work at all. Even with the discount, I feel I've paid too much for just a flat bed, as I've now removed the useless hood. Would be glad to hear your comments, as the bed has never looked the way it does in the pictures - perhaps it was a faulty bed?

records.title: I would not recommend!!!
records.text: I recently purchased the luxury deluxe cocoon cave bed for my dog, it was his birthday present. The bed arrived around a week before the birthday which was great, however, on unpacking on the day there was no instructions of how to put the bed together. Inside was this large piece of felt, a bendy rod and the curtains. I didn’t pay near £200 for a bed ‘I’ would have to put together!!!  As someone who suffers from a Mental Health condition I struggled terribly with trying to put it together and this impacted on my anxiety. In the end I gave up and first rang the moblie number on their website which was switched off or not available, can’t remember which but needless to say it didn’t connect and no facility to leave a message. I then completed the online form stating I was struggling to put the bed together due to my MH and could they send me instructions? That was on 15th Oct and to date I have heard nothing back. In the end I struggled through but the felt piece does not sit flush with the hood part of the cave bed and there are kinks in it where it folds due to excessive material. Whilst the bed is lovely the whole structure isn’t. The curtains keep sliding off as my dog gets in and out of his bed as they are not fixed or zipped to the main structure. The hood keeps collapsing because it’s not sturdy enough, it’s basically a piece of felt shoved in an empty space acting as a hood. Honestly I wish I’d not bought the bed and I wish I’d not bought it from this company, given the cost of it. It’s a useless bed for £194.97 and their aftercare is even worse! If you have MH or if you may need aftercare help then please go elsewhere for your dog bed because they have no active phone number where you can contact them if there is a problem, they don’t respond when you fill their contact form and the bed isn’t fit for purpose!

records.title: Not fit for any dog with claws 🙄
records.text: "Unfortunately, this bed was a huge disappointment. Unless you have a dog that simply sits down without moving around, this bed is not for you. My small dog likes to burrow a bit before settling, and after just a week, the bed was already in tatters. I contacted Pet Prestige, and they blamed my dog for the damage, which I understand since she does burrow. However, I've had beds that cost less than half the price last for years, and they’ve never ended up in this condition."Would like to add photos, but there is no attachment availability?? Will be donating this bed to a dog shelter, not even a month old!

records.title: Bed arrived damaged
records.text: The bed I ordered arrived damaged, likely done in transit. It was a large, heavy bed and only posted in a thin plastic parcel bag, which in my opinion for a bed over £200 was not adequate! I messaged the company, I was understanding and as a small tear i requested a patch of the material be sent as would be less faff than organising collection for such a large item. I am still waiting for said  patch, utterly disappointed and I should have just returned the bed, now left with a damaged item!!

records.title: Never recieved goods ordered
records.text: Never recieved goods ordered, not answering phone or my emails have had to raise a case through PayPal to hopefully get money back don't order from them .

records.title: Very poor
records.text: Received the order in time but the product was very poor quality from what was shown on the website. The item shown looked exactly what I needed but what was sent was no good, it was a lot shorter In height and the sides were round not flat and straight, I spoke to their customer service and they said to reshape it to what I wanted but this wasn't possible, I will be returning these and not using their service again,

records.title: Bed Fine, Frame Unsuitable for Use.
records.text: Unfortunately we cannot use the radiator bed as the radiators we have are quite chunky. For future information it may be an dea to be able to adjust the size to fit any radiator.

records.text: Item arrived damaged. Seller seems reluctant to provide details of how to return. Contacted 3 x times and nothing happening with refund. Very disappointing service.
